My only slight complaint is that since the bowl isn't totally rounded (bottom is flat) I still have to help her get out the last few spoonfuls of the yogurt, oatmeal, etc.  We have one or two rounded bowls with the suction cups (which don't work by the way) and she has an easier job getting the food out of the rounded bowl.  I think this is a very small issue though and I would still highly recommend these bowls and purchase them as gifts for other people.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Great for toddler/kids - hold up to dishwasher and being dropped

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I bought this scrubber based on the recommendations on Amazon and am totally satisfied with it. I scrubbed the bathroom in no time, scrubbed the sinks AND my 7 year old trash can--which is gleaming white right now! And I didn't even wear out the battery power.
This tool is easy to assemble (just put in the battery and pads) and easy to use. For this price, I can't even hire a housecleaner in my area to work for one hour!
Highly recommend it!

I spent a long time trying to find a quality thermos that kept the drink warm but wouldn't spill. The popular choice for this seemed to be the Contigo travel mug.  Unfortunately, that is not fully disassemble-able - so it can't be fully cleaned (if needed).  I found this mug and it's fantastic.  Met all of the requirements and looks pretty good.

Note: Aeropress users, this mug is too narrow to fit the Aeropress or it's adapter funnel.  You'll need to brew into an intermediate container.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Great thermos and easy to clean

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
Crafty World has been amazing in making sure that I am happy with their travel pillow. It is a well made pillow and for those who like a very firm feel, this is the pillow for you. It fits around the neck quite well and supports the head as it needs to.
They are a great company and care about their customers.

I was in the market for a toaster and wanted a white one. I was going to get a cheapy but I got a gift certificate from Amazon for Mother's Day. So, I purchased the Cuisinart. I love this toaster. It does everything I wanted it to do. I use whole wheat toast. The toaster toasts it to perfection.

Bought one of these from amazon and after a few days I could really tell how much it has helped clean my house. I have 4 dogs and always wondered why things have been so dusty and why particles are always in the air. This basically solved that problem overnight.

I liked this so much I ordered another one a few days later for my bedroom upstairs where there is no return air duct so it has help tremendously.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: God Send in a beautiful package.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
My husband and I have tried at least a dozen pillows between us over the past couple years.  They all seem to be too soft, too hard, too high, or too low. (Hmm, this is beginning to sound like Goldilocks and the three Bears, isn't it?)  Well, after reading so many positive reviews about these pillows, we decided to give them a try.  The instructions say to fill with 2 quarts of water for a soft pillow, 3 quarts for medium, or 4 quarts for firm.  They suggest starting with 3 quarts for medium.  My husband went with the 3 quarts, but I figured I would like a softer pillow and used 2 quarts.  It was a Little bit too soft so I ended up adding another quart and that was just the right amount.

These pillows come with very easy instructions and pictures.  They even come with a nice little spout that you screw in to the valve on the pillow where you fill it.  They suggest setting the Pillow on one end on a chair when filling and that made it very simple both to fill and to press out the air bubbles.  Then just tighten the valve, and you're all set.  There is a thick soft layer of padding above the water bladder, so it never feels cold.  I find that it's very comfortable and cradles my head perfectly.  My husband likes his too.

There is a product code included with each pillow where you can "like" them on Facebook and get a free hypoallergenic pillow cover.  I think this is a great solution for anyone who can't find the perfect pillow because you can add or subtract water to make it just to your liking.  I'm a happy sleeper again!

The brush did not hold up to scrubbing two potatoes.  The bristles bent every direction.  I contacted the seller and was told they would send a replacement right away.  That was a couple of months ago.  They do not return my emails either.  I have had a scrubber like this in the past that lasted many years.  I would NOT purchase this from this seller.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: I have had a scrubber like this in the past that lasted many years

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
UPDATE: In response to my previous review, the company did send me a replacement. I appreciated the responsive customer service. However, the replacement was no better. Within a few weeks, it started to fall apart. After just a month, there was a 3-foot long hole. I think the waves/ridges make it less structurally sound than normal memory foam toppers. I got a flat, solid memory foam topper, and it looks brand new four months later.

Original review:
I bought this memory foam 3 weeks ago. I was happy with it at firstits comfortablebut after just 3 weeks of use its falling apart.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Fell apart after a few weeks

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
My original Duraflame Fireplace/Heater lasted for close to 4 years before it ultimately conked out. I had no problem with that as it had served its purpose longer than I thought it would.  San Francisco nights can be very cold all year long. So I find the same frplc set on Amazon on June 30th, but I want to make sure it also has the same 3 prong plug in that my original set had.  5 out of 7 people said "YES, IT DOES".  I could not imagine why 2 people said they had a regular 2 prong plug?  Why would this fireplace unit be manufactured with two different style plugs?  So I ordered it and a 3 year protection plan. It arrived today...  so excited when UPS showed up.  I didn't even have to pull the unit out of the box to see it had a &#@! TWO PRONG PLUG!  To add insult to injury, AMAZON Customer Service tells me that I will be charged a fee (couldn't or wouldn't tell me how much of a fee) for UPS to pick up the package at my home.  The outer ship box is HUGE and it's slightly heavy and very awkward to carry - just ask my UPS guy . So hauling it over to the UPS facility is out of the question for me!  The 1 Star is for a non-usable product and a no thanks to Amazon for such a time-wasting and disappointing experience!!!  (pic is of my orig. fireplace insert)
UPDATE:  RETURNED the "never unpacked" Duraflame within 24 hours and I am being CHARGED  $20.86 for the privilege of doing business with AMAZON...
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: My ORIGINAL Duraflame was FABULOUS *  The 'New' Duraflame NOT SO MUCH

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: This is literally the worst thing that has happened to me in....I don't know, well, ever. This mandoline cut off the end of my thumb. Entirely. About half an inch of my thumb was sitting on the bucket with the sweet potato chips. Im currently typing with my other thumb and right index finger because I still cant handle things touching it almost two years later. The ER doctor said that mandolins really shouldnt be sold to the general public because he sees an incident like this once a day. Hes right. Dont buy it unless you hate your fingers.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Im writing this review with one thumb

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
Ozeri Nouveaux II Electric Wine Opener:
Bought this wine opener based on Amazon reviews. Great idea, simple to use, fun blue light when charging/using.
BUT---Cork extraction direction ceased to function after 4 bottles! Re-charging, jiggling, and swearing did not
reverse the problem. Back to Amazon ( returns are simple, fast and pain-free!). Thanks, but I'll stick with a
simple method of mechanical wine cork extraction, like rabbit or wing types.

You can use all the excuses you want for this product-not enough oil, too little oil-this product is worthless. I'm tired of hearing all the restrictions and what you need to do to get this product to work.  I followed the directions, and I may have gotten 1 month of non-stick out of it.  I was so frustrated with it, I threw it in the trash, where it belonged!  I replaced it with a Cephalon non-stick PFOE free pan, and I have never been happier.  I don't have to follow all the stupid rules-use only small amount oil etc, I use the Cephalon pan with ease, eggs and other foods slide off beautifully, and it cleans up great.  The Cephalon was worth every penny.  Don't waste your money on the Aeternum pan!

Terrible pillow. I have purchased 6+ Pacific Coast pillows from Costco and loved them! But this one is painful. First, the description said it is a down surround pillow. I realize that I may not have understood "down surround" meaning that it is a combination of down and feather. Had I known this, I would not have purchased it. The pillow is too firm and feathers are noisy!

This clock is beautiful BUT I still can't justify the price especially after buying some other metal art from overstock. That was beautiful and reasonably priced (without Jon Allen signature which I seriously I don't care about). See the attached  pictures of the back of the clock. I don't  expect splattered paint when I pay $215 for this.

I was so excited to finally have a coat rack seeing as how they are so expensive.  Well, once I got it I was very diappointed.  None of the hooks will stay attached to it, I have one left that is still hanging on, but I'm sure it will go soon.  Thanks for selling a piece of crap!

So I usually only slam a product if three things go wrong, well guess what, three things went wrong.

When I bought my Sodastream from BB&B (first week in January), it came with a sample pack of flavors, the root beer exploded all over everything and we spent 20 minutes cleaning everything else. (this is #1).

That night I called to voice my displeasure and the Sodastream customer service rep told me he would sent out a new sample pack. 6 weeks later nothing (that is #2).

Tonight, I traded in my old carbonator on February 15th at BB&B. No problem with the exchange. I installed the new cylinder and my Fizz chip register not full. Had to pop out the Fizz chip take out the battery and reset the meter. It did register full, but I am not really trusting the fullness. (that is #3).

Way to buggy of a product for $149 and this company is experiencing some supply chain/quality assurance issues.

AVOID!
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: This company/product is not ready for prime time.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: Dear fellow consumers, please don't be fooled.  Conical burr grinders are high performing grinders for true coffee connoisseurs.  A burr grinder that is not conical, technically a burr wheel grinder, is an overpriced fake that performs marginally and CLOGS every few grinds!  My favorite part is the nice tan I get from the coffee dust from cleaning this thing with compressed air for 50 minutes!

Totally dissatisfied with this purchase.  This coffee table it tiny compared to how it looks in the pictures.  Definitely look at the dimensions before you buy it.  Also some of the side panels didn't fit even because the hole for the attaching hardware were no exactly in the right place.  It comes in so many pieces that it's impossible to repack and return.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Totally dissatisfied with this purchase. This coffee table it ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
When I received this I looked for an indication that it was bpa free. It didn't say it anywhere. When I googled the question about citristar being bpa free I could not find that anyone knew. I called the company and spoke to someone who said he would check.he came back and said it was. I asked how I would know for sure. He asked if I wanted
 him to send me the papers.. I said yes. He sounded insincere but I gave him my email address. I never received anything. Even checked my spam.  I'm sending it back. Even though it got good ratings I'm not taking a chance that it has bpa in it.

I received the print late, not in the two days guaranteed.  When it arrived the art was completely off the frame backing.  Small nails were sticking off the frame and all of it was damaged. The backing of the art looked as if it was glued to the frame at one time.  Very disappointed and will not be buying again.  Now I have to take time out of my day to return the item for their poor packaging or whatever the issue was!

I believe this is deceptive.

You do not receive the items pictured. The mesh is not the same as pictured. The zipper is not attached the way shown in the pictures. I'll grant that "Premium" is mere puffery, but the failure to send the item pictured - and to be substantially different - a deceptive practice.

The bags themselves are a bad value. They are very lightweight. One of the bags zipper came off the first week, and was too difficult to re-attach.

Is reviewing such an inexpensive item worth it? If you have this money you want to spend, please donate it to your Amazon Smile charity instead.

Used to replace the stock pourer that came with an oil/vinegar set. Only using for the vinegar bottle. The cap gets stuck frequently, which is annoying because it causes a fast gush of vinegar when the cap swings open. The metal rusted within the first few WEEKS of use. Super disappointed. Good thing it comes as a pack of 6 - I will go through ALL 6 in the same amount of time I had the original pourer from the set.

These things were great at first, but as time went on, they became a total chore to open or close. I often have to remove the top almost completely in order to get some of these to twist.

Update: A year later, we're throwing out empty tins as we run out of what they held, and going back to the store bought containers. This has to be the biggest failure of a purchase I've made from Amazon. These things are garbage with anything small enough to get between the lid and tin, turning them into an unturnable pain in the ass.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: These things were great at first

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: The heater does not turn on. We tried everything. Plugged into different outlets and tried to turn it on manually or with the remote. Nothing. The thing is dead. It is clear that it has been assembled before. Bracket that holds the heater in the frame is broken on one side. I am just appalled because I cant imagine how much it would cost to ship it back to return it. So that means we have to get an electrician to try to fix it. Just ridiculous!
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: The heater does not turn on. We tried everything ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: The product worked fine when received but when my husband went to use the next time it showed the room temperature as 200 degrees then went to HHHH in the display.  He checked the battery it was fine but still tried another just in case.  He has not been able to get it to work to date.  For this reason I would not recommend this product.

I read in the reviews that the fan vibrates so much that it tends to walk around, but it was way worse than I was expecting.  I got it for my window and when I realized that it vibrated so badly I wedged it into the window until it didn't move, but then about 10 minutes later I heard a crash upstairs and my fan was broken.

This is at least partially operator error, but do not underestimate the power of the wobbles if purchase this fan (I wish now I would have just gone for a nicer one that doesn't wobble since I have to get another one anyways now).

We bought this twin Milliard mattress along with the 8" full version for a bunk bed.  This mattress is so squishy that it's hard to believe there's regular foam underneath the memory foam.  I cannot lay on the edge of the bed at all--it flattens by three or four inches.  Both mattresses were more supportive when they were on the floor (as opposed to slats on the bunk bed).  Anyone have suggestions for making these beds more supportive?

With that said, the smell did not last very long, and this mattress does expand to the right size.  My kids do not seem to mind the firmness/softness issues.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Way too soft.  Tell me I got a dud?

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: Not sure why this is a number one seller. I suggest not wasting your money on this item. After little over a month the mesh inside the electric kettle broke off. This is an important piece since it filters the water and does not let any mineral accumulation come out. Not sure how it happened but I was not able to get a replacement through Amazon since it had been over a month. They recommended I contact Hamilton which I did but after speaking with them they could send me a replacement but had to charged me shipping of $10 dollars. I didn't think it was fair since I had just bought it and was going to have to pay more for the same item. Save your money people and get something else.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Save your money people and get something else.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I bought this toaster, and it was working great. Up until the mechanism for the lever broke.

This toaster advertises for extra wide slots for bagels. Apparently, they didn't take into account that REAL bagels are thick.
There is a metal bar in the bottom of the slot that is meant to hold your bread/bagel/whatever so it doesn't fall to the bottom. This kept getting jammed, and I had to readjust it almost every day.

My parents have had the same toaster for 15 years, It's unfortunate that no one will ever be able to get a built to last appliance in this throw away society that we live in. I thought Hamilton Beach was a good name, but I guess I was mistaken.

I even called to get the warranty, but in order to do this YOU must pay $11.99 for return shipping. Why should we have to pay return shipping for a product that they screwed up?
Then to top it off, customer care informed me I need to cut the cord from the toaster and send them a photo of it.
This completely nullifies the warranty! How does that make any sense? I understand they want to make sure they're not getting scammed, but you are literally sending them photographic evidence that you physically altered their product, voiding the warranty.

It's a shame.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Had the toaster for less than 2 months before it broke.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: I purchased this alarm clock because my previous one quite working.  The old one was an Emerson Smart Clock as well and I had it for well over 15 years, I loved it.  It was easy to set and when the power was off it would reset its time when it came on.  I purchased this Emerson CKS 1708 clock to take the old one's place, thinking it would be of the same quality.  I was immensely disappointed.  It is lightweight, cheap feeling.  It is a nightmare to set the time and change the alarm.  I couldn' find the instructions on how to reset the alarm. I threw it in the garbage yesterday and am waiting for a simple alarm clock to come in.  I hated this clock and wouldn't recommend it to anyone!
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: The old one was an Emerson Smart Clock as well and I had it for well ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
The Bialetti 6800 moka express 6 cup is what I received for $30 which could have been purchased from and shipped from Amazon for $22 at the date of this review. So, buyer beware! But that's not the reason for my review. The pot I received leaked and blew steam from the center where it screws together. Of the six cups of filtered water I used one cup made it into the upper chamber, with most of the rest on my kitchen range or pack stove. The pot screwed together quite roughly, threads were either not cut or molded to allow smooth tightening inside was not finished well nor was the lid. I wonder if I received a counterfeit Bialetti?

 I have been using my 3 cup moka daily for over three years and have learned some of the quirks it has but that the fun part; learning new coffee brewing equipment.
As an afterthought; Today I purchased a Bialetti 6800 moka express 6 cup in town and it screwed together smoothly and flawlessly. The inside is finished as I am accustomed to with Bialetti and no grey dust on my drying cloth. So I wonder if I did get a counterfeit moka?
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Not the Bialetti quality I'm use too.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: These are the worst piece of junk lounge chair clips!  See attached pics.  The package arrived open and broken.  These will NOT stand up to even one use. The plastic construction and wire ring is super thin and flimsy.  I wanted to use them for lounge chairs on cruise ships, but they won't even survive packing in my luggage.  What they don't tell you in the description is that the opening is only 2 1/4" fully extended.  That's not enough thickness for your beach towel and the diameter of the chair.  I am sending these back  right away.

Buyer Beware! I received a different heart that looked more like a spade and had a raised top where the ashes go into. Does not loot like the picture posted. It's NOT even close to the same heart pictured. I will be having to keep it as after I put some of my sons cremains into it and screwed it shut, the round ring that attaches to the lid/ screw part broke off.  Now I can not attach it to my key chain nor hang it from the mirror of my car. So annoyed and angry about this! I paid $25.00 for it!
I would have returned it before I put ashes into it but I was so sad after the loss of my son and my brain got mixed up now and then due to the stress, and I temporarily didn't remember or notice it was not the same one I ordered as I had ordered many many different pieces of cremation jewelry recently. Now my sons ashes are stuck it there!  I want a refund or replacement with the Heart pictured.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Item received NOT the same as pictured

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: This order was 10 days late arriving after the date estimated by Amazon. To make matters worse, I had been canning jams for a Bazaar fundraiser and I filled out over 40 labels only to find out that when I went to put them on the jars the adhesive was staying on the backing tape and NOT on the label-very frustrating! I contacted Amazon ad was informed that I had to return the labels (a cost that was as much as the labels themselves). They gave me a $ 5.00 credit for the inconvenience but I have yet to get credit for the returned items. I always seek out and trust Ball products because of their dependability and quality and this was an aggravating disappointment. I had no choice but to use cheesy computer sticker's labels to label the jams that I spent so much time and care to put up. I am sure that this is a manufacturing defect but frustrating nevertheless.

Sadly, this canister is about as lightweight and flimsy as any flip-top style container I have handled. Too bad because it looks nice in the pictures and even from a few feet away, but once you handle it the challenges are quickly exposed.

That said - it is correctly described in the listing as weighing just 9.4 ounces... the paperback book in my hand right now weighs 30% more at 12.2 ounces. Six inches tall, five inches in diameter, a top, gasket and closing mechanism... combining for just 9.4 ounces.

Summarizing as briefly as possible: The metal of the canister is very thin; The lid of the canister is made of plastic and the injection molding tabs have not even been polished off (hard and rough little stubs around the edge); The rubber gasket needed for the airtight seal is poorly fitted under the lid and falls out each time the lid is opened; The gasket is next to impossible to get back into the lid's groove so that the closing mechanism has a chance of sealing properly; The closing mechanism does not apply enough pressure to push the plastic lid all the way down over the gasket and create a good seal; The wire ring part of the lid closing mechanism is so flimsy that we have a difficult time lining the lid up with the canister when trying to lock the lid closed. More often than not we give up and just close it off-center (therefore not airtight).

I did receive this unit gratis from the manufacturer and we tried to put it through its paces to objectively find out how well it performed. My statements here reflect that testing.

Am thinking about taking it into work and just putting it in the break area filled with things that do not need an airtight seal like M&Ms, gum balls, or jelly beans. Still, at the current price that's not worth a second star.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: HomeFlav Flip Top Canister - Thin metal container and plastic top - Not airtight for us - Difficult to use

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: You wouldn't think that a bread box, as long as it stayed together, could be so bad.  Well, it stayed together, but with the poorly aligned edges on the roll-top like door, the uneven and poorly routed slide guides for it and the exceptionally thin wood used to make it...it would actually be better if it had not arrived in one piece as then the other flaws would go unnoticed.  If this were just a few dollars, it would be worth the time to sand and patch, but at $30 for this level of (or lacking of) craftsmanship, it's actually offensive.  Honestly, even if it actually opened and closed properly, I would still only give it 3 stars as the flimsiness of it does not warrant such a high pricetag.  I built a better one in shop class in 7th grade and I was by no means a star pupil in that class.

I was really looking forward to using this heater/cool fan in my RV. It had great reviews from RV'ers and others for its heating capabilities particularly in colder weather. I liked its design and how it looked.

However, I was very disappointed. It doesn't heat the room anywhere nearly as well as the Vortex Whole Room heater which is 1/6th the cost. The Dyson is better for a spot heating situation.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: It had great reviews from RV'ers and others for its heating capabilities ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
this centerpiece is not the size it should be  states is 27 inches long  it is barely 18 and only 6 inches wide  not 11  the greenery is falling
out and the candy pieces are fades and look very old and perused!  I would not recommend buying this.
one of the candles is barely glowing  I think the price of the 3 batteries I used are probably worth more than the item
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: I would not recommend buying this

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: I too hoped this was the poor man's Thermapen. My experience was not "ultra fast thermometer with 4-7 second readout". It frequently took 50-90 seconds. I probably could have lived with that, but could not live with every time having to use a butter knife to expose the probe. I was unable to pull it out with my fingers, and I wasn't going to use my finger nails. So back it goes for a refund. Disappointing.

Finally gave up with this product.  The dough sticks in the grooves so badly I spend all my time cleaning it out so I never used it.  I have since purchased a different item whose blades are sharp enough to cut flour and butter or shortening together quickly and well.  The Salvation Army now has possession of this one.

Probably should have read the reviews before making a purchase. The photo makes it look sturdy, but just as others have said, the wire bends easily, is difficult to straighten or tighten, and while the frame has a nice, smooth finish to the top (visible in the photo and while in the package) the underside is hollowed out almost as if they forgot to attach the back half. It's not comfortable to hold, doesn't work well, and the adjustable feature, while a great idea, is executed poorly.

I wouldn't recommend this. Ended up buying one from Publix that works like a dream.

Was hoping to have a monitor in the kitchen for both my kitchen fridge and for the freezer.  The freezer is directly under the kitchen but the signal was unable to make it to the display unit.  I had hoped that the claim of 330' would make this strong enough to make it no more than 30' even with the freezer siding and a floor in between.

I liked this tea kettle at first, but then found out that you can easily burn your hand on the handle.  Then, it started rusting inside.  Can't return it as it was sent to me by the company as a replacement for a different one that got a hole in the side after only a few uses.  It's made in China.

Bought the XL version after frying two 14# turkey's last year w my standard version (which I love).  On Thanksgiving Day, I start heating the oil, but the "ready" light never came on.  I thought the light was bad, dropped the turkey in, and realized the heating element had shut off.  After checking power, breakers, I had to take the bird out and reset the element.  Returning this one, I have no idea why the element won't hear properly.  Have never seen the "ready" light w this one.

I bought two 25X40 sets for my left and right doors and they DO pull off easily when raising but not when lowering. mine only have the 2 magnets on the ends, perhaps a third in the middle would have helped or a stronger larger magnet used at the ends.  Disappointed there are no parts supplied to secure the bottoms because the way they flap around I can see them getting caught in the door frame as the door is shut and broken. these are identical to the ones sold by carol wright gifts for $8.99, but I purchased these thinking they would be better quality and now CRG is sold out.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: not secure enough for my steel doors, they pull off and bottoms flap around ....

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: The size was perfect, but the actual product is defective. There are large areas in several spots where the stitched pattern is a problem. It makes the design looked blotched out compared to the rest of the coverlet's pattern, and you can see this all along the bottom part of my photo. The color is another slight issue, being more on the golden mustard color side rather than a taupe on the brown side. Other than these two issues, it's a decent taupe coverlet for a hard-to-find oversized queen mattress.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Stitched pattern was defective for mine

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I purchased this immersion blender after our Braun unit burned out after more than eight years of use.  The Kitchen Aid unit is quite disappointing for many reasons.  Chief among these is the chopper/blender blade does not do an adequate job no matter how long one runs it nor pulses it.  Two illustrations suffice:  in making a blue cheese dressing the unit never fully blended the ingredients.  In chopping triscuits (we use them to make "bread" crumbs because they are whole wheat) we are never able to adequately and evenly chop them to a reasonably fine but not powdered consistency.  In using the immersion blender the unit never delivers a smooth result.

In addition to these major disappointments, the design of the speed control lacks a locking-in feature which means depending on how one holds the unit it can slip from one speed to another.

In conclusion, I would prefer to have replace our Braun with another equal unit but an equivalent one was not available at a good price and this KitchenAid received such high (and undeserved) ratings.  Were it not beyond the 30 day period, I would return it but we did not use it sufficiently prior to the 30 days to make a good judgment.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Adequate at Best and Not Well Designed

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
This $200 unit replaced a six year old $400 unit.  Not sure why I settled for GE again after the early failure on the last one (JVM1870).  But I did, went with the cheapest one I could find knowing if I got 5 years I was ahead, compared to 6 years with my expensive model.

The template was not the same so I had to drill more holes in my wall and cabinet.

Otherwise it installed fine.

The most annoying feature about this one is the noise.  A fan turns on everytime I cook and it is loud!  All microwaves make noise, but this baby sounds like 747 in my kitchen. I mean loud!

I have thought about returning it but am not sure others would be much quieter.

Our usage is consistent with a family of four, teenage kids, re-heating food, popcorn, and warming up stuff.

Feels a little cheaper than the original. Just a little less quality plastic, if that's even possible since the original did not impress either. I thought the blender was loud before but with this on it it sounds like a jet engine full of rocks. The better idea would be to trash the Cuisinart blender and start over. Alas, now I'll have to wait for it to break a third time to toss it.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: I thought the blender was loud before but with this on it it sounds like a jet engine full of rocks

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: I was disappointed with this item because I had had a Black & Decker several years ago which was smaller and remivable from its base.  I had expected that I could just slide a new base into the old one.  This also had to  be retooled which causes 4 "bumps" inside the cabinet, so items cannot sit on a flat surface.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Bladk & Decker under cabinet can opener

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: Tested this thermometer in a toaster oven and my regular oven, set both for 350 degrees. The toaster oven was over-cooking food so was curious to see what the actual temperature was, the gauge read between 325 and 330 the entire time which was unexpected. So put it in the regular oven and it never read above 340. So not sure how accurate it is. Also the dial is VERY slow to move.

I bought two (size - large). One is good, but the other got a dent and a crack in the middle. The shipping box is fine, so it is not UPS's fault. thought of returning it, but really don't feel worth the time and effort. The product itself is good, but it is annoying if it is damaged for some reason.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: The product itself is good, but it is annoying if it is damaged for some reason

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I love Bodum products and it looked fantastic. Like many others who wrote reviews, I too was very disappointed with the cup being too fragile. Bought a set of two and broke one of them the same day of opening the box.

I am constantly worried of breaking the remaining glass.

Otherwise, it does what it's suppose to. Keeps hot drinks hot and cold drinks cold for long periods. Looks absolutely beautiful.

But again, I would not buy another set mainly because it is too fragile.

I should have listened to the reviews! I thought that perhaps the other reviewers were expecting too much and assumed they would have a strong flavor. I on the other hand, just expected a very slight hint of mint flavor like the toothpicks I get from many of the restaurants that I frequent. These have zero flavor other than wood. I could have bought 1000 toothpicks locally for about 1 dollar. At least I learned a lesson about trusting the reviews.

One purpose of a decanter is to let a wine BREATHE for awhile. This decanter fills to the top with a bottle of wine hence negating what a standard size decanter will allow.  I do like the look, light weight and feel so I will be keeping mine.  For a serious wine I will use my larger crystal.

Update: I got the black model, and it definitely looks better than the silver/grey one, but it's still cheap and flimsy quality wise. Don't be misled by all the reviewers going crazy over this. If Amazon had better return/exchange policy, I might have upped the star-rating. So I'm sticking with the 2-star.

Original review:
I thought the silver model would go great with the stainless steel appliances in my kitchen. I was wrong. The pictures are just misleading. The silver model really is grey, and made of cheap plastic. It does what it's supposed to, and that's the best I can say about it. I wanted to return it, but Amazon's return policy meant that I would have to pay return shipping, despite me being a prime member, and literally (I do mean literally) having ordered thousands of dollars worth of stuff from Amazon in the past. The return shipping is some 35% of the price of the drawer. Never mind Amazon, I'll just keep this thing. I'm ordering the black one now, which hopefully I'll like better, but I'm getting it from Target instead of Amazon. Much easier to return if I don't like it.

Good suction, until it gets plugged.  There is a fine mesh screen within the plastic collection bin that gets clogged very frequently. You will have to use a delicate brush, like a toothbrush, to clean it when you clear the bin. With this Dyson, it is no longer as easy as dump the bin and go.  So unfortunately. this is the first Dyson that does indeed lose suction completely once this mesh screen gets plugged with hair and dust.

If you can put up with that, then this Dyson offers great suction. It does feel quite a bit cheaper plastic-wise than our past Dysons.  They probably had no choice in order to keep this Dyson from getting too heavy.  Also, the Big Ball tends to squeak and squeal quite a bit.  Overall, great suction but a general miss for Dyson.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Gets plugged and loses suction (see photos).  Big ball squeaks and squeals.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
Not that great. Hard to fall asleep on it even tucked under the pillow case. It's too heavy and slides off the pillow to one side or the other. Not to mention it freezes my ear so much when I turn on my side that I can't sleep.
Giving 2 stars instead of one because it DOES get pretty cool. But in practice, I would only use this for someone running a high fever for their comfort.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Hard to fall asleep on it...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: If you have never had popcorn from the original Stircrazy, you may well like this one.  However, be careful not to burn the corn. I bought this model for the convenience of being able to put it in the dishwasher, which is the best thing it has to offer.  I have just purchased the original again and enjoyed my first batch or really great popcorn since my old one died. If you do buy the new model, turn it off while it is still popping or it will burn while you are struggling to snap on the black butter lid and then flip the popper.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: This new model not as good as the original.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: We had the first brewstation and we were ok with it except we had bought the one you couldn't program and you couldn't tell how much coffee was left. This one can be programmed.  In that respect, it is fine.  You can also set it to stay on for four hours instead of the two hour auto shutoff.  The coffee is great too.  Now, the downsides.  First, once again, you can't see how much coffee is left.  It's almost impossible.  Then, after only two months, the thing leaks!  We clean it regularly so that isn't the problem.  I will attempt to send it back and see how I make out.  I hope to update this when and if I receive a solution.

About 10 years ago I had bought 8 red Waechtersbach salad plates. Now, I thought it was time to replace a few of them, because the glazing showed signs of wear and tear. My old plates were made in Germany. I noticed that the Waechtersbach plates you can buy now are all made in China. I thought I give it a shot and ordered a set of 4 plates. They arrived well packed and on the day they were due to arrive.
The plates are of the same size and a slightly different color. This would have been acceptable. I don't like the quality though. The color is uneven at the rim, every plate in the box looked different, as if nobody had bothered with quality assurance. I will send the plates back to Amazon and even consider contacting Waechtersbach about this.
I am sorry to say I cannot recommend buying the plates.

Disappointed.  Some of the hardware doesn't fit (a screw to attach the clock to the bracket).  AND the bird calls are off.  I've worked to get the sounds to adjust to the correct bird to no avail.  There are instructions saying how to insert the batteries, and where the hands should be set when doing so, but after attempting several times, I give up.  Sorry, Mom... I will have to find you a different clock for your deck.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Could have bben the perfect gift, but....

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: The clock is beautiful and runs quietly.  However, the alarm is so loud it is startling.  The alarm volume cannot be adjusted.  I literally could not sleep because I was anticipating the clock alarm going off and trying to stop it ringing before I woke the whole house up.  Would be 5 star if the volume could be adjusted.

I purchased 2 sets, one for each daughter.  Within a year of purchasing, all the knives had rust spots on the cutting blades as well as spotting on the other surfaces of the knives.  They have never been put in a dishwasher, nor left sitting in water.  The scissors are not near as sharp as other, cheaper kitchen scissors I've purchased. Due to spotting/staining I would be embarrassed to have any guests use the steak knives.  Very disappointed, thought my children's  families would get years of use.

This item broke the first day I used it. Granted, I was using it to slice olives and not eggs but it didn't feel like it would last anyway. I purchased it over the others because it is made by a brand I trust but I wish I spent less on something more durable rather than something that looked nicer.

This clock looks great, and runs smoothly and silently.  The alarm isn't easy to set, and you can't set it to the exact time you want.  Or even the inexact time you want.  Sometimes this alarm goes off on time.  Sometimes it goes off 30 minutes early or late.  The alarm is not too loud and not too quiet.  But you can't trust it as far as you can throw it.  And you can probably throw this one a long way.

Full name on the box: Light Grey Bonded Leather/Mesh Air Executive Chair (Model: 43807)

This review is from a petite females perspective
I was browsing for couple months and this Serta chair stood out to me, mainly aesthetically. I don't see many chairs in this color or style. It matched with the rest of my PC/desk setup.

Positives
-Seat is comfortable.
-My back feels nicely supported. It helps me sit very straight.
-The casters were surprisingly easy to put in. I had to use some force with two of them though. They roll fine on carpet.
-Easy assembly

Neutral/Negatives
-Paint of armrests is easily scratched. I accidentally scratched it while installing the back.
-The black plastic caps used to hide the screws don't fit well. The plastic inserts for hiding screws in arms don't fit well either. It makes the chair appear cheap. (I will provide images)
-There is some indentation (mainly arms). Luckily not much damage I noticed besides some on the arms.
-Craftsmanship isn't the best.
-At lowest setting, my feet cant touch the ground but being 411 its to be expected.
-Seat back height is a little high for my liking/comfort.  I prefer couple inches shorter so I can sometimes rest my head back rather than getting blocked by the seat.
-Head area (or shoulder rest to some) is too firm. I prefer it to be squishy.
-Adjustable arm positioning? No, thats a false advertisement.
-Customization? There is barely any besides height. The left lever I believe supposed to adjust the chair tilt but maybe Im too light to notice any difference.

As another reviewer mentioned, don't forget to remove the foam or cardboard behind the lumbar and head/shoulder. That is supposedly the last step when assembly is all done.

**If you come across any issues/warranty, you contact TRUE INNOVATIONS, not Serta. (I will provide images)

I absolutely love this blanket. It is super comfortable but....it smells so strongly of bleach.  It gave me a headache. I have no idea why it would come smelling of bleach. I've washed it once already and it held up just fine in the delicate cycle but it still smells. I'm hoping one more wash will get it out.

I gave this mug 4 stars because even though it doesn't keep coffee warm very long and the clip broke after a while, it is still my wife's favorite.  I have purchased a few higher rated better performing more expensive travel mugs for her but she doesn't use them because she likes to clip this one to her bag so her hands are free.  For her, the clip makes the other shortcomings irrelevant. She has two of them and i recently purchased another one to replace one with a broken clip.

It really fits into our kitchen.  I didn't notice any dents in the box when it arrived, so I think the dent must have happened after I put it on the countertop - although, I can't figure out it might have happened.  The paint has cracked around the dent, but the dent is in the back and I still like it.  Just be sure not to knock it around.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: but the dent is in the back and I still like it. Just be sure not to knock it ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
Good thermometer. It is very easy to use and wash off. I've compared it with other, more expensive, thermometers and it seems to give an accurate reading. Like others have mentioned, the packaging could definitely be improved (very simple), but the product itself is good.

This product was provided at a discounted price in exchange for my honest review.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Good thermometer. It is very easy to use and ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: This is my first french press so I have nothing to directly compare this product too.  That said, this has french press coffee maker had been outstanding!  It has insulated walls (or at least airspace between the inside and out) and keeps the coffee hot for a while.  Unlike most french press coffee makers that I have seen, this one is not "see through".  I grind my own coffee and pour in hot water from my drip coffee maker (I just do hot water in my drip maker so my family can have tea/cocoa) and after 5 minutes, bam!, good coffee.  The taste seems more pronounced, maybe due to the oils that aren't stopped by a paper filter in a drip machine. You could also use a gold foil mesh in your drip machine.  I do think the temperature of  the water is more conducive to good coffee in the french press coffee maker, and has been great for my coffee needs.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Outstanding Cozyna French Press Coffee Maker

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
This product works great, but it is not for Indian Wheat rotis (Chapathi). I mom used to have long time ago when I was just a kid, that worked fine with Indian wheat rotis, But this one won't.

However, but for other rotis, this is just great, it reduced the time to almost less than half of what it used to take earlier.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Works great but not for Rotis

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
howdy y'all,

i've one of these already and i'm buying another today. so i _do_ like it. [*grin*] it's red and it's fairly easy to read. plus, it's RED!

the slight changes i would like are these ...

- a second hand

take care,
lee
