Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: I bought this popper for my husband as a birthday present. We have used it a couple of times and find that it works best if we place a handful of kernels in the popper. The kernels don't need to completely cover the bottom (take into account how much they poof up). Listen for the popping sounds to slow down like the directions say because every microwave is different. DO NOT place butter or margarine on top of the silicone cover before microwaving! It causes the popcorn to burn. We use spray butter after the popcorn has popped.

The dressers are great, but there is one small modification that I would recommend. There is a wooden beam across the front of the dresser (behind the drawer facings) that is held in by two pegs. The glue failed rather quickly on one of our dressers, and in truth I think it will eventually in all cases as glue just isn't effective forever. A small L bracket on each side (in the corner between the beam and inner side of the outer wall)  and some small wood screws will ensure that you don't ever have to worry about it. If you don't have a few laying around it's a cheap buy at the hardware store.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Good Dressers, Quick Tip to Improve Stability

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: This snowglobe is the correct size and color and lights up based on the description.  The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because the description says "new", yet the date stamp on the bottom is 2010 and over time and it has faded a bit.  Regardless, it is the most colorful and unique Las Vegas Globe that I have found.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Las Vegas Light Up Snow Globe

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
Filtrete's Water Pitcher, model WP02-WH-8 with the 8 cup capacity has a great slim design. It fits easily in the refrigerator allowing you to always have cold, fresh, filtered water on hand.  The filter fits in the top under a removable cover, allowing easy filling of the pitcher.

The filtered water tastes great.  I was impressed that the Filtrete Water Pitcher removed virtually all of the nasty-tasting elements from our city water supply (we're known for our nasty tasting water here, so that's really saying something).  Thanks to a great design, the filtering process doesn't take long at all.

I am supposed to drink a lot of water, and having this handy little pitcher really helps with that. The pitcher makes it easy to always have great tasting water on hand.

I had searched diligently for several months to find two pillow covers to coordinate with a table runner that I purchased from Crate and Barrel. These work perfectly!  The fabric has a soft, luxurious finish, and the 12" x 20" feather and down inserts that I purchased though Amazon work well. The layout of the designs on the rust, gold, gray, and cream side of each pillow complement each other; one pillow has a gold circular pattern offset on one side while the other has a gray circular pattern offset.  The layout of the designs on the dark brown, blue, green, and cream side are not complementary.  One pillow has a big, round design in the middle while the other has only half of a big, round design offset to one side. If I had been going to use the dark brown side of the pillows, I would have sent them back.

I ordered this unit as I have been looking for a white corner cabinet for my stereo system.  This model, the Homes Styles Bermuda Corner TV stand looked just right, as it matched the decor of the room.  Some of the reviewers here on amazon.com have commented that it takes too long to assemble.  Unpacking and assembly plus the additional work that I had to do took about 3 hours.  I have put together similar cabinets before and I was expecting it to take some time to complete it, so I allocated my time accordingly.  Cabinets like this don't just "pop" into place with the push of a button.  These things do take time and when you are working with MDF material you have to be careful as it can very easily chip.  There are many angles and corners so you have to make sure that each piece is straight and level before moving to the next step.  Don't tighten everything until the last step and make sure everything is square.  It really helps if you have someone to hold each section as you tighten the screws.  That being said, the assembly instructions are rather poor.  They consist of simple drawings, not pictures, without much of a written description as to how to proceed.

As others have commented, the cabinet pieces were packed very poorly and I agree.  Everything is crammed into one cardboard box with pieces of styrofoam for padding and tyvek like cloth to prevent scratches.  The cardboard box was rather thin considering the weight of the MDF pieces.  This should have been more securely packed using two boxes rather than one.  Three pieces were chipped; luckily the chips are on the back where they won't be seen! I had to redrill the hole for one door hinge as the predrilled holes were too high, not allowing the door to close without rubbing against the top. Also, the mounting point for the door magnet was broken so I had to glue it and wait for the glue to set overnight before I screwed on the hardware. Minus one star for poor packing.

In addition, I drilled two smaller holes in the back to allow for more cables and speaker wires to snake though (I am connecting to a surround sound receiver and using several analog cables).  I drilled holes on each side of the shelf to allow for better air flow as my receiver just fits in the space.  My receiver can tend to get hot if it is played loud for long periods of time.  I have a small box fan that I can use for those rare occasions.

I am a firm believer in the old adage "you get what you pay for". The amazon price was a good value compared to some other internet prices.  I knew from the moment I ordered it that this was not going to be fine furniture, but it does look really nice and it is being utilized as I intended with just a few modifications.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Beautiful and functional but not without its flaws.

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText: I'm satisfyed with this product for the price I've bought (about $4 for set). I've washed it once, it hasn't changed color and size.  Fabric became softer and it is very pleasant to sleep on. Color is just as I expected. Thanks Amazon for good quality products and possiility to buy it for great price sitting at home!
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Very good set for its price

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
almost perfect, except for one thing, the screws!! the silver screws stick out like a sore thumb when mounted on the wall, especially on the white washed finished we purchased. we spray painted the screws white to help blend. if the screws were finished the same way as the rest of the piece would be perfect.

The piece has 4 hooks that are fairly large, can hold thick spa towels, clothes, jewelry etc. very easy to mount on drywall, two screws are included with proper drywall mounts. mount is very sturdy with provided materials and construction of the piece is solid - heavy but not overly heavy. we use in our bathroom to hang towels.

Aesthetically pleasing and practical, but a little on the pricier side.  There are a few advantages to this toaster, such as the extra wide slots.  I can't tell how often I have stuck a thick bread or muffin in a regular sized toaster only to struggle to get the torn pieces out.  Not with this KitchenAid toaster, but the larger size comes at the cost of a little extra counter space.  And the high-lift lever further eases the task of removing bread/bagle/muffin.  If your other appliances are silver and you must have a matching toaster, the finish on this unit is more resistant to finger prints than stainless steel.  I use it to toast bread only, so I haven't had any negative experiences with muffins or bagels.  All in all, I'm pretty happy with this KitchenAid.

Recently purchased as a gift and the recipient has been very happily frothing away ever since. The materials used in construction appeared to be fairly light weight and flimsy, and I would be concerned about the longevity of the item, but so far I've not heard of any problems, so at this point I couldn't criticize on that account. All in all it's easy to use, affordable, and works as advertised very well indeed.

It does work pretty well, but after my roommate still told me she smelled it a little bit sometimes still. I came up with the idea of putting a short sock (just a normal woman's sock) over the vent end, and that little bit of extra filter seems to have done the trick as she hasn't complained one time since I added the sock. I am certain the Smoke Buddy does most of the work, but still just being able to stop the released air from blowing out helps. Perhaps they could slightly modify the air release in future versions. But I still recommend it, sock or no sock. :)

I was a little apprehensive after reading the reviews about the color swirls being almost nonexistent but I figured we could return them if needed. So happy I did! I have Prime and the packaging was superb as I had to open two additional boxes, plus bubble wrap and thick packing paper, just to get to the original ones the plates came in (they came 6/box). No chips or broken ones.

The plates did not disappoint. The blue color was exactly as I was hoping for (looks just like advertised). They are heavy weight and not that thin glass. They look and feel great!

The Cons: Each plate had a sticker in the middle which were hard to take off. It took some time to remove them all and most still had that clear sticky residue left. Scrubbing them and running them through the dishwasher worked to remove it. I would suggest the manufacturer to use more easily removed stickers or just not put them on every single one! The other issue I found (it has been mention in reviews) is that the bottom* only has a small raised surface and its kind of rounded so if you are having to cut your food, the added pressure of pushing down can causes the plate to tip slightly if you aren't directly in the middle of it. Now this isn't an issue if you are not needing to cut into thick/tough pieces of meat. I just will be using our other plates when we have steak!

* The second two pictures Im trying to show the bottom side of the plate.

Very happy with my purchase.
I loved the colors, the beige has a bit of olive green in it but it goes well with my dark laminate wood floors and my green color walls. The only thing was that the bed skirt was a bit small for my Californian king tempurpedic bed. It didn't fit perfectly but other than that, I love it.

Although the price is right the bags that I received are not the ones that are pictured.  They are a micro lined bag that do not have a closure as pictured.  There was no mention of a closure in the description so I was not expecting one but the picture is misleading.  That said the bags appear to be well made and definitely do the job so I have no plans to return the item.  Compared to the original Hoover brand bags they appear to be made from lighter weight material but also claim to be an allergen filter similar to the Hoover.  I would rate them a good value for the price.

My 3 year old uses this one, he loves it totally. This is the second time we bought thermos for him. Very useful in winters which keeps the warm water in same temperature for good 2-3 hours. Only problem is water leakage which happens if the flap is kept open. Yet to try for keeping liquids cold since I never bought this in winters 3-4 months back

my only complaint about this is that if there is a stray string on this fabric, pulling it by accident can fray and mess up the material easily.  So I worry about their longevity and what's going to happen when I want to clean them.  Otherwise, they look very nice, and I got them at a wonderful price.

Looks great, but nozzle fell of first one before much of the liquid soap had been used.  Amazon replaced with a second one at no cost to me.  The same thing has happed with the second one. I've stuck the nozzle back in, and are careful to push down from the back.  That seems to be working OK.  I'm going to try gluing the nozzle back in.  If that works I'll let you know.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Looks great, but nozzle fell of first one before much ...

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I haven't used this long enough or hard enough to address what appear to be durability problems with this and other steamers, but so far I'm sold. Deep cleans beautifully. The grout on the white tile floors of both bathrooms is clean again. My vinyl tile floors look really good. I've been motivated to wax after deep cleaning and it's as good as mom!

I'll update if I run into problems but for the moment I'm a happy girl.

Can't wait until Thanksgiving with this bad boy. I whipped it out when I got it and my wife gasped! Very sharp and nice handle too. Ordered a new sharpener to keep it and all my cutlery in shape. I gave it a 4 because only a Bob Kramer knife would get a 5 (and maybe a 6 or 7).

We had one of these when I was a kid. I was recently looking for a better and healthier way to pop popcorn (other than the unhealthy microwave bags, or the unreliable microwave poppers or the air poppers that create tasteless popcorn) and was pleased to find that this is still being made. Upon receiving it, I was disappointed to find that the bowl/cover was much flimsier than the old ones. Also the plastic cover over the butter receptacle did not hold as tightly as one might like. And I was disappointed that the stir rod was bent incorrectly at the factory, allowing one side of it to scrape quite severely on the cooking surface; if left like that the nonstick coating would have scraped off in no time. Luckily, it is made to come off and after fiddling with it for about 15-20 minutes, I was able to get it bent correctly so it just barely clears the cooking surface.

Having said that, it pops great. My first batch did not have a single unpopped kernel! Not all batches come out that great, but it has the best performance I have ever seen in a popper. And I have found some new ways to use my Stir Crazy:

If you want that true movie theater taste (though not terribly healthy), I would recommend the "Real Movie Theater" premeasured pouches from Wabash Valley Farms, especially the less oil, less salt version which actually tastes better and is not greasy like the regular version. Just snip open the pouch, and toss in the premeasured oil, corn and salt/seasoning and let 'er pop--you will get evenly salted and seasoned popcorn that tastes as good as any theater popcorn.

And believe it or not, you can make caramel popcorn (or even candy-coated popcorn) by using "Glaze-Pop"--this is what the theaters use. In three minutes you will have delicious caramel or candy-coated popcorn, I promise! You can find it for $4 a box or less on the web if you shop around. I am including instructions for use here, as the box only has instructions for commercial poppers: put in two tablespoons of oil, then add 2/3 cup of the Glaze Pop flavoring of your choice, then add 1/3 cup of (unpopped) popcorn. Let it pop just as if you were popping regular corn (do not add salt). If you want to pop more corn, adjust ingredient quantities upward accordingly. Cleanup is easy, just carefully wipe off the popper surface with a wad of paper towels before it cools; flavoring easily washes off the domed lid. Coverage will not be as even as if you spent an hour slaving over the stove making the caramel and stirring it into the popcorn, but every kernel will get enough flavoring so there no mistaking that you are eating caramel (or whatever flavor you chose) popcorn. My favorite flavors are the caramel, the chocolate (popcorn tastes like chocolate cereal) and the cinnamon. A note of caution, the food coloring used for red and especially the purple and blue flavors can easily stain whatever they come into contact with, even your fingers!

This is a great entryway solution for hanging daily gear on our bifold closet doors. The only problem is, that it swings side to side sometimes due to no being anchored on bottom/side like other over-door racks. Still pretty handy and holds plenty. Its well made. Admittedly wish it were longer because I"m 5'3" and I can only really reach the bottom 4 hooks.
Home_and_Kitchen.summary: Swings sideways, and holds a lot

Home_and_Kitchen.reviewText:
I don't normally write reviews about inexpensive housewares, but I fixed an issue with my unit that I think might help others with the same issue.  When the unit arrived, I was unable to get the alarm to work and the LED light wouldn't illuminate.  The unit ships with two cheap, off-brand AAA batteries already installed.  Most manufacturers will either keep the batteries separate or they'll place a thin piece of plastic between the battery terminals and the contacts to keep them from draining before sale, but not this company.  The display worked fine, even if it's pretty poor for off-angle viewing, but as I said the other key features didn't work.  I thought that perhaps the reason was that the unit was designed to reduce battery drain when the batteries are low by disabling those features and, by golly, I was right.  After installing a brand new set of Costco AAA batteries the alarm and LED worked fine.

So before you attempt a return on the product, change the batteries even if the unit is brand-new.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This is another quality item from Quest Nutrition.  There are few choices when it comes to chips for people who need to limit intake while also maximizing nutrition.  The protein to fat and carb balance is UNMATCHED!  These chips have become a regular part of my daily routine now for along time.  They are purchased in bulk on Amazon at the best prices available.

Cooks fast and my kids loved the themed shapes.  Great quick lunch when we have errands to run and I don't want to spend lots of money getting kids meals at the drive thru.  The instructions include pictures and are simple enough tot follow that my kindergartner and second grader can "cook" these without help.  Not quite the texture of the regular blue box of Kraft macaroni and cheese, its a little slimier...but still tastes like the original.

These work great! You have a better insertion than with a plastic applicator. They are easy to use and have good protection. A lot of people will think that it's messy, but it is not. They are discreet and small enough to hide if you don't want people seeing them. They are my new go-to. I received these free for my review.

I tried the variety pack to taste-test with family over the holidays.  My daughter talked me into trying Fuggedaboudit.  I don't normally like dark roasts because they all seem bitter to me, but Fuggedaboudit jolted me awake and was very smooth and tasty.  The Brooklyn Bridge blend reminds me of GM Nantucket - one of my favorites - but is a little stronger - still very smooth.  Maple Sleigh was also a pleasant surprise since I normally find flavored coffee's too sweet.  It had just a hint of maple syrup - not too sweet and no bad aftertaste.  I've ordered quite a few variety packs over the years, but this will be the first time I've re-ordered a full variety pack, rather than just cherry-picking a couple of favorites.

First I tried the French Vanilla flavor of Vega One but didn't really care for it. But this chocolate flavor tastes great! I only use a half scoop and mix it with almond milk, a banana, and a little cold water or ice. Great way to get some nutrients with a dessert taste.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Great way to get some nutrients with a dessert taste

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: IF U LOVE RAISINS THAN YOU KNOW HOW EXPENSIVE THEY CAN BE IN SUPERMARKETS. THIS IS THE WAY 2 GO. 4 LARGE BAGS FILLED WITH FRESH, MOIST SWEET RAISINS JUST BEGGING 2 BE ADDED 2 UR CEREAL, BAKING OR HEALTHY SNACKING RIGHT OUTTA THE BAG. THEY ARRIVED QUICKLY, IN PERFECT CONDITION + ALL HAVE FAR OFF EXPIRATION DATES! AND U JUST CANT BEAT THE PRICE! VERY HIGHLY RECOMMED!

I have used this for years as a rash powder. It is the best diaper rash treatment I have ever found and I have used all of the store bought as well as doctor prescribed treatments. Sprinkle some of this on baby's bottom (or farmer who has sat on a wet tractor seat all day) and it's better in no time flat.

This is a rich, full-bodied sauce with a great flavor. I'm not a drinker so am unsure what the vodka added, especially since I thought vodka was a flavorless alcohol. As you would expect the main flavor is tomatoes but it is not watery nor weak like many tomato based sauces. It was also not acidic but had a mild, creamy tomato flavor. The tang in this is entirely from the spices. A very nice blend.

Super-sensitive skin here, and this product is wonderful. I use the whole Burt's Bees Sensitive skin product line and have not had an issue with any of them. Very well made, no parabens, etc.  My face can be fine one day and a rash on it the next, just from something in the air.  I can use any of Burt's Sensitive skin products even if my face is broken, they are soothing.

WHAT A DIFFERENCE this product has made with my hair. My summer hair was a little frizzy and very dry. I was looking for a shampoo that would be gentle cleansing but also provide a lot of moisture and shine. I was looking for a miracle product to calm my summer hair. This product was intriguing because it offered so many moisturizing oils. I was a little skeptical because I thought it might provide too much oil and leave my hair feeling greasy more than anything. But that was the opposite of my experience. After just one washing, my hair was already starting to feel moisturized, softer, and was much more manageable to style. I do recommend getting the 3-step process of the shampoo, conditioner, and one of the extraordinary oil after-treatments. It's really the best way to see the greatest results. This post was sponsored by LOreal Paris Advanced Haircare as part of a sampling activation for Crowdtap. I received complimentary products to facilitate my review. I take reviewing products seriously and would never give 5 stars and a positive review to a product that I didn't believe in.

I love this cleanser, I was using a much more expensive cleanser before this and it was working but the price was really bothering me for something I am rinsing down the drain.  I use a clarisonic and I have dry/ combination skin very dry skin on my forhead and cheeks and large congested pores on my nose. I really wanted a soap free cleanser because I just love how my skin feels without using soap. I do however have a deeper cleanser I use about once a week before I use a face mask just to ensure I get any residue off my face and im starting fresh.

*scent- it is fragrance free which means no added fragrance the natural scent of this product isn't great but it isn't bad at all and it is very comforting to me for some reason. It isn't strong and it does not linger once you rinse it off you are good!
*cleansing ability- this cleans great without leaving your skin tight or dry. I use this in the morning with just my hands to wash off my night treatments and I love how soft my skin is after. I have another cleanser Im using up at night , however when I do use this at night it works Great with my clarisonic to give me a deeper clean. I use the burts bees makeup remover wipes first if I have makeup on.

*overall- it is a great soap free cleanser. Does not irritate my skin, I am absolutely in love with it! Will repurchase again and again! Also It helped clear up some tiny bumps I was getting on my forhead!

I 've had Rosacea on since my teenage years and spent 40+ years putting up with recurring outbreaks attributing it to stress. Well it is stress related but about 10 years ago during a routine appointment my Dr. took notice and identified it. There was a name for this? Who knew? She prescribed Metro gel which had a small effect but I found it ridiculously drying and sometimes irritating to my skin so I only used it if I had a bad outbreak. I found Prosacea  about 5 years ago at a Walgreens when shopping for something else. Intrigued I checked the ingredients. Sulpher. Then I remembered that sulpher is used in homeopathic medications as well as special soaps for acne. Bought it, tried it and it worked. Dramatically. Like "RIGHT NOW". I saw redness fade within 20 minutes at the notorious cheek to nose creases. You know the ones. The inflamed, tender, crusty, oily, complete strangers staring at you, the gentle inquiry of "What's wrong with your face?"
Prosacea says enough of that. Even the worst oubreak is clear in 24 hours. It works for me. I don't even have to use it every day for it to be effective. Problem solved? Not exactly. Rosacea is actually a very complex condition with many possible contributing factors. Stress, hygiene, diet, heat, strenuous activity, and alcohol can factor in. There is also solid research that microbial activity from fauna normally found on our skin can be a cause. There isn't a cure for Rosacea, by the way, it's a condition that can be managed quite well. Because it is affected by many different things it doesn't surprise me that some people respond well to Prosacea while some might not. By all means see a Dr. who knows something about Rosacea if you are still suffering. There may be other ways to approach your particular skin environment.
Prime_Pantry.summary: It works. Simple, direct application produces dramatic results for long time sufferer. That's me ladies and gentlemen.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I've made iced tea twice so far. I don't follow the directions for the tea, I just do my own thing and it comes out just fine. I add a little sweetener and ice cubes and it's delish. I just didn't realize how huge the tea bags are but if you want a pitcher full of tea this is the way to go. The tea is easy to make and it tastes good.

Great for use in our RV where a spill of liquid bleach would be a disaster.  We keep it in the storage area under the bed and don't worry about it tipping over.  Have used it several times, and it seems to contain just the right amount of bleach for the normal size machines in the RV parks.  Seems to dissolve as it should as well.  For home, I don't see the appeal, simple and cheaper to just pick up the liquid bleach bottle and pour it in the machine.  Love it for using in the RV though..
Prime_Pantry.summary: Using in our RV where a spill is a disaster.  Wouldn't bother at home though.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This works better than anything else I have tried and I have naturally wavy, frizzy fine hair.  I straighten my hair after blow drying and spray this on before using my flat iron. In the past I have used Hot off the Press by P.Mitchell which I didn't like the feel of on my hair and then a Garnier spray and was going to try the Tresemme Heat Tamer when this popped up as a suggestion. After reading the reviews I decided to purchase and found it was available locally at a store which I didn't have to wait for it to arrive.  It leaves hair soft and a great price!
Prime_Pantry.summary: This really works and is the best!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: These are my favorite macadamia nuts and they are hard to find especially online for a good price. I do think this is a good price, so I bought one the other day and it tasted horrible. I contacted amazon and they sent me a new one and it tasted soooo much better! So happy the second package was good because I love these(:
Prime_Pantry.summary: First package bad. Second one good!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I switched over to this detergent years ago when regular detergents started making my skin itch. This one gets my clothes nice and clean without any lingering smells and I my sensitive skin appreciates the switch. Most of our laundry isn't heavily soiled, but it does the get the dirt stains out of our toddler boys clothes.

I made these for my wheat-sensitive friend. I added a few extras to the mix....toasted pecans, dried cranberries. They turned out great. I was pleased at how they puffed up while baking. Some mixes turn out thin, uninteresting cookies. The mix made 3 dozen average sized cookies. I don't think anyone missed the wheat flour. No after-taste as in some gluten-free mixes.

If you have soap scum look no further. I have honestly tried no less than 10 product and only Bar Keepers Friend has worked as well. These scrub pads are really easy to use and I just bring one in the shower with me once or twice a week and it takes only a few minutes.

A great way to clean a surface, but without the harsh chemicals found in many other products! These are my go-to wipes for cleaning/sanitizing any surface. They work extremely well-better than most other similar products I have used. When the kids are doing their best to destroy the house, this product is a lifesaver. It has a somewhat pleasant smell-much better than the chemically smell of similar products that has a tendency to irritate lungs.
Prime_Pantry.summary: A great way to clean a surface

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: LOVE this product!! We are a family with allergies and can't say enough of this product. The product leaves clothes clean, fresh and soft. It doesn't matter which stage of product one uses, it's all the same. I like the bigger size for it lasts approx. 3 months. The larger size product is hard to find in big box stores.

This fish oil is great my wife and I both like it. The taste is better than most other fish oils because of the orange flavor I can hardly taste any fishiness. The pills are also ultra purified which removes a lot of unwanted ingredients. The IFSO rated the pills highly as well. I wish the pills were a little smaller they can be a little intimidating for some who does not take a lot of pills. I would recommend this product to anyone looking for fish oil, also sign up for subscribe and save and save your self some money at the same time.

I've come to prefer this version of Febreze because it has no scent at all.  I've read that many scented products use unhealthy chemicals and I want to avoid that.  I use the product in my bedroom, particularly on my down quilts that can't be washed, and have noticed far less of a problem getting a stuffy nose during the night, so the allergen inhibitor action must work.  Although I like a refreshing scent when I spray something, I'm learning that may not be the healthiest option and this version seems to help me.  I am pleased with this product and will rebuy.

My husband flipped out when he heard about these, and checked the store shelves incessantly. I was very happy to find them on Prime Pantry. They are his favorite now, and it's really nice to be able to find them quickly and easily. The toasty flavor is nice, unless you don't like toasty flavors. It is not a burnt taste, just nicely browned which helps bring out the cheesy flavor even more.

I use this in my water bottle all the time.  Taste great and my grandson age 5 calls it Nana tea.  He loves it.  Very refreshing.  I use half the amount in my water bottle with ice and shake it up.  Then add water as needed and it still taste great.  there are 5 tubes in the container.  worth the price.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Taste great and my grandson age 5 calls it Nana tea

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: Before using this product I thought my hair was beyond repair. A result of years of abuse. I tried deep conditioning, vitamins, coconut oil..tons of products.....you name it but it wasn't until I added Miracle to my regime that I saw real results. I'd like to keep it as a best little beauty secret ever but for what it did for me it deserves to be shared. If this review isn't convincing it's at least worth a try for the price.

I found recently that my usual vendor no longer supplies the 35 oz box of this cereal. What a sorry shame for that business! This cereal is a "staple" to my diet. It has a great taste and is HEALTHY for you. (no cardboard taste!) Nature's Path has put together a gem with this one.

I have two boys in sports, I do believe in sports drinks for this reason, especially in the heat.  These ready to make crystals are extremely cost effective, they can put scoops in their water bottles and go.  Not to mention they can adjust the scoops to their taste and required needs.  Perfect, thanks Gatorade for finally giving us an alternative to the ready made.

Wonderfully packaged. Super fast delivery. Item exactly as seller described. I hope to do business with this seller again! Thank You! I sent my nine & twelve year old grandsons a junk food package just for fun & of coarse they loved it! There really isn't much to review here, we've all had Keebler's  cookies & crackers, and know they are a wonderful, fresh, & a trustworthy brand. A terrific verity of flavors, peanut butter just happens to be my grandchildren's favorite. Actually, when I saw the pictures of them opening their package, I was a little jealous & wished I was with them. Or even that I'd sent myself a package! With eight different flavors of chips, Orange crush Pop Tarts, A&W Root Beer Pop Tarts, one hundred & five miniature candy bars in 4 flavors, Keebler Jif peanut butter cookies, & Mom's favorite (We have to keep her happy too), Lemon Cream Oreo's, there had to be something in there that made them all happy!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I really love these. The Kirkland brand from Costco is MUCH more affordable, but it hasn't been available for a long time now. Mauna Loa's macadamias are fresher tasting and I like them better than any others I have tried. The Kirkland are harder and drier, possibly from being roasted more. The smaller amount in these bags also means the macadamias are consumed when they are fresher. I've tried unroasted macadamias and though they may be healthier, I don't enjoy them nearly as much. If these were more economical, I'd probably be eating them every day.
Prime_Pantry.summary: I really love these. The Kirkland brand from Costco is MUCH ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
Long time cottonelle customer here.  These rolls are not big by any measure and are smaller than in brick and mortar stores and cost more money.  Perhaps the bulk of shipping warrants the higher price.

Loyal Amazon Customer here, but will not buy this product again via Amazon.

i wouldnt call this a great product. its not even good, but its a decent alternative to a carb i suppose. its edible, just very bland and i havnt quite found anything where its like oh yum, thank goodness we had those miracle noodles in there.
