Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
C/S means cut and sifted.  I mistook the amount of product, so it was much more than I needed.
However, I made a few nice mint waters, seeps some into an concentrated liquid for water or tea, and will give some to friends.
So far the amount of stems is noticeable in mine.  So far good flavor.

This product just tastes okay. I have had other strawberry fruit strips that tasted sweeter. Maybe its because this is all natural that it just tastes ok. The coloring is greyish, which is more indicative of actual natural strawberries. Nonetheless, I do think taste is important too.  Good product if you like healthy snacks that are not too sweet.

Tasty hot chocolate, but I don't think it tastes like Junior Mints. The mint flavor is very subtle, not like Junior Mints where you can really taste it. I was very excited about these but was disappointed that they don't taste very minty at all! And this is coming from somebody who can't stand altoids because they are too minty.

I used this product successfully for several years without any pregnancy scares. The downside is that it produces an unpleasant discharge that can last up until the next day. I don't know if that happens to everyone, but it happened to me every single time I used it. I finally decided to go back to the pill, as just the thought of dealing with the discharge was starting to dissuade me from using it.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Works as promised, but has potentially unpleasant side effects

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: When I saw onion powder, I thought "what do I do with this?"  Turns out I keep trying it in just about anything I might put onions in but don't feel like going through the process of chopping them.  The powder has a strong-ish onion smell which is good since that's what it should smell like.  Plain it has some onion-y taste, too.  My results with it have been a bit mixed.  In eggs it got lost among all the other things going on.  When I put the powder in mashed potatoes it borderline overpowered the other flavors I had mixed in.  It worked nicely in some beef-flavored ramen, though, to add a little depth.  I could see adding this to gravy to boost onion flavor, too.  But it's powder and it's kind of weird.  Not my favorite but I keep finding useful-ish things to do with it while cooking to boost onion flavor without the tears that come with the actual chopping of onions.

Good price but just be warned they will arrive having melted and reformed so when you open them chocolatey flakes from the coating are loose in wrapper and will be all over the place - not good if you eat these on the go or at work - as if they melt or rub into your clothing....!! Might be fine in the winter though, I've only bought in summer.

While a bit fancier than your run of the mill plastic party cup, there's no mistaking for the fact that it is still a plastic party cup. It holds 14 oz, enough for ice & a can of soda. They look a bit better than an el cheapo cup, but you'd have to care about such things.

The plastic is brittle, so it could break easily. You can wash them in the dishwasher - I did so without problem, but then why bother having a disposable cup? Finally, there is the price. I recently had a party for fourty guests. I would not pay the price for these cups vs the store brand since after all, they're all going into the trash can afterwards.

So in the end, it boils down to price and that's strictly a personal decision.

I'm almost 30 and still get occasional white heads, and have combination skin. I liked that this was mostly natural. Unfortunately, I am picky about how my skin feeels after I use cleansers. This pirticulat one leaves a film on my face, so I'll lightly scrub my face with a washcloth after using it. Other than that, it works fine. I usually use dermalogica but it's too expensive.

I have Celiac disease, and have found this to be the most "normal" tasting cereal. The peanut butter flavor is not too strong, and the puffs don't get soggy as fast as regular cereal. I was thrilled to see it offered on Amazon in bulk, only to see the price. I can buy this cereal off the shelf at my grocery store for under $5 a box. Here they're charging more than $8 per box, plus shipping.

If you're dealing with Celiac, this is a great tasting cereal that's doesn't have too much sugar. However, check out your local grocery and health food stores before paying these prices.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Cereal is great, the price is not

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
The scent is just okay, and I'm not sure how exfoliating simple sea salt really is.

It's additionally a bit too drying for my personal needs. A lot of (generally cheaper) body washes are that way for me, however. So I'm not sure if that's just the case here, or if it's maybe the sea salt that is causing the drying properties.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Scent is okay, probably too drying if you don't have naturally oily skin

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: These are convenient to have, as they come in a nice sturdy plastic container but they also are smaller than I'd like (almost half the size of normal wipes) and they dry easily. They are thick, which is good, but just too small and dry.

My fault for not looking in to this as much as I should have. Its mainly artificial sweetener and artificial flavor,milk powder, coconut oil,some cocoa powder,silicon,and preservatives.
 I wish they would have branded it Chocolate drink mix,or something like that,and it should be made more clear that it IS sweetened, its just labeled as no sugar added which is true,but deceptive.

purchased this variety bag for family. We are happy with the freshness and quality but not happy with the variety/equal amounts. There were actually 111 pieces in the bag, but 49 of those pieces were starburst candy. Most people want and expect chocolate and expect equal amounts of each of the 5 types of candies. Here is the break down for the bag we got. 49 starburst, 25 3 musketeers, 12 twix, 12 snickers, 13 M&Ms. Only one person in my family eats starburst. Most of my family wants twix, snickers, or M&Ms so this wasn't a very good bag for us. Feel like we are being ripped of with so much starburst being put in the bag. Expected a more equal amount of each type of candy.
Prime_Pantry.summary: great bag if you want starburst (almost of the bag). Not at all equal amounts

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
Damnit, I wanted to like this product much more. I have been trying to find a better cleaner for my kitchen to replace the big brand cleaners full of chemicals, and I've enjoyed other Seventh Generation products. This actually cleans really well. The kitchen counters feel cleaner (no residue) and look cleaner (again, no residue-causing streaks). But I just can't get past the smell. It claims to be lemongrass, but I don't smell that at all. More like a burnt, dried thyme herb...? I don't know what it is, but it's not pleasant to me, and it lingers. Really wish they'd come out with a lavender scent or something else. Real bummer.

The smell won't bother some people, and that's great. Just wish I was one of them.

If you can nuke this popcorn without burning it, it's pretty good. If even a couple pieces burn, the smell will drive you out of your house. And will hover for days. The fresh fumes hurt your eyes.
Pretty light on the caramel, just a dusting. But it's a reasonable substitute for the real McCoy.
Prime_Pantry.summary: it's pretty good. If even a couple pieces burn

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I had searched for a waterproof mascara when I purchased this. The mascara is fine but it is definitely NOT waterproof or even resistant!  It smears easily and is not easily removed. I usually love Covergirl but this mascara is not for this Florida weather, or me.
Prime_Pantry.summary: The mascara is fine but it is definitely NOT waterproof or even resistant

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I'm not a big shortbread lover and thought the chocolate chips would help.  The flavor was not bad and I think it is the texture of shortbread that bothers me most.  I was also expecting more cookies in the bag and it hard to tell by weight in the listing.  I would buy them again and dip in milk.

This was a tiny package, compared to other brands of granola about the same price. Taste was great, no doubt about that. Bob's Red Mill has quality products. Its beautifully packaged, with a pretty lavendar border, leading one to believe that there might just be blueberries in this container. Each morning as I poured a bowl of this granola, I eagerly searched for a blueberry. Just one. I at least wanted to see one blueberry going into my bowl, I would have settled for a half or one even. Alas, I gots nothin'. It was like the Cracker Jack box with no prize. How disapointing.

i was a little disappointed with this product i thought i was going to like the smell and i usually love method cleaners - i haven't noticed a difference in cleanliness in my shower, there are mold spots on my plastic curtain liner that would normally come off with a bleach based bathroom cleaner, and the scent is kind of salty (for lack of better description) definitely not minty... not sure i would purchase this product again.
Prime_Pantry.summary: don't like the scent, haven't noticed it working as a cleaner either.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: The price is great for the amount you get but I have come across some large clumps that would not come apart and had to be thrown out. However I would still purchase them again because of the price and the amount that was able to be used.

The review below is for: Planters Mixed Nuts, Unsalted, 10.3-Ounce... Somehow it is also posted under:
Planters NUT-rition Heart Healthy Mix,...(see my review for that product below)

 Planters Mixed Nuts, Unsalted, 10.3-Ounce: It says less than 50% peanuts. Well it must be 49.99%. The peanut taste overshadows the rest of the nut flavors.

Planters NUT-rition Heart Healthy Mix is great. I just wish it had cashews.

This coffee is very strong and even in its description it says A sophisticated full-bodied dark roast with bold, smoky, and bittersweet notes. A slightly bright well-balanced cup
I don't know about balance but it is bitter compared to most dark roasts I have tried and it leaves an intense after taste. I admit with some cream it provides the jolt to wake me up, but I prefer my coffee black, and this is just too strong for me to have it that way.

These tomatoes are FABULOUS and worth the extra cost.  My first shipment came in with no problems.  Unfortunately when my second one arrived 8 of the 12 cans were dented, two so badly that a can opener can't be used on one end.  I am hopeful that the sender will make it right.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Love the Product But Watch Out for Dented Cans

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: Hefty is a great bag. The price on Amazon.com Prime Pantry was great but I did not realize that I had chosen the "Pine Scented" version. I am not a fan. It smells like the "Pine Tree" scratch-n-sniff stickers from when I was a kid. It isn't overpowering enough to make me not  use them but I will not buy this scent again.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Not a fan of the pine scent

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This salmon jerky was good.  The flavor was good, but a bit salty for my taste.  I could not eat as much as I would have liked at each snack time.  If you like salmon and need a good protein snack, this would do the trick.  I used it for one of my protein snacks on the Fast Metabolism Diet and it is a good occasional snack.

It tastes great but I wish Amazon had more variety of the Dasani drops. When you see the flavor that you want the quantity is too much. Why can't each flavor just be sold individually? Why must I be forced to buy 5 bottles of a flavor that I've never tried before and don't know if I am going to like? And when they are not busy forcing you to buy more quantity than you need, they are busy forcing you to use Amazon Pantry when you may not need that many things! So now I just buy my Dasani flavors so from the grocery stores.
Prime_Pantry.summary: It tastes great but I wish Amazon had more variety of the ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: Like this tea and the Keurig concept but am probably going to stop using these since they are not biodegradable and our dumps are crowded enough with stuff like this.  If they come out with a better more friendly product I'll go back to them.  Back to tea bags and use the Keurig for the hot water.

My cats love this food. They  gobble it up and sometimes upchuck on the carpet. If you don't notice and clean right away it will stain your carpet. Otherwise I have no complaints other than the cats eat it very fast and I have to buy again. I wonder if that is because they like it or that it is not as nutritional as some of the other brands.

My daughter loves this soup. And I love that it is organic. However I recently realized that we can contains BPA in the lining.  Therefore, we are on the hunt for another organic soup that is not packaged and I can containing BPA or BPS. Great taste but I don't want to serve her organic soup with a splash of chemicals! Eliminating chemicals is the whole point behind spending the extra money for foods containing organic ingredients...
Prime_Pantry.summary: And I love that it is organic

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
This product did not work at all!  I noticed right away that I had ZERO tooth sensitivity, which seemed odd.  I just finished 10 treatments and there has been no noticeable whitening.  I also noticed the negative reviews seem to be dated May 2015-August 2015.  I am wondering if maybe there was a bad batch of product.

I contacted Crest and am happy with the good customer service I received.  I would not recommend getting this product on Amazon.  It has worked amazingly when I have purchased it through the drug store, but this time I saw no results.

Not only did it take forever to receive, but when it arrived the cans had leaked and the smell of sour milk was revolting.  It stunk up the porch, the house and now I have to smell it for two days in my outdoor trash container before its picked up in two days.  Disgusting !!!

Ill leave a simple review here:
Product is rated very well on Envirnmental Working Group's skincare guide for cosmetics.
Cleans pretty well, but the after taste is simply bad.
Not a clean after taste. Had to return it.
Happier with Toms Wicked Fresh Spearment Ice, a fresher cleaner taste left behind.

It's hard to believe the people giving this five stars are even reviewing the same product. I tried these on both my smartphone and computer screens, and they left milky white streaks everywhere (despite the prominent "no residue, streak-free shine" promise on the packaging). How this ever got out of the lab and onto store shelves is beyond me. Do not buy.

Did not taste like the Fiji water that I previously bought from the stores.

Update 3/30: I measured the water ph today and it turns out to be 7.0(plain water). This confirms that the Fiji water is not as advertised with low ph. The only reason Fiji water brands itself is because of the ph and have failed me.

All I tasted was a cheap subtle maple flavor that's it. No bacon flavor at all. Sure theres the cheap "bacon bit" look on the frosting but the bacon flavor or lack there of doesn't come through at all. I'll stick to maple bacon donuts.

This soap is so messy that it is not worth using. It may smell nice, but good grief! If you set it down, gets all over the sink area and countertop! I threw it away and don't know what to do with the other two bars. I would hate to give it to anybody...

Unfortunately, thought the picture shows a pistachio and pecan front and center, the jar is almost totally almonds and cashews. There are a few pecans, pistachios, and Brazil nuts in the mix, but not enough to justify the price. I highly suggest if you want pecans in your mix, then buy a can of Planters cashews, a can of Blue Diamond almonds, and a can of Planters roasted and salted pecans. You won't get any Brazil nuts or pistachios, but maybe you can find those at a nut seller in your local mall. I'm not much of a fan of almonds, but I tried a little pack of Blue Diamond almonds the other day and was blow away at how much of a pure almond flavor they have. By comparison, the almonds in the Planters Deluxe Mixed Nuts are hardly distinguishable from the cashews.  Do they cook them all together, or do they just transfer their flavors to each other once they are packed? I don't know, but compared to the almonds sold separately, there is no comparison. It used to be that there were actually pecans and Brazil nuts (along with hazelnuts) in the old pack, and the mix looked more like the picture. Planters has lost me now. The price has gone up and the quality has gone down. I ordered some pecans from a seller in Georgia and they arrived in two days, at a low cost, and they taste like pecans. They are in my freezer now, and I roast some every now and then when I want the real thing. Too bad.
Prime_Pantry.summary: All almonds and cashews -- and the flavor is second rate

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
The product arrived on time. No problem with the package.
Only two of the 20 strips worked and stuck fine. The others were falling off my teeth and causing too much trouble staying in place. After 20 days of struggle, I didn't really see much difference. Needless to say, the great pain and sensitivity I had . Sorry to say, I am extremely disappointed.

There's a first time for everything.  I always order Scott toilet paper.  It is very hard for me to believe that this is actually a Scott product.  The rolls are much smaller than expected and...wait for it...they have a strong scent.  Ugh!  I decided to try to use them, put them in the bathroom closet, and was stunned to find that the entire bathroom ended up smelling from the tp.  I took the rolls out, put them in the guest bath closet.  Same problem - the tp smelled up the bathroom and the adjoining guest bedroom. Their final resting place was in the trash can in the garage.  Bottom line:  low prices are nice, but this time it was NOT worth it.  Yuk.

I think most people with digestive issues don't need an extra burst of lactose.  I suppose I should have read the label, but milk does not belong in a "GOOD" probiotic.  I went from OK to bad taking this product.  Thankful for Amazon's return policy.

I did not buy this from Amazon but I feel compelled to warn others about the potential for allergic reaction from the sulfates in this product. I'm a healthy person with very minor allergy issues but 6 years ago they started getting much worse. I even started suffering from mild asthma! The only other time I had mild asthma was after drinking red wine which a found out contains sulfates so LONG story short, I stopped using ReaLemon and...voila!  My allergy problems disappeared in about two weeks. Hallelujah!!!!

The tea is great. But it gets 1 star for rip-off pricing. I just bought a box of 12 at Safeway (9/12) and paid $6.99. That would make 24 cost $14 and they want to charge $20???????? This is simply outrageous. I got on-line to find a discount on quantity and found this out-of-line pricing instead. For $1 more than they want to charge, I can get 36! The tea itself is very good tho' it does leave some aftertaste of the spices. I do like it and plan on buying more, at Safeway.

BUYER BEWARE!  The "New Formula" is terrible; notice it does not say "Improved."  I've loved Quantum since it hit the market.  It cleaned wonderfully.  This new formula left a brown residue on my dishwasher that I had to scrub off with baking soda; I called to complain, threw out that box and they sent coupons. I tried a new box of the "new formula."  And a few washes later I noticed that there was an awful brown film on my dishes.  I tried scrubbing it out with baking soda; letting scrubbing bubbles sit on them; and soaking them in vinegar.  Nothing will remove the film completely.  So now my creamy ivory dishes are mottled almond and look very dirty.  I called to complain, and they suggested I add rinse-aid. When I said the rinse-aid is built into the pack, they said well it can help with the film.  I said I will not buy rinse-aid for an expensive product that shows it already has rinse-aid in it; and rinse-aid is a preventative; it will not remove the film that is now on my dishes.  So they offered coupons; what?  Needless to say, I am throwing this box away and will never use this product again.  I've washed my dishes in the dishwasher for 20 years, with and without rinse-aid, and they have never had a nasty brown film left on them.

This soap smells like gasoline. And, it dissolves into a gloppy mess even with normal use. I make my own soap, so I know how to position a soft bar of soap to help it dry out between uses, but this one is not holding up. That, along with the putrid smell, has led to just toss them out.
Prime_Pantry.summary: This soap smells like gasoline. And

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I am a fairly sophisticated cook x 50 years and make almost everything from scratch.  However, in the interest of time, sometimes I need to use commercial chicken broth.  I wouldn't feed this to a dog.  It has a strange taste that doesn't resemble chicken broth.  I typically use Swanson's, but our store has switched to Pacific.  Even if you add a little more salt, the taste does not improve.  I made two batches of my lemon chicken soup - one with Swanson's broth and the other Pacific.  The soup made with the Pacific broth was almost unedible because the taste was so bad.  It is mind boggling that people give this 5 stars.  DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY !
Prime_Pantry.summary: SERIOUSLY - THIS HARDLEY DESERVES ONE STAR

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: Smells like paint doesn't tast much better. I was only able to drink after I added ice to water down and added some sugar. (I don't usually care for sugary  protein drinks ). Normally I make my own shakes with ON gold but thought this would be convenient to take to work. It was a mistake.

When we saw this in a local supermarket, we were excited to try it.  So much so, we made it that very night.  First let me say that I don't know why this is called "sesame" as there wasn't even a hint of sesame flavor.  It was just blah.  I could have thrown random seasonings together from the cabinet and come up with something better. Very disappointing.

Campbell's Chunky Healthy Request Chicken Corn Chowder, 18.8 Ounce About the Product The product was not described as I received it. The description clearly states (pack of twelve 18.8 ounce cans) but I only received one can. I just spent 5 bucks on a can of soup, good soup, but one can of 5 dollar soup is not something I would have ever purchased at this point in my life. Pack of twelve 18.8 Ounce cans of soup (total of 225.6 Ounces) Made with lean meat, hearty vegetables and heart healthy Good source of protein, fiber and vitamin a, low cholesterol, no trans fat Easy open pull tab Product of the USA
Prime_Pantry.summary: Not as advertised! Pack of 12? Try, pack of 1!!!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
Okay, I know it's a gamble ordering something like taco shells online. My complaint it more than receiving taco shell crumbs, my shells although not expired were all molded.
So I revive my package, check the date all is well, three days later go to make dinner and bam  furry, green, taco shell crumb confetti. GROSS!!! Super disappointed.

One star is a generous reward. My sweet 1 year old German Shepherd puppy developed a horrendous chemical rash from this collar. I am appalled and infuriated this would happen. Its bleeding and crusty and terrible and hes in pain. He seems to have developed a fever as well. DO NOT BUY THIS JUNK. BUYER BEWARE IT IS POISON. SO ANGRY.
Prime_Pantry.summary: My sweet 1 year old German Shepherd puppy developed a horrendous ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I have to admit that I didn't read any review for this item, but I believed that a sponge is a sponge, wrong! This one will melt in your hands and disappear in annoying crumbs, I'm not sure for what they are ment, bit I can't find any use for something of such low quality!!!

I have sworn by Pampers since my first child 6 years ago. I am so sad to say that I am completely disappointed with the "redesign". My daughters  (6 & 5) rarely had any leaks in either their Swaddlers or their Cruisers. I expected the same thing when I bought diapers for my son. While Swaddlers were up to par, this first, and last box of Cruisers (I already cancelled my subscription) left us feeling wet. Literally. The fit of the diapers is terrible. And we've had a leak almost everyday. Not night, day. I've been reading the other reviews, and I can see the general consensus is that these diapers blow(out).
Dear Pampers, please do not respond to tell me that you've made great changes and improvements to  these diapers. You haven't. You tried to fix something that wasn't broken. I have no interest in calling to hear how you've made them better. I think this is one of those times to say, "Sorry guys, we goofed! We'll bring back the diapers you know and love!"

I wish I could give it zero stars. Whoever thinks this smells like a lemon, needs help. This is the most disgusting, repulsive, overwhelming, stinky cleaner I ever had the displeasure of using. I can't think of anything that smells this bad. Cat urine maybe? It's also weak and doesn't cut grease, just smears dirt around. Compared to Fantastik or generic "green degreaser" this is like slightly soapy water. Awful product in every respect. I had to air the entire apartment out after using this stuff for only few minutes. Poured the whole thing down the toilet. Yuck.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Whoever thinks this smells like a lemon

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
I bought this and used it in one machine, poured enough amount.... the result, the same regular laundry smell.
Next load, I pour more, the result? no change.
Finally I just got fed up with it and poured A LOT, I mean I almost finished more than half the bottle in 3 regular loads
and the clothes just smell slightly as they usually do!

Don't waste your money.

Husband brought this home to make dinner with. When I tasted it I asked him if he had watered it down somehow because all I could taste was cooked chicken and the rice we were eating it with--I didn't taste the sauce in the slightest. Luckily my husband will eat just about anything no matter how it tastes. I wouldn't buy this again.

God awful globs of dry, flavorless mush that turn to glue in your mouth!  I tried giving them to my dog and after the first one even she wouldn't eat them so I took them to work thinking, surely out of a building of over 150 people there had to be at least one vegan who would take them.  Most people wouldn't even try them and the few adventurous folks who did were in agreement with me that they were horrible (most even spit them out into the trash can) so they ended up getting thrown away.

Misleading Title at the web page. Read the fine print before ordering. I thought I was purchasing Dry Roasted Peanuts with Pure Sea salt, which I  have been purchasing from the grocery store, ingredients: dry roasted peanuts, sea salt. The product that I received had a label which had sea salt also contained other ingredients including celery salt, onion paprika, corn syrup etc. There is nothing wrong with these ingredients; however, the listing should read Planters Dry Roasted Seasoned Peanuts. I am sugar restricted, so I should have read the label rather than trust the header however, Amazon's stellar Customer Service quickly resolved the issue.

I recently was getting low on diapers and found these diapers at a good deal. I couldn't remember why I didn't like them so I thought I would give them another try. I was soon reminded of why and returned them. I had to suffer with the pack that was opened because I needed diapers. These diapers do NOT hold up on a moving toddler. My poor child kept grabbing his front area so I checked it out. His diaper was pretty much coming off. I thought maybe it was his pants were causing it so I changed him and left his clothes off. Not even 5 minutes later it happened again! When he bends over you can see a nice plummer crack too. I would of hated for him to have a mess poop!

Photos show how the diaper kept coming down in the front and a comparison with the Pampers Cruisers (on right in photo) to the Huggies Little Movers diaper (on left in photo) that have an elastic back that forms to your child.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Was quickly reminded of why I disliked these...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
Normally I wouldn't buy something like this, I would just go to my dentist and have my teeth whittened.  A friend a mine was using crest whitestrips and I noticed a huge difference on her teeth so I decided to try it.  I bought it when it had the $10 off coupon so I paid about $30 for the pack, ended up buying 2 packs one for the hubby and 1 for me.

So the whitestrips work it totally does, but it seems to make a more dramatic difference on me then my hubby.  Not sure the reason why but for $30 it did more than what it had to do. It's totally worth the $ and it works.

I would totally recommend this product!

I have always praised Progresso Soups in the past and I will do it again.  This particular one was a very good value on Prime Pantry as well as being low in calories and quite appealing to the taste buds.  What else could you want in a soup or any food for that matter.  Another thing that I love about Progresso Soups is the great variety that they offer, and unlike other brands, they all do not taste the same.  Each has a distinctly different taste.  Prime Pantry still needs to find a way to ship them without damaging the cans so badly.  Other than that, I highly recommend the soup and the supplier.
Prime_Pantry.summary: I have always praised Progresso Soups

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I really like the silhouette and never know they're not panties. I do wish the L/XL had the same amount in each package as the S/M. After wearing one for a few hours it gives off an odor you think is coming from your body but is actually the Depends. It would be great if it was designed to not smell.
Prime_Pantry.summary: You still feel as though you're wearing panties.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I hate protein shakes and almost refuse to try hardly any of them. With that being said, this isn't too bad. Sure the after taste is like any other protein shake but the initial taste is tolerable. And the can makes it convenient to keep in the fridge at work and isn't gritty like the powder shakes.

Mmmmm coffee! The best in this is definitely the french vanilla. The others just taste the same as one another (caramel and hazelnut). The coffee cools super fast and thickens after that if it sits too long so drink your coffee quickly, don't be lazy.
Prime_Pantry.summary: dont be lazy,  drink your coffee

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
Haven't tried it yet, so I can't give it a real review until later. Just wanted to post this for anyone who was worried about the lack of seal. This arrived today, but when I unscrewed the cap, it was just the open lotion with no seal to peel off. I called St. Ives customer service and they said the product description doesn't mention it having a safety seal, and that this is normal for this moisturizer - it just comes off the shelf brand new that way. So even though it doesn't have a seal, that doesn't mean it's been opened or used before.

But just trust your own judgement - if it looks 1/4th empty then someone probably used it, returned it and it got resold, which is really gross. Mine is full, about 1cm from the top and still has a nice swirl like a tub of whipped cream, so I trust it. So far I took just one star off for the smell, but will still give it a chance (most lotions have a common scent that really bothers me so take that with a grain of salt). If you're sensitive to smells, it might bother you. Still looking forward to trying it though!
Prime_Pantry.summary: This moisturizer isn't supposed to come with a safety seal

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This product does what it says. Heats up on application to face (in my case, even when dry). Each packet contains .25oz, I only apply it around my nose and forehead and was able to make one packet last 3 days. It leaves my skin feeling clean and soft and is quite easy to wash off. Although, I have NOT seen any improvement in my skin (pores, blackheads, acne). Regardless, I will finish off the box and add to this if I notice any changes.

I enjoy these chips. I got these instead of my usual jalapeno ones from the same company for a bit of flavor change. I think those are better but only slightly, like the jalapenos there is a great amount of flavor without being too overpowering. The small bag size prevents you from overeating as with a larger bag.

I feel bad, a little, taking off a star. But we switched to this to test an allergy theory.  (it wasn't the old detergent)  The scented detergents get you used to expecting a "clean" scent after something is washed.  The scent-free of this is usually good - until you are washing something that smells bad (think towels that mildewed or workout clothes from the locker)  Even washed in the hottest water allowed for the longest time, there will still be a hint of the original stink, or at the least the absence of smell you normally get.
So either the scented detergents cover the fact that certain items aren't 100% clean, or the Free & Gentle is too gentle and doesn't really get the hard to wash stuff clean in one cycle.  That said, we are still using this as our main detergent, we just also have a backup detergent that's made for things like sweaty workout clothes.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Like it for 90% of the laundry, just not the really dirty stuff.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: These have done a pretty good job.  I was worried because I have sensitive teeth and when using whitestrips in the past I would get shooting nerve pain. I did not experience any issues with these whitestrips!  They have gotten my teeth whiter but not as white as I'd like. I think I will get another box of these and do a second round.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Did a pretty good job for the price!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This is not my main face wash as it doesn't have a lot of soap. Not sure if that is the right word. It's mostly scrubby. I use Paula's Choice, which I love, and layer this into my PC face wash twice a week. It helps to exfoliate little dry bumps. I have been using this specific St Ives for 15 years or so off and on. On it's own it never got rid of my blemishes. Used as a once or twice a week scrub it has helped keep my skin smooth. I would not recommend it if you have sensitive skin. Also, kudos to St Ives for not using plastic beads!
Prime_Pantry.summary: A good staple for your skin care routine

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
I'm the kind of person who asks for mild salsa at a Mexican restaurant and complains that it's too spicy. So, the biggest question for me on this trail mix was "how spicy is it?" The answer is, kind of spicy, but manageable. It rides right on the "too spicy" line, but doesn't quite step over. For me, it was just a touch too spicy to get an "I love it." However, in every other aspect, this is a fantastic trail mix. The ingredients are fresh, great quality and the blend of sweet and spicy is almost perfect.

I shared some of the trail mix with a few friends and they universally loved it. Two asked where they could buy it.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Just a bit too spicy for the most sensitive snackers, but otherwise a fantastic sweet and spicy trail mix

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I have been a coffee drinker for at least the past 30 years. First off I must say the K-cup made my life easier since I do not have to make an entire pot anymore. Now I do not like my coffee too weak and do not like it so strong that is almost taste burnt either. I generally go for a medium blend. Having said that, not all medium roast coffee brands are something I would buy again. I bought some off here before that tasted like it was soaked in old socks. When I tried my first cup of this Brooklyn Bridge, I was pleasantly surprised at the smooth taste. I cannot say it is the best cup of coffee I have ever tasted, but I would buy it again. To be fair, I must state I drink my coffee with cream and sugar but even those of us who do that still can tell when a coffee is not good and this product passed my test. On a side note about the K-cups, they are 20 times the prices as buying a bag of coffee and brewing it yourself, but this is one of the rare times I pay for convenience. All my reviews are genuine and I paid full price for the product.
Prime_Pantry.summary: A nice smooth cup of Joe

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: This is very tasty. The reason that it's not five-star is because this package has two 5 ounce servings, which is a little over a half cup, for each person. Perhaps it's for a side or first course, rather than an entree as I served it. I will buy this again.

These things work AMAZINGLY! I live in the country with really hard water that made me constantly have to clean my toilet to get the hard water stains off it. I put one of these on and it lasts a solid 2-3 weeks and keeps it clean and white.

The reason for the loss of a star is that the Ocean Breeze smell is REALLY strong. I ordered the normal scented ones and they're 1000 times better.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Great! but the smell is strong

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I love blackberry anything!  And in general, I like cranberry juices that contain other fruits (i.e. cranberry raspberry, cranberry apple, etc) because they are sweet, but still a bit tangy, which makes them feel really refreshing.  This was definitely still the case for this drink.  I also really appreciate the fact that each can contains a serving worth of fruits and veggies, because I always have a hard time consuming enough veggies, and I wouldn't have even guessed this drink contained them.  I was a bit concerned that I wouldn't be able to tolerate it when I read that sweet potatoes were one of the first ingredients (aka there's a greater quantity of it) because I can't stand sweet potatoes.  But I went ahead and tried it, and was pleasantly surprised that I didn't really taste them.  I really like that these contain a natural source of energy in the form of green tea because I could use more energy right now--it's finals week!--but I'm wary of drinking most energy drinks.  I don't know for sure whether it did much for me in this area.  I did feel more awake, but I didn't feel radically different.  Also, green tea is good for your health in general and it promotes weight loss, both of which are pluses for me.  The drink is a red-purple color, so be very careful if you drink it near carpet or upholstered furniture because it will probably stain them.  I like the overall design of this product, it tastes nice, the packaging is attractive, and the cans look like part of their design is hand-drawn, which is kind of neat.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Tastes good.  Great alternative to most energy drinks.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: Smart food is a smart choice. It's a good snack. It's really doesn't taste like much,  just a hint of salt.  It has that bagged popcorn taste and feel.  It's not bad,  just not as good as fresh air popped popcorn.  Nice little snack alternative for the kids though.

Not a bad coffee at all. I'm more fond of more mild roasts, but as a medium roast this is alright. Not too strong or bitter, but still a bold enough taste to distinguish it from the lighter roasts. I'd call it a straight-up, "regular" coffee comparable to what you'd get in most diners. The package comes with 40 K-Cups, which is a pretty good value, and they work fine in my Keurig. No leaks or failed cups so far, and every cup has turned out as I'd like.

Great product for top load washers and I continued to use when I got my front load washer, but followed the directions to put the pod in the barrel directly and started getting residue in the washer barrel.  Even running multiple cycles with machine cleaner didn't get rid of it.  When I stopped using the pods in the barrel it cleared away that same wash load.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Don't use in front load washer

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
We have been using various "natural" peanut butters for years, switching as soon as we learned about the dangers of partially hydrogenated oils. "Natural" is the industry code word for no hydrogenated oils, and we always look for it because even "reduced fat" peanut butters have hydrogenated oils if they're not labeled "natural."  We've tried so many brands over the years, including Skippy which tends to have slightly more saturated fat than other natural blends.

As a family we tend to prefer the more boutique brand, Peanut Butter & Co. Among the basic go-to brands, we agree that Jif Natural has a more robust roasted peanut taste. This Skippy seems a little bland by comparison, although it has that same classic Skippy taste, meaning we detected no real difference taste-wise between this natural version and the regular (hydrogenated oils) version. Per a two tablespoon serving, Skippy Natural has 3.5 grams of saturated fat (other brands have 2.5 or 3 roughly), and 3 grams of sugar. We found that the Skippy Natural with Honey (5 grams of sugar) tastes better all around.

Skippy Natural may never be our absolute favorite peanut butter brand, though it does offer a recognizably pleasing peanut taste, no hydrogenated oils, and a good value compared to more boutique natural brands. If your family is thinking about going "natural," at least with peanut butter, Skippy is worth a shot.
Prime_Pantry.summary: No hydrogenated oils, good peanut taste

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: I can't eat dairy or gluten and it is very difficult to find an edible power bar. These are one of the better ones. In the variety pack I like the peanut chocolate chip ones the best. My son really likes the lemon ones. The texture isn't grainy, but they are a little seedy. I also really like that these don't cost as much as other bars I buy.

It is a very good brand, made in Germany, which is under another name called Bubchen. Bubchen is much more expensive and takes forever to arrive. I am glad i found it at Target, which is just the same price here my son has eczema and his doctor was worried anything with fragrance. but so far this wash has been ok for him.

the only thing i don't like about it is, it is very diluted. every time my daughter squeezes the bottle, it comes out too much. While Bubchen's is very very thick, you can use one pea size to wash your whole body, which lasts much longer.
Prime_Pantry.summary: just a little too diluted but very good product

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
These are great for just trying to freshen up your face in between washes. I have pretty oily skin so through out the day it's nice to be able to use one and get rid of that yucky feeling and the shine. It's probably not the greatest thing out there for make up removal but I typically don't wear too much make up so it works for me (eyeliner, mascara, dark eye shadows I'd probably go a different route).
Also if you're looking for something to help with acne, like i said it'll help when using it between washes, but this alone won't help. I tried to get lazy with my routine and  that didn't last long.
Prime_Pantry.summary: These are great for just trying to freshen up your face in ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: These are still the best priduct out there but I like the old pink ones better. They had a better more controlled fit. I do not care for the dark colors during summer months. The darks for winter are ok. This product now seems to be just like the flex fit.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Good but not as good as it use to be.

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
It's tea - it has caffein, wakes me up in the morning, tastes great, works in my Keurig - so that's good for me.
Maybe a little pricey, but I knew that going in, and love not having to do complicated manual dexterity thinks like trying to open tea packets, or measure out loose leaf.  It's a little concession to my fumble-fingers-in-the-morning to have K Cup coffee.
But this Twinnings tastes great!

I have drank Maxwell House coffee for a long time. It's a staple in my family and relatives. The breakfast blend is smooth and light, but doesn't taste like flavored dishwater as some other brands. I'm not a gourmet coffee drinker. I stick to tried and true. Maxwell House doesn't disappoint.

My girlfriend and I made this mix and made one batch the way the box says to just with egg, vanilla, and butter. Well we used egg replacer because she is vegan. First batch came out gritty like other reviews I've read and tasted good but the texture just wasn't right. They were completely falling apart. The second batch we made we added soy milk to make the dough more like a regular cookie dough consistency, and they came out so much better! I'd recommend this mix if you add milk or soy milk to it.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Really good if you add soy milk!

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: These work but be careful. Start with only using half to begin with. Also, taking it right before a workout made me nauseas. Drink it slowly if you can take the taste. The taste makes you want to down it quickly. But that can upset your tummy.

This is a nice bag of nuts. I like that it has sea salt, which has a more subtle flavor than regular salt. These are roasted (not raw) nuts and the nut quality is nice  the Brazil nuts in particular are super nice quality and flavorful. Service size is  cup, and measure in at about 180 cals per serving. These make a good afternoon snack.

There are a lot of peanuts in this, fyi, so you really get only a smattering of the other nuts. I'm okay with this but with other brands equally weight the nut ratios. I think the overweighting of the peanuts is what makes this more affordable than other brands.

It comes in a ziplock, stand-up bag, which makes it easy to store upright in a cabinet.

Very nice.

Recommend.

I don't really like these as much as the cascade pods. I feel like all they did was pour some liquid detergent i to little packs and sealed them up. I like the cascade ones with multiple soaps in the one pod. My dishes are clean though, so if you pay less than something else it might be worth it but I don't love them
Prime_Pantry.summary: I don't really like these as much as the cascade pods

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
I purchased this because I was craving that chocolaty milk to drink when you've eaten the cereal out of it, just like I bought so often for my kids when they were young.

I was sorry I did. The company has apparently gradually decreased the amount of chocolate flavor until it's no longer there. Those who have eaten Cocoa Krispies all along may have not noticed, but for someone who hasn't eaten them since the early 1980s it is painfully obvious. Not only is there no chocolate in the milk the cereal sits in, the milk is hardly even "dirty" looking, much less chocolate. I couldn't even taste a bit of chocolate flavor in the cereal itself. I won't be ever purchasing this again.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Company has apparently gradually decreased the amount of chocolate flavor until it's no longer there

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: When my 7 year old was in diapers Huggies used to be the best diapers.  Now with my 21 month old Huggies brand just keeps getting worse and worse.  They don't hold the moisture in at all anymore.  2 hours and he needs a fresh diaper.  i would expect more from the expensive diapers.  Thinking about switching to a different brand
Prime_Pantry.summary: ... old was in diapers Huggies used to be the best diapers. Now with my 21 month old Huggies ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
I decided to try a scientific experiment.  I applied the strips to my upper teeth only, leaving the lowers untouched as a control.  After applying all 40 strips, one per day in the prescribed manner, to just my upper teeth, I compared uppers to lowers.  I could see no whitening effect whatever.  My teeth are old but sound.  No pain but also no gain.

  I wonder if much of the improvement people report is imaginary.  It would be easy to see what one hopes to see, unless photographic records are kept or a controlled experiment such as mine is carried out.

For the price you have to use a lot of soap it's kind of one of those cheaper soaps I'd pass on this and just get something a little higher quality. It's great for people who like to constantly use soap but the price really doesn't allow it compared to Walmart.
Prime_Pantry.summary: It's great for people who like to constantly use soap but ...

Prime_Pantry.reviewText:
For some strange reason I can't receive the order with SEA SALT.  Happened 2 times now.

Probley going to Wal Mart from now on for my nuts.

And maybe just a quirk where I live. Real Hot Arizona desert.  The nuts don't have the same taste and crunch as when I purchase from Wal Mart. Air conditioned store etc.

I think maybe the nuts maybe getting over heated during shipment here waiting on delivery etc.

The foil tops are almost bulging out from the can when you open.

Not as good as the reviews stated. For some reason, there has been an increase in the consumption of testosterone boosters. I did not feel a difference in any positive effects within the two weeks of consuming the supplement. There are negative side effects though such as increased irritability and decrease in patience. Would not recommend when it comes to buying a supplement.
Prime_Pantry.summary: Not as good as the reviews stated

Prime_Pantry.reviewText: The product is ok, the problem is the cans. I think only 1 of them was actually un-crushed, bent or dinged. While the price is right since theses in the store are priced at $3 something or higher, can't beat the bulk cost, but seriously the cans look like they bounced out of the delivery truck and onto my porch, which I am starting to wonder if it was the delivery drive or that's why they are selling them so cheap....Plus the picture isn't what you get either, so be aware of that, there is a slight variation in the product.

The crackers and everything else are... OK.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: The main problem with this product is that it is overpriced and completely unnecessary. Lip exfoliation is one of the simplest, most inexpensive beauty routines one can engage in at home because it only requires two basic ingredients that virtually every household has on hand: sugar and oil. Specifically, all that is required to exfoliate the lips is a tiny amount of granular sugar, either white table sugar (sucrose as in this product), brown sugar, raw sugar, or sugar alcohol such as xylitol. Add to that an equal amount of any food-grade oil you have on hand in the house, for example: olive oil, canola oil, safflower oil, or coconut oil. One-fourth teaspoon each of granular sugar and oil is enough to do both lips. The instructions for do-it-yourself exfoliation are as follows: In a small bowl or saucer, measure out one-fourth teaspoon of granular sugar. On top of it put an equal amount of oil. Wash your hands and dry them thoroughly. Blend the sugar and oil together with the tip of your finger. Rub the sugar-oil mixture onto your lips in a circular motion for two-five minutes. Gently scrub off the mixture with a clean, damp washcloth to remove not only the sugar and oil, but any loosened, dead skin. If flaking, dead skin still remains on your lips, rub more of the sugar-oil mixture onto your lips and repeat the above process. After you are finished, immediately moisturize your lips, ideally with a natural, food-grade oil or a lip balm made with an oil-beeswax mixture, since anything that goes on the lips ultimately ends up in the mouth and stomach. The second problem with this product is that even though the container looks small, there is enough of this product to last a very long time. And while it is sitting on your bathroom shelf, it is slowly drying out. Within six months to a year, long before you've used more than a fraction of it, this product will deteriorate into a hard, unusable lump (not to mention that most cosmetics companies recommend throwing out their products anyway within six to nine months because of inevitable bacteria buildup). If you make your own sugar-oil mixture each time you need it, nothing is wasted, and it is always fresh, with a smooth, viscous consistency that glides onto your lips. The third problem with this product is that, though some of the ingredients are natural and food-grade, others are not. The ingredients for this product include: "Sucrose, Petrolatum, Flavor, Caramel, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, VitiVinifera (Grape) Seed Oil." Below is a description of each ingredient. The most problematic one is petrolatum. It is too bad that the makers of this product didn't just stick to grapeseed oil, which is a natural, healthy oil. Sucrose is simple white/table sugar. Petrolatum: This lab-derived substance has been around since 1859 when chemist Robert Chesebrough developed a method of purifying a black gel that clogged oil rigs called "rod wax." This is a very thick substance which is anything but ideal for exfoliating the skin. Flavor: It is not specified whether this is "artificial" or "natural" flavor. Artificial flavor is derived from non-food substances, that is, chemicals created in a lab. Natural flavor is derived from a real food, but the process by which it is derived is unexplained. In both cases, there is no way to know how safe or healthy the flavoring is. Caramel: This is sugar or syrup heated until it turns brown. It can either be used as a coloring agent or to impart flavor. Jojoba oil is a natural plant oil. It is created from the liquid wax of the seed of the jojoba plant, a shrub which is native to southern Arizona, southern California, and northwestern Mexico. It's much healthier than petrolatum, but it contains 14% erucic acid, which is not recommended to be taken internally. Grapeseed oil is a natural oil derived from the seeds of grape. It contains vitamin E and antioxidants.
