Luxury_Beauty.summary: It's a pretty bottle, although rather small

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I ORDERED THIS DIFFUSER TO GO ALONG WITH THE T3 ION GENERATOR HAIR DRYER (FEATHERWEIGHT LUXE 2i) WHICH I ORDERED AT THE SAME TIME, AS SUGGESTED BY THE LINE AT THE BOTTOM OF THE HAIRDRYER DESCRIPTION - THE ONE ABOUT OTHERS PURCHASING SUGGESTED ITEMS TO GO ALONG WITH WHAT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING.  GREAT I THOUGHT.  ONLY PROBLEM WAS THAT THE DIFFUSER DID NOT FIT THAT DRYER!!!
IN ADDITION, THE SUPPLIER TO AMAZON WAS NOT AN AUTHORIZED DEALER OF T3 PRODUCTS!!
BUT AMAZON IS A FIRST-RATE BUSINESS & WHEN I EXPLAINED THE PROBLEM THEY EVENPAID FOR THE SHIPPING COSTS TO RETURN THE ITEM.
WELL DONE AMAZON!!!

I'm really sorry to leave a negative review for this product as it started out so promising. The first two weeks of use soothed my dry under eye area but within that second week my eyes started reacting negatively to the balm. It took me several days to realize that the balm was triggering the severe tearing and itching under my eyes and on my eyelids. After I stopped using the balm, it took days for the reaction to clear up. I did research on the product ingredients and discovered that some people may experience an allergic reaction to calendula which is obviously what happened to me. If you are sure you don't have a ragweed allergy (which is similar to calendula) then you most probably would be able to use this product.

I tried this set of products for three weeks without seeing any result. The products did not leave my hair as fluffy and full of body as my regular shampoo so I stoppped using it. My sister, however, has had good results with finding new growth. I gave my pack to her. The instruction booklet indicated that this orange pack is for people who have experience definite hair loss and I did not. I was using it in hopes of having thicker hair. The booklet said there is a different pack for that. Try to get more information before ordering.

Did not look natural. When sprinkled on, the powder made spots on my scalp and did not distribute evenly. When I ran my fingers through my hair or scratched my head, I ended up with powder under my fingernails and on my hands that looked like dirt. Perhaps lighter shades would work better or on people with skin color closer to hair color. I have light-med skin and very dark hair (I ordered the dark brown powder). I ended up returning this product for a refund and decided I'll just live with my hair the way it is.

I have very fine hair but I have lots of it.  I have tried multiple times to find a dry shampoo that will work on my fine hair that has to be washed every day.  I did my research and chose to try the Klorane Dry Shampoo.  Unfortunately it left me with the same heavy product build-up as all the other products I had tried.  This may work for people with thicker hair but it did nothing for my fine hair except make it feel heavy and sticky.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Not made for my fine hair

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I haven't even purchased this product, but I'm already disappointed after having read the list of ingredients.  Sure, it doesn't have certain things IN IT, but the first two main ingredients are volatile organic compounds that are 'natural', AND aren't safe for you to absorb through your skin on a continual basis.  Shame on LondonTown for not getting this right for the consumer.  Let The Buyer Beware....

Glad I ordered the smaller size to sample. The smell was light and nice, but the beach spray in an aerosol just didn't work. I've tried many beach sprays and knew that Oribe was a luxury brand so wanted to try it. It shoots out in big bursts of spray, which means it won't last long. It didn't give me beach waves at all. I had better luck with $5.00 Beach Spray.

I have been using the zirh shaving cream for 3 years, and the old formula was amazing as many of the reviews state. I tried the new formula, and you simply cannot compare it to the previous blue cream like formula. I am looking for a replacement product and am yet to find something as good as the previous zirh. I hope they will bringn back the old formula at some point as it really was the best shaving cream out there.

There are three main possible problems with this eye area: puffiness, dark circles and wrinkles.  I don't have puffiness or wrinkles, but I do have dark circles.  A dermatologist told me dark circles were mostly genetic and there's really nothing you can do about them (even surgery isn't very effective) except apply concealer.

This serum doesn't do anything for them either.  I can feel it's tingly, and tightening, so if I had puffiness or wrinkles, I think it would make a difference.  However, I think my dermatologist is correct about the dark circles.  I think I'll just have to live with them!

I have very sensitive skin (Eczema) and this works pretty well.

I didn't immediately realize this was marketed towards men when I received it, but it still works well for me. I would definitely say that this soap can be gender neutral :) It smells good, and it is a generous size. It also lathers pretty well.

It does seem a bit pricey for one bar of soap, but the price is not too far off from other comparable speciality soaps.

Tried these out today finally. They had a bit of a scent but it wasn't unpleasant at all. The directions said 10 to 15 minutes to leave it on, I settled for 12 for an in-between. I was a bit worried when it didn't get quite as stiff as other pore strips I've used, however, it ended up working really well, if not better, than others I've tried (though, for the record, I haven't tried too many. Mostly Biore). It got rid of more blackheads than the other strips I've used, leaving me shocked in just how many I actually had and didn't know. I would totally order these again in the future because they really do a fantastic job. My nose has a funny little tingle now, but it's a nice feeling, since it makes me feel like it really did a good job cleaning out my pores.
My only minor complaint was that they did leave a white residue behind on the lower parts of my nose by the tip, but nothing that can't be washed off after.

Edit, after buying a second package: I knocked my rating down to four stars. The second package I bought had charcoal added as an ingredient, which in itself wasn't a big deal because I knew it was a popular trend now. However, I don't know if the charcoal affects the strip or not, but I've noticed with these that the outer portion of the strip becomes very sticky when applying it (no matter how much I dry my hands first) and you can see the material sticking to your fingers. It wouldn't be a big deal but it does make me question the effectiveness now, and it does prevent me from sticking it to my nose properly because I don't want to end up pulling all the goo off. I might buy a third box at some point to see if I just got a dud box, but I would not buy a forth if it continues.

Update: I had used the sponge that came in the compact before my last review. I noticed the package suggests a kabuki brush. Giving it one more shot, I sort of buffed a lot less powder into my cheeks using little circles. The coverage was way better and I didn't get the weird crepe skin on my forehead. This pressed base works better than I initially thought and I up my review to 4 stars. It just takes some gentle buffing and light amounts of product. Im willing to admit when Im wrong.
Original review:
Im in my late 30s and have mild aging on my face. Mostly fine lines with a couple stress wrinkles on my forehead. This base covered the two acne spots I have, but completely made my lines and wrinkles worse. It even made part of my temples look like crepe skin!!! Around my eyes looked 10 years older.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Update: I was wrong. Previous review: Ok coverage, but accentuates lines and wrinkles

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
Get it? Blows.
Anyway- this hair dryer is VERY quiet. I was skeptical that it would do the job because on top of it being quiet, it doesn't seem to blow very hard or be very warm (on the warm setting it feels a little on the cool side).  I wouldn't call this the BEST hair dyer I've ever owned but it does the job.

As an obsessive flosser and Glide afficiando (sp?), I ordered this hoping for the whitening aspect. I wouldn't say  it does that much but I was amazed at how it's rougher texture seems to do a better job flossing. My teeth are very tight so I thought it would shred or break- nary a problem there and it does a great job.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Not all floss is created equal.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
This mascara is waterproof, but with some warm water, very easy to wash off your face. Especially if you follow up with some make-up remover aftewards to get off any excess. It's interesting to see these "tubes" come off your lashes in the sink.

My only complaint is that the mascara is a little "heavy" and i have to curl them before I use this mascara. I also find that the liquid causes some bunching of the lashes. I think if i had a little lash comb it would be better.

Overall great product and does what it says.

I was very skeptical of this toner at first. It felt like water on my skin. I didn't get the same stripping 'alcohol' effect that I was used to from other toners. I didn't think it was working. I had the typical T-zone, mostly oily, but dry in patches. After 4 weeks of Obagi, I do feel like my skin is more balanced. Now, there's no dry patches or oily spots. My skin feels less stressed, if that makes sense. Definitely, it is feeling more natural. It is a very gradual change, so you have to be patient. My only negative is the relatively high price tag. But you get what you pay for.

This iconic brand has been around for over 50 years. It was founded by a Romanian-born skin care specialist.

Moisture Magnet SPF 15 sun screen provides moderate sun protection in the form of a facial moisturizer. It is a light textured, pink lotion that comes in a no frills 2 ounce plastic squeeze bottle. The lotion has a light floral fragrance.

It smooths on easily and absorbs into the skin quickly. My face felt moisturized and soft many hours after application. I was able to apply foundation over the lotion and I had no problem with peeling or stickiness. The texture was dewy and comfortable.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Moderate Sun Protection, Good Facial Moisturizer

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I have only been using this product for one week but I like the cooling gel that is dispensed by the rubber applicator.  It spurts the right amount of product under your eyes.  So far, no major improvement but in a month if I see one I will do an update review.  It is lovely to take care of that area as it wrinkles so easily.  I smile too much having cause the lines and wrinkles and crinkles around my eyes and this product refreshes all that.

Worth a good try.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: ... been using this product for one week but I like the cooling gel that is dispensed by the rubber ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
The shampoo is great!  Truly great.  It feels moisturizing and a little goes a long way.  It gets foamy, and I feel like it's doing a great job.  It smells nice, too.

However, the conditioner - eh.  I have to use A LOT of it just to get some sense that it's moisturizing my hair.  I feel like as soon as I put it on the hair, it gets absorbed into the hair, and the hair feels dry (in the shower).  It's a little weird.  Then, as I towel-dry my hair, my hair feels unconditioned.  It's almost like they should just add some olive oil to their formula, or something.  A conditioner needs to feel a little balmy.  This one is just bone-dry.  I won't be buying it again.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Shampoo is great!  Conditioner is not so good.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: The spray gets everywhere and it comes out so cold that it "smokes". But I'm glad this product exists because it does a great job of covering my scalp in the front where my hair has thinned. The first time I did a continuous spray per the instructions but the hairline looked fake and as though I had a leftover stain from a bad dye job. The second time I sprayed in spurts and it looks more natural, plus it gives a good volume boost that I didn't expect. I'd recommend it but spray naked, before you put on your make up, maybe even put some removable tape on your forehead to mask the mess. Otherwise try the powder. I'm also not sure what kind of poison I'm introducing into my body through the scalp with this stuff, will do some research...

Hate the fact is has dyes but LOVE the fact is has literally replaced my entire skin care routine -- I used to have uncontrollable combination skin.  Half of my face felt like the Sahara and the other half was a pit stop at the Daytona 500, no matter whether I was wearing make up or not.  Most beauty items I had tried failed on me or made me breakout with in a day.  A friend suggested I may have sensitive skin, and that this brand may work.  She raved about the pimple reducer, which we joked about reminded us of calamine from when we were children. She went on to tell me about how their products are great but can be hit or miss.  So I took a risk, well, if you call $7.00 a risk.

And what a great risk that was.

Now my daily skincare routine takes me five minutes, tops.  At the bathroom sink I exfoliate oil and blackhead prone areas (without water!) Garnier Charcoal, sweep my face with a soaking konjac sponge (depending on the time of day I'll use a different color), then liberally spray this. All over my face.  In two ample circles.  And in a downwards angle.  I do this entire routine two to four times a day.  After two days my blackheads were gone.  After a week, my skin looked like porcelain.

Needless to say, this new routine has made a marked difference in my skin -- and how I feel in the skin I'm in.  I simpay cannot get over how well it has worked!!  My face feels like fine paper to the touch, and I am obsessed with how it smells.  I even use it in my hair as suggested.

It works well, smells amazing, has mostly great benefits ... but the ingredients..... please find better colorants.  It was literally the first thing I noticed as soon as I received it :( I work at a printing company so I understand how formulas change and ingredients can be difficult to source (I won't even mention last year's vanilla isolate incident...) but last I checked you CAN relabel products such as this.

Overall 4/5 because this stuff changed my life.  Lost a star because .... colorants.

I have very sensitive skin, so I have to be careful what types of products I use, especially on my face.  This eye serum/lotion did not irritate my skin at all.  It has a nice subtle scent-it smells fresh with a touch of floral.  It comes out the consistency of a thin lotion and spreads on leaving a silky sheen and feel on the surface of the skin.  A little bit goes a long way-a pea-sized amount provided full coverage for both eye areas (under eyes, to the sides, and on the lids).

I noticed results within the first 2 days of using this.  I have dark circles with faint crows feet on the under/sides of my eyes.  I applied this first at night and when I woke up, the circles were more smooth and less dark by about a shade.  By the second day, the skin around my eyes, where the faint crows feet were, the skin looked fuller and you could barely see the lines.  The improvements continued for 3-5 days and have since plateaued at a nice place-firm skin around the eyes and very minimal circles.

I am not sure how long these results will last when I stop using this cream, but it really does work.  The reason I gave it 4/5 stars is the price-it is currently listed at $125 per 0.5 oz. container.  I do like it, however, I just can't see spending that kind of money regularly especially given this is only for the eyes, it's not designed to even be used on the the other parts of your face.

Overall, it works great, and in this case, it should b/c you may have to sell your first born child to purchase it regularly-however, this stuff will make you look so young no one would believe you've had kids anyway, so there you go ;)
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Works as promised, but a bit rich for my blood....

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: This is my second Hot Tools- 2 inch curling iron and although it is good, it is not as good as the prior one.  The pros are it heats fast, and has the large barrel which is hard to find.  The cons are the cord gets tangled quite a bit more than the earlier model and I find that this one tends to produce static in my hair.  I have used this one for 1 month now and the static is getting somewhat better so hopefully after some time that will cease to be an issue.  Overall it is a great buy -- good quality and good pricing.  I would recommend to anyone looking for a large iron.

The only product I've tried so far that helps get rid of my spots of acne and pimples. I usually apply it as soon as I see/feel a pimple growing and when I do, the redness lightens/goes away by the next day (application is executed at night before bed). The package took awhile to arrive (the shipment would go in the opposite direction of the destination point) so that was a little annoying to observe but it arrived in the end.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: The package took awhile to arrive (the shipment would go in the opposite direction of the destination point) so that was a littl

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I love a sparkly face, ever since I discovered glitter as a child I will continue to wear make-up that dresses me up in illumination!

Japonesque luminescent highlighter is divine, lightweight, easy to apply and you will not end up looking like a 7 year old that just found a stash of glue and glitter and went nuts.

I applied my primer as usual, and combined my regular liquid foundation with a tiny squirt of this. It really does highlight without being whorish.

I also used it just on my eyelids with some mascara and it brightened up my eyes.

This product worked wonders for me as I get very pale in winter, and because I have iron deficiency my skin begins to look pasty and a little translucent. After using this gradual tanner for 2 days I already saw myself getting a brownish tinge to my skin and a lot of my skin imperfections were masked! After using it for about a week I looked like I already had a base tan. Though this isn't like the instant bronzy tanners that give you instant dark results, I liked it because it gave me a more natural transition to a light brown (so my friends wouldn't notice that I was using a fake tanner). I loved that it only took 3 minutes to work in the shower. However, you do have to make sure not to let any drips of water run down your legs because I did get a few minor stains from the product while I was trying to figure out how to use it. The only con to this is that you have to stand in the shower for 3 minutes (it gets pretty cold standing there wet!) but altogether this was a fast and easy way to bring some color into my skin.

Decent clarifying shampoo.  Not as strong as Neutrogena clarifying shampoo and others of that ilk, so I used it as a normal shampoo.  Smells pleasant enough.

I have repurchased and would purchase again, but want to try others.  Aren't we always looking for the perfect shampoo?  I don't know about you, but I haven't found the perfect shampoo yet.

It won't change your life, but it will do the job.  No complaints on this one.

I am coming off of a 2 week vacation in full sun so I am as tan as I will ever get in life. I thought this would be fun to try. Unfortunately I am still too pale for most of it. The compact has a nice large mirror. You will need your own brushes and sponges for application. The Sun Shadow color was the only one of the 3 colors I could use for contouring. The Sun Kissed/Sun Baked were too brown or orange-y for my skin. The real keeper for me us the gold highlight pen which is terrific at getting the effects I want. I love it.

I intend to swap out colors that don't work for me with others I buy from the clutch collection. That will make this a one stop shop for my daily makeup.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Lovely compact, mostly too dark for me. You can customize with other colors.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I'm really impressed I love the orange concealer it's easy to blend out without turning out to be an Ompaloompa. And it has a protective lid to cover the cream concealer so the fallout from the powders don't get on them. That part I was really happy to see that they thought a head and put that into their product packing so it great for the price
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I'm really impressed I love the orange concealer it's easy to blend out without ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: My wife says this device is effective, easy to use, and easy to hold.  When I asked about mess she said it's no more messy than any other method as long as you plan for it.  In the past she's used files, stones, and other callus removers but was willing to try one of the electronic pedicure appliances.  She says this is the best of all the methods she's used.  She also indicated it's not *too* bad to clean and is "quiet enough" for her purposes.  Overall, she's pleased with the appliance which means I now have to plan for replacement rollers.  Not knowing how long a set of rollers will last coupled with the high cost of replacement rollers (on Amazon only from marketplace vendors they are currently about the price of the device) is why I gave this device 4 stars.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Easy to use - but expensive replacement rollers

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I watched how to line my lips and then apply to my whole lips af few times before before I bought it. I was excited to receive it today. I tried the liner around my lips and then filling in both top and lower lip and it was barely showing a darker version of my own lips.

It looked so buttery on the girls that were sellin git to me! Bah humbug. My lips showed all the dryness so I applied my lip gloss over top and that helped. I didn't really see the liner color through my sheer gloss though and by the time dinner was over, I had nothing left on my lips. I will keep trying to see that I'm doing wrong. I loved ti on the QVC selling ladies!

This pomade is excellent especially if you have unruly hair. It is pricey however you only need to use a small amount so this will last you a long time. So the price does even out in the long run. And also if you do not wash your hair every day then the next day you still have good looking hair. It leaves your hair looking good and gives it a natural shine. However only use a small amount do not use a lot.

The smell and the consistency is nice.

My wife loves this gel-like product. This product feels light to the skin and non-greasy and absorbs almost immediately. After a couple of weeks of consistent use, my wife exclaims that this is such as super awesome product for her skin as she says that her fine lines are not visible anymore. Only complain is that the container - pump side falls apart quite easily.

This has been my eye cream for going on six years and I highly recommend it.  It takes about a month of twice daily applicaton to see a difference in the dark circles and fine lines but once you've got your baseline, the maintenance is easy.  I had forgotten how well it worked when I abruptly stopped using it while I had to undergo some surgery (hysterectomy)and found the dark circles reemerging after a couple weeks... Obviously it's a cumlative effect that you must keep us with.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I've Used This Product For Years.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I have been using this eye cream for years. It is not heavy and I put it on after I use the DDF Moisturizing Dew. When I have not used it, I do notice the skin under my eyes does get more dry wrinkles but it does not "help" with my dark circles or anything....but it does not claim to anyway. The only "bad" thing about it is the price, however, you only need a very very small amount for both eyes.

One of my recent samples has been Mario Badescu Skin Care Products. I started off with the Almond and Honey Face Scrub which was a pretty gentle scrub. It smells AWESOME, I am a big fan of the sweet almond scent! I give this scent 5 stars :-) I scrubbed it onto my moistened face and rinsed it off, it left my skin feeling very clean and soft. I then applied some of the Seaweed Cleansing Lotion (toner) it smelled pretty plain and earthy. The Seaweed scent was just ok, but it left my skin feeling clean and tight. Next I applied a small amount of the Ceramide Herbal Eye Cream. It smells like a non-scented lotion. This was just ok. I then massaged the Hyaluronic Moisturizer (SPF 15) into my face and neck which also smells like a non-scented lotion. It went on light, its not really thick, which I liked. Out of all these products I loved the Almond and Honey Scrub & the rest of the products were just ok.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I like the way it makes my skin tight

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
Im a fan of the Jack Black brand. I was skeptical of trying this deodorant because of the price & because Degree has been my deodorant brand for a while now. Ill go over my pros & cons, but the summary is I really liked it, but I felt the amount in the bottle is very little.

The pros:
- I think the smell is awesome. Its a clean & manly smell, but its not overbearing. Its not a in your face smell. I got a few compliments from how it smelled on me.
- all day wetness & odor protection
- didn't stain clothes
- applied clean. No clumpy or gooey feeling that you would get with a stick or gel.

Cons
- I really only have one con but, in my opinion, its a big one. This deodorant is $18 & I didn't feel the bottle lasted me very long. I went through it right away.

I'm still unsure, I got a sample of this before i bough the whole bottle, and I've been wearing it everyday. it's just a tiny bit on the sweet Victoria Secret side. Not totally my thing, but I like it enough, and it does smell really, really good. It's just that whole VC cheap girl thing I'm not so sure of.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: It's ok. But everyone's taste is different.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Love this little straightener. It was a lot smaller in person than I imagined beforehand, but it did not lack in quality. I purchased this straightener to throw in my carry on bag when I went to Orlando earlier this summer. My hair is pretty thick and naturally frizzy and wavy, but more frizzy than anything. It didn't take very long at all for it to heat up and be ready to work. It worked relatively quickly and for the most part held the temperature. Only a few instances I had to leave the room and come back in order to let it reheat a bit. Not only was it a quick tool to use, and a space saver, but it managed to keep my hair almost as straight as when I first straightened it through multiple days of Disney world adventures. This was huge to me, seeing as the slightest bit of humidity and my hair goes bananas. Great investment if you need a small, travel-friendly straightener that will get the job done.

I have very oily acne prone skin and being a 16 year old girl teenager doesn't make it an easier. I've been struggling with acne for about 4 years now and this product has cleared my skin up completely. It has done such a great of a job that I don't even have to wear foundation to school anymore because of how comfortable I am in my own skin now.  This product is an angel!

I bought this for my fianc so I picked his brain to write this review. He says he really liked this product because it holds throughout the entire day and washes out easily in the shower. He also really liked that it didn't take much product to accomplish the look he wanted, even in his thicker coarse hair. He often has a problem with gel that needs to be applied thickly and then doesn't wash out of his hair, so he was glad to find this gel.

Even though he really liked this gel, he now uses another product only because he is trying to achieve a different look with his hair now. This one was a hard hold, so it gave his hair a slicked back look. He did say that if he wanted the slicked back look again, he would definitely buy this again.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: He says he really liked this product because it holds throughout the entire day ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I am a beauty product addict. Price doesnt matter to me, Ill try anything, and have tried an insane number of all things potion and lotion. My fave hair serum is $5. My fave face cream is $200. I mention this only because I want to be clear that I am not attracted to only higher end lines.

That said, I tend to have frizzy hair on the top layer. But as a mom who doesnt enjoy spending hours getting ready in the morning, and one who simply cant even spend more than 45 minutes weekdays (if Im lucky), I always struggle with this. I also don't want to use a flat iron every day, because my hair is starting to get fried from it and hair color.

I stumbled on this shampoo and conditioner searching for products with a more natural lean, although I know some people have issues with some ingredients here. My hair is basically frizz free right as it dries thanks to this, and a little bit of my fave hair serum, and its almost perfect (its only ever "perfect" when I flat iron!). Soemtimes I don't even use the serum, and its still great.

The conditioner also has really helped with damaged ends.

I have literally been on a retinol for 30 years!! I remember back when :) I was put on retin-A for acne and remained on that prescription for many, many years which has really helped my acne, particularly when I experienced cystic acne. My acne has since gotten much better but I remain on a retinol for its anti-aging benefits. I find this product to be very good. There are different levels so if you have not used a retinol you may want to step down and use the .25 or .50 and work your way up. I find I have very little redness or irritation with this, which can be a problem for retinoids in general. There are lots of retinol products on the market anymore but I think for the price point and quality of this particular one you simply can't beat it.

 I am 46 years old and people tell me everyday that I don't have a single wrinkle on my face. I attribute that to long term retinol use.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: My acne has since gotten much better but I remain on a retinol for its anti-aging ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I was given my first tube and liked it so much I'm buying it now and have actually 'subscribed' for delivery every 2 months.  I'm 64 and have the usual complexion issues associated with being a senior; dark[er] under-eye circles, bags and a few age spots.  The Pur Minerals Disappearing Ink Concealer 4-in-1 is wonderful for hiding EVERYTHING completely without caking or settling into fine lines.  It is creamy and feels like it's moisturizing while hiding any issues we may find.  I absolutely love this product and recommend it whole-heartedly to any senior ladies looking for a great fix!

I have  been using Borghese Fango Active Mud for face and body for about 30 years - and I LOVE it.  I have a very bad skin disease (hidradenitis suppurativa), and this mud has been miraculous on numerous occasions - when antibiotics and steroids would not work.  You can only leave it on your face for 15 minutes or so (try it out).  But you can leave it on your body all day and all night.  It seems to act as a poultice - drawing out all the toxins.  When I see my dermatologist after using Fango, he always exclaims "Your skin looks like a million bucks!"  One jar lasts forever - and I slather it on half my body each time I use it.  I had maybe two dozen cysts when I put it on last night, and today they are all gone and my skin is beautiful!  I think it would work wonders for acne as well.  I highly recommend this fantastic product.  it smells very earthy and nice.  I have one jar that is probably five years old; when it dries out, just add a little water the night before you want to use it.  It has saved my life many times.  I've seen it as high as $60 for 17.6 oz.  Can't say enough about this wonderful product.

This is a great product. At first I was slightly hesitant to pay the price for such a small size, but the reviews convinced me otherwise, and they have held true.

All you need is about a fingertip's worth of pomade for your entire head. Applied to wet hair, you can achieve any style you want. If you leave it alone, it will give your hair a wet look, but if you run your hand through it one time, the sheen goes away, but the hold stays. This was a huge plus for me, because I like being able to style my hair without looking like I put any effort into it.

I have bought Imperial paste twice now, and I don't picture myself ever buying a different brand. Do yourself a favor and invest in this. You won't regret it.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: This is a great product. At first I was slightly hesitant to ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I'm a hairdryer snob.  I've bought and returned a few online (based on good reviews)...plugging them in for just one second tells me they're not good enough.  I'm not terribly particular about the weight of my hairdryer, but the power of the dryer is a deal breaker.  This one is strong and delivers SMOOTH air (does that make sense?  hmmm).  It is much quieter than my old dryer, and it weighs next to nothing.  Pro for heavy over-packers like me!  Maybe I will start caring about dryer weight after this one...I've never had such a featherweight!  I'm impressed.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: THIS IS THE ONE, get it

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I bought a sample size of this cream when I was on vacation in Charleston and fell in love.  I was glad when I was able to purchase it on line.  It is by far the best moisturizing cream I have ever used.  Your hands remain like silk long after washing them and abusing them like most women do. I use it on my elbows and feet too with excellent results.  LOVE IT

This stuff is great. Bought it for Maui against a friends advice who claimed the Four Seasons complementary poolside sunscreen was better. Normally I would have agreed but I had this stuff. It lasts in the pool, ocean, sweat, anything. It has little smell and protects my extremely pale skin. This comes from a person who burns looking at the sun from his hotel room. I strongly recommend. Allergy free as well.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Absolutely the best sunscreen I have ever used.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I am new to Jack Black's products and I simply LOVE this moisturizer!  I have used it both at night and during the day and find that it makes my skin soft and helps ease redness.  At my age, and in the climate that I live, I need all  of the help I can get!  Unlike many other moisturizers, I found I did not have to keep re-applying it.

The cream goes on smooth, it has no strong scent so men and women can use it without it smelling "perfumy". The tube is just the right size to fit in a purse, cosmetic bag or backpack.

I am on a never ending hunt for the perfect lip balm.  I shop around and always come back to this product.  I've tried all the "flavors" and they all work the same for me.  This may be by perfect lip balm.  I've had problems in the past with Aquafor chapping/burning my lips so I stay away from that devilry.  This feels like a vaseline type product going on and I only need a teeny bit which means this tiny tube lasts a long time.  It's not too sticky/gooey but viscous enough to stay on.  I mostly use it before sun exposure b/c it has SPF!  Bonus!  Now if they could just add a little color for a slight tint - THAT would be perfect!

Surprised how well this is working.  The main thing is keep your hands out of water as much as possible and
wear gloves. I started using this following surgery so I was not able to do the normal chores, the nails grew
very fast and looked great.  Now that up and about, having to be more careful taking care of them.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: the nails grew very fast and looked great. Now that up and about

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I break out every time I shave
I hate shaving because I break out every time I shave
Ingrown hairs? Razor bumps? I don't know
But I break out every time I shave

... until I started using this after shaving (if anyone cares, I use jack black shave cream in a hot shower with a fog-free mirror; not too shabby of a set-up)

I now get the occasional pimple after shaving.. but I no longer dread shaving and will continue to use this product until my body rejects it
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I break out every time I shave I hate shaving because I break out every time I shave ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: St Tropez is the best, I've been using it for years and have never had an issue with streaking or bad application. The trick is to exfoliate before applying, use a tanning mitt, and wait until it's mostly dry before dressing. I tan at night and wash off in the morning because the mousse smells a little after a while - it's not an unpleasant smell per se but I wouldn't want to smell like it all day. The smell comes off fine after showering and I'm left with a flawless tan. I get compliments all the time on my tan - and for a girl who's as pale as they come, this stuff is awesome!

Easy to use.  Took a few tries to get the right curl and temp for my hair.  For you gals with fine hair, don't go over 300 degrees or you will fry your hair.  Stays curled all day without any hair spray.  Soft and not crunchy of looking "Shirley Temple" or "rolled".  My hair stylist friend told me it's cheaper on Amazon then at the beauty supply store with his discount.

Works beautifully for a side part. I put off trying pomades for a long time because I associated them with a slick, shiny look that isn't what I'm looking for. I regret not trying this sooner. This gives my hair a nice, natural shine that doesn't look greasy. It holds everything in place very well but the magic is that I can run my hand through my hair and it feels like nothing is in it. No stiffness or tackiness at all. And it smells great. I can't put my finger on it exactly but it's a bit like a green apple scent that I really enjoy.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Works beautifully for a side part

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I love this dryer! I've only used it once but I must say it not only cut down on the drying time but also left my hair so shiny. It's not that loud. Also it has a lot of power but doesn't seem to get too hot which is nice. I used the little attachment for the end of the dryer because it is so powerful. If you are looking for a great dryer for a reasonable price this is it! I feel and look that I just left the salon. Maybe even better

From all the reviews and forums I've read, in my initial shave I was fearing for the integrity of my lovely visage.  I took it painfully slow for the first 10 or 15 swipes of the razor, the first three swipes caught and stuck into my skin, issuing the initial warning of the beginning of a cut, so I carefully backed out and adjusted the angle.  After those first three catches everything started to pull smoothly and I started to see that none of the doom and gloom forecasts of nicks and cuts were coming true I gained confidences quickly.  By the end of the shave I had accomplished a close shave with close to a normal shaving speed compared to my original multi-razor shaving speed.  I highly recommend going DE safety razor, you'll never look back and your wallet will thank you!
Luxury_Beauty.summary: First Shave and No Styptic Pen Required...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I love this stuff. Foams nicely, smells great, doesn't irritate my skin. I use this with a safety razor after moisturizing (either with just hot water or the Proraso pre-shave cream Proraso Anti Irritation Pre-Shave Cream with Green Tea and Oatmeal, 3.6 Ounces). The razor glides nicely over this stuff and I can normally get away with one pass.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Smells great and helps give a nice close shave

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Nice curls and I am surprised that I like the clips. I have never used clips. I've always had the metal pin type. I didn't think they would stay in my hair but they did as long as I ensured one half of the clip was inserted deeply against the roller against the hair next to my scalp. I like the tray and I like how fast they heated up.

After reading reviews about this product I was extremely eager to try it out - especially after knowing celebrities like kim kardashian and other professional salons use this. This is well worth the price I paid for heats us extremely quickly and hot - how hot you want it is up to you.
No problem with this so far but being from Australia I completely forgot that the power point was different (this being the US plug) nevertheless just get an adapter and WALA you can use it

I have fine hair, and live in the very humid DC metro area.  I have tried everything, and this product is amazing.  Does what it is supposed to do, is not heavy, I just wish I had found it years ago.  Do not hesitate to buy.  Looks expensive; however, you do not need any more than a squeeze equivalent to a dime to do the job.  I will now be looking at their other products.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I have fine hair, and live in the very humid DC ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I've been using this for years and just got my mother a bottle. I blow dry my hair every day and color my hair so I need all the help I can get.  This stuff is amazing - it smooths out the hair and takes away frizzies.  It isn't sticky or greasy and doesn't weight my hair down.  It's the only product I've used consistently for years - it's worth the price and lasts a long time.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: This stuff is amazing - it smooths out the hair and takes away ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I have been looking for an airbrush that will give my shoulder length hair a nice curve but not curly.  This one works great...Not so hot that it fries your hair, and it has a button to push if your hair tangles in the brush.  So far, I haven't had to use that little feature.  I haven't found anything I don't like about this product.

After reading the great reviews, I decided to give this a try.  I was skeptical because I have tried everything.  This was going to be the last thing I tried before I succumbed to acrylic.  I am 56 years old and in the last year, my nails have stopped growing and looking healthy.  I have been using this for about a month now and it really works!  It took about 3-4 weeks before I saw improvement.  I highly recommend it.  My nails don't look yellow at all as some indicated in reviews.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: After reading the great reviews, I decided to give this a try

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I can't understand how I didn't know about safety razors until now. Picked up this razor a few weeks back and I'm completely enamored of it. Shaving is actually kind of fun since I got it.

The blade that came with the razor wasn't the greatest. In fact, it kinda hurt a little bit when I tried it out for the first time. Thankfully the box of 100 blades I ordered along with this razor are much better at cutting. With the new blades, I get one of the smoothest shaves I've ever had. And since I only need to shave once a week, at about 2-3 uses per blade, I spent about $30 altogether and I'll have good shaving equipment for the next 5 to 6 years! Razors with cartridges seem like a cash grab to me now. I'm never going back.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Shaving is actually kind of fun since I got it

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Love this shampoo and use it, along with the companion Davines Alchemic Silver Conditioner, several times a week on my blond hair (I'm white, and have lots of heavy, wavy hair). It makes a huge difference in color preservation between my professional toner appointments; my hair staves off the yellow much longer when I use the Davines Silver set. For a while I just used the conditioner, but adding the shampoo made an enormous difference, and I will always use them together from now on. This shampoo cleans your hair nicely, but it doesn't foam much, so don't have expectations about a big, fun, foam experience. It's gently scented.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Love this shampoo and use it several times a week

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I work with patients in a hospital setting and wash my hands at least 15-20 times a day. My hands are often dry and chapped. I've tried everything: Eucerin, Vaseline, Cetaphyl, etc but nothing has come close to this cream. I got it as a gift from a coworker and haven't stopped using it since. It's rich (not watery like Cetaphyl or Eucerin) and absorbs quickly. Doesn't leave a sheen or film after use. The size is small and convenient; perfect for sticking in your pocketbook or lab coat. Others have commented on the diaper cream smell but I find it quite pleasant and mild. Overall, would recommend this hand cream highly. The only downside is the price. But it's so good it's worth it. I got it around Christmas; 1 month later I'd say it's still 1/3rd full.

Side Note: I also ordered the 25% shea butter lotion in the 7oz jar figuring it would be very similar to the 20% in the 1oz tubes. It's actually not the same at all. The 25% is much richer and leaves an oily film which stays on my ha... Read more

50 bucks is a LOT for soap but it's a good investment.  It smells fantastic and feels squeaky clean.  I ditched my old shampoo too.
Only need 3-4 pumps for head to toe shower. Anything comparable you find at target or Walmart will usually be 8-10 pumps and not be even close to the amount of lather. Smell lasts long too.  Get it.

This is a product that is at least 4-5 years old. Xen-Tan has not sold Dark Mist in four or five years. The Mist Intense is the replacement for this and if you look on the Nordstrom site or other authorized sellers of this product you will see the Mist Intense (the updated paraben-free version of this product) is the current one.

I just used this curling iron for the first time and it burned my hair off -- literally. I grabbed one strand of hair, clamped the barrel down and tried to move it down the strand and it stuck. To my horror, it sizzled and melted the hair in the clamp. As I pulled the curling iron away from my hair and it had half the strand melted to it. The entire barrel is now covered with black charred hair that won't come off -- think of burning food in a pan on a stove top to the 10th degree. It's disgusting. I had the setting on medium - about 380 degrees which is the setting the outside of the box recommends I use given my wavy hair type - and I let it heat up for about 5 minutes before I used it. I have used hair tools for the last 20 years and have never experienced anything like this--I am incredibly disappointed. Now my entire apartment smells horrible, like burnt hair, my hair has two burn marks in it from the barrel and I have a brand new $30 curling iron that is covered in charred hair making it unusable.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: It's disgusting. I had the setting on medium - about ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Pretty much everyone that said this was fake had the same comments I have.  The product came opened.  It even had a scanned "4 year Warranty" tag on the front when the bogus "paperwork" that came with it was for a 3 year warranty and gave no information to even register the product.  Next, this product worked even worse than something I could pick up at a drugstore.  The dial was hard to turn, the plates didn't even get very hot, and they didn't even close all the way.  How do you straighten your hair with plates that don't even close?  Only the end section would close and it grabbed my hair and scraped it through the plates.  So much for "glides through hair."  This product is obviously fake since my hairdresser recommended the brand to me and there's no way she would use this thing everyday.  I rarely write reviews, but this just made me mad and I felt I needed to pass this information along.  I should've just bought through an authorized retailer (AMAZON IS NOT) rather than try to save some money and ultimately have to put more work into returning the stupid thing.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Should have read the reviews closer...THIS PRODUCT IS A FAKE!

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: This used to be my favorite lip balm. I used the one in the little pot or chapstick form for years. I loved the old version because it didn't have a sunscreen taste or smell, just the tea tree smell (I dislike sunscreen taste/smell in products, but you gotta use them!) it was smooth, and really moisturized my lips. It was my go to always, and kept me from getting burnt lips at the beach.  But, this new version is terrible. Not only is it sunscreen tasting, it's feels different, and I don't like the tube. Still searching for something as great as the old product ;(

I bought this product several months ago (February), but since I have quite a lot of skin care products, I hadn't had the opportunity to look at it or use it until yesterday.
I realized the tube has two small cuts on the edges at the top of the tube. I don't know if they were made intentionally of the tube is too old that just cracked.
Judging by the weight of the tube, I can say it is only about 40% full, if not less.
I don't know what happened, I hope at least the little product that is inside is the true cream.
If I had noticed this since the beginning, I would have definitely returned it. But now it is too late.
So disappointed. I usually get my Bioderma products from Amazon, and never had any problem until now.
Don't but from this seller.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: tube has 2 cuts on the top

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I have long, kind of crazy growing lashes, my eyes are also a bit hooded, not much lid shows, so it is an absolute must that I curl my lashes. I was very excited to try this mascara this morning and curled my lashes as I normally do and as soon as this mascara touched my lashes they drooped to the point where they were actually pointing down! I quickly wiped it off before it dried and re-curled and put on my regular mascara. I am so bummed out I was extremely excited to try out this mascara, which isn't cheap. Total waste of money for me, returning...

I bought this product based on reccomendations from a writer/blogger that has severe excessive under arm sweating issues, not unlike myself; I have purchased several products in the hopes that one or a combination of a few would stop the embaressing sweating! Long story short, I received the DERMA DOCTOR product, used it and it had ZERO effectiveness in reducing my under arm perspiration. Only AFTER using it for a week did I decide to read the back and discovered it's active ingredient is EXACTLY the same ingredient as the clinical strength Secret solid I already have, not only that but my SECRET clinical strength antiperspirant has 19% as where the Derma Doctor only has 11.25%! In addition, the SECRET clinical strength only cost me $7.00 dollars and the Derma Doctor was $20.00! Neither antiperspirant works for me but if you want to try an antiperspirant with this active ingredient to see if it may help for you buy the secret clinical strength at your local store and save yourself the $13.00 dollars difference in price!

In all my years as an Amazon Prime shopper this will go done as the worse product I have ever purchased.  As a shaving gel, it has all the lubrication of a piece of sand paper and washes off at the slightest contact with water.  I followed the directions to the letter, massaging in the gel into the area to be shaved and began to think that maybe I had accidentally ordered something other than shaving gel.

I had previously used Gillette shaving gel but thought that maybe I could find something cheaper that worked as well.  Well, I guess I learned the old adage..."you get what you pay for...."
Luxury_Beauty.summary: ... Amazon Prime shopper this will go done as the worse product I have ever purchased

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I would give this 0 stars if I could. This mascara is terrible! It did not provide the length and fullness the product description promised and, the worst part, by mid day the mascara begins to flake. Not enough to see the flakes on your cheeks but enough to notice that something irritating is in your eye. Removing the "tubes" is a pain as well. Yes it comes off with soap and water, but then you're left with slivers of black pieces of "tubes" in your sink. Can't be good for my septic system.

Anyway, I've tried "pushing through" and used it about 5 times. Every time, I've been disappointed. Wish I could get my 23 bucks back. In the trash it's going. Seriously, don't waste your money on this product

I liked it the 3 times I got to wear it before the product was gone. Wtf. If I pay good money for a high end product I expect it to deliver.. and while I like the wear of it, there was very little product in the tube so I'm really disappointed. Maybe it would be different if I bought it from ultra.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Very disappointed with the very little product in the tube

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: First this takes a while to lather up and once you've applied it there's almost no "cream" to it. Once you rinse it off it leaves a dry feeling behind. You can literally rub your fingers together and hear them "squeak". It makes for a very uncomfortable shaving experience. Save your money and get Cremo Cremo Astonishingly Superior Shave Cream, 6 Fluid Ounce, which is even cheaper but light years better.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: It's soap! Does not provide moisture or silky smooth anything! Avoid!

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: After using this daily for a couple of weeks I began noticing pimples, especially on and around my nose and eyes. I stopped using it for a while to see if perhaps it was something other than the product. My skin cleared up within a day or two and I had no further breakouts. However now after using it in the morning for a single day I'll have breakouts beginning by the afternoon. This is unfortunate because initially I really liked the product!
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Unfortunately I can no longer use this!

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I have been using StriVectin-SD for 10 years. I just loved it. But now I'm totally disappointed. I got new one Strivectin -SD and creme for neck from my daughter like birthday present. Because I used it for years I did not made the test. I put creme on my face and about 1 1/2 hour nothing happened and I was happy. After that my face gone red, but not just red, purple, hot. They say that small warm can occur and it disappear after 1 - 2 hour. It's already four days and my face still purple, I look like I gone thru fire. I don't know what to do. I totally ruined my face. I'm afraid that it's never going to be like before.

It's ridiculously over priced.  I thought $13 was a lot for a tube of toothpaste, but figured for a "large" tube and what it promised, I'd try it.  The size of the tube was about like those you buy at Bed, Bath and Beyond for your luggage.  I won't purchase this again.  I'll just use a gel toothpaste on my lumineers before I pay this price for a tiny little tube of paste.

I received the above Neova Copper Peptide Cream, a product I have been using for several years.  The cream I received is spoiled, and it reeks of rancid oil. Also, it is not the correct consistency and is in a near liquid state, indicating it has gone bad. I believe it is is way beyond its expiry date and shelf life.  It is a defective/damaged product.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Received A Spoiled Product From This Seller

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I was very disappointed with this product!! It does not do what it claims. It's a gel but the color does not adhere to eyebrow skin or hairs. And to make things worse,I used half the tube in one application trying to get the effect of the product. What a waste of $25.00. Talika should be ashamed of this product and makes me skeptical of other products made by Talika
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I was very disappointed with this product

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: This was such a disappointment. Most of my box were men's samples. I feel misled by the description of this box. I knew the samples would vary but I didn't think most of them would be for men. I just don't see many men ordering a luxury beauty box for it to make sense that a random box would be filled with mostly men's product samples

Wow! Bought on January 28, 2016 & it's almost dead & it's only May! I've been noticing it seemed to not be curling my hair very well. Some days it worked fine & others not so good. Today my suspicion was confirmed. If I can hold my hand on the curling iron when it's at its highest heat & it's been on a half hour it's a goner! I may be blond but I'm pretty sure that's not normal!

I hate to buck the tide of glowing reviews here, but this stuff STINKS. LITERALLY!  Im giving it one star because you cant give zero. Oh, it works--I didn't get sunburnt. But the smell--GACK! I am normally scent-sensitive, so when I was at the spa at a resort and realized the only sunscreen I had was in my makeup, I bought this. First, after sniffing the testers, I bought the unscented version--and within five minutes of putting it on, I smelled like rotting fish dipped in not-quite-dry oil-based house paint. I showered, went back to the spa and they let me exchange it for the Fresh Mango scented version--which tester smelled delightful. Put it on today, and I smelled great.....for maybe half an hour (the instructions say to wait 20 minutes after applying it to go out in the sun. Then the mango scent was gone, replaced by that fishy-painty stench. Every place I went to shop, I had to duck into the restroom to wash my hands, forearms and cleavage. Within five minutes, the stink had come back. It ruined my appetite at the coffee and fro-yo bars, and Im sure other people noticed it too--so embarrassing!  I think once it sinks into your pores you have to metabolize it out, because I washed, wiped down with face-wipes, sprayed myself with my favorite citrus verbena (and my bra and hair with Febreze). Even sprayed a tissue and tucked it into my cleavage,  And the stink is back--overwhelming even the scent of the barbecue I had for dinner. (Hoping the beans I ate do their job--even flatulence smells better). I looked at the ingredient list, and voil: LINSEED OIL. Yup, the very stuff they use to make oil and house paints. Threw the tube into the trash, and now the wastebasket smells like fishy paint. Will go back to Neutrogena, LaRoche-Posay or MD, no matter what it costs--since Im at risk for lymphedema and melanoma, avoiding sunscreen or wearing a long-sleeved heavy shirt in the summer heat is not an oprion. Id rather go bankrupt than smell like the garbage pail in a newly-painted fishmarket.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: OK--if you don't mind the smell of linseed oil (and nobody around you cares).

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: The cleanser has been watered down or tampered with.  I have order this product several times through other sellers and have never had a problem with it.  This is NOT the same product,  the cleanser has a foul smell and is very watery.  I did not open immediately because was finishing another tube and passed the return date by a few days.  Horrible product and don't recommend product from this  seller.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: CLEANSER HAS BEEN MODIFIED OR TAMPERED - FOUL SMELLING AND WATERY

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I received this product yesterday and it was obvious that the bottle had been tampered with - seal was sliced open.  Even worse, what was inside the bottle had been tampered with.  It was not Moroccanoil - does not smell or feel like it.  I was leary once I saw the bottle seal had been tampered with and could tell right away that it was not what it claimed to be.  I sent an email to the seller requesting a full refund.  Will post outcome once I hear back from them.

I bought this item in august.  I had one I was using.  When I opened it today, the jar been opened and the color was yellowed and smells funny.  I tried to return but since I purchased it in August I no longer qualify.  I would not buy from this seller again.
I wasted my money on this product as it can not be used.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: the jar been opened and the color was yellowed and smells funny. I tried to return but since I purchased ...

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Sabon use to pride itself on using natural ingredients, there was a manufacturing center in Montreal Canada  and the ingredients used in it were amazing. To name a few the ingredients it use to have was  (water, shea butter Glyceryl Sstearate, Caster Oil, Olive Oil)  the new ingredients while it contains some of the original stuff has added in cheap and unhealthy inferior oils such as mineral oil and Petrolatum. The scary part is petrolatum is high up on the list which means a substantial amount is used in this product. These inferior oils negate the healthier ingredients in this product. Before buying this I was trying to research the ingredient in this product as my last bottle was purchased some time ago. I only found generally comments on what it contained and now I know it was for obvious reasons. They only list the healthy items but fail to mention the list of other not so healthy ingredients.  They have switched manufacturing companies and closed down the Canadian Sabons  so I had to buy this  product on-line. Had they still had stores open in Canada I would never had bought this knowing what they are now using in the ingredient list.  Save your money if you want to put crap on your face there s a lot of crapy products you can find in your drug store for cheaper.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: INGREDIENTS HAVE CHANGED AND NOT FOR THE BETTER.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I have asian hair, it is bleached with a 'temporary color' on top.  It is punkie colour atlantic blue.  I thought this product might pull at least some of the color out of my hair, but it did nothing at all, not even a shade lighter.  So if you have a temporary color in your hair this produce might not do anything to get it out.  oh well, there goes $20 down the drain.

I love this product line so much.  HOWEVER -- my particular jug of this arrived and it was defective....  maybe it was really old?  It must be because I was in my fancy neighborhood beauty and makeup store, and the jug is now clear (tho the one i received was opaque white).  the liquid is so congealed and thick (hence why i think it is old) -- the squirt pump wouldn't work -- it took like 10 pumps to get a pea size of liquid out of it.  So of course I pumped a few times -- and then the pump broke.  I had to go buy another squeeze bottle, and I added water to it and it is now a normal body wash.  Really annoying to pay so much, but not at all worth returning a broken jug.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I got stuck with an old jug, tho i love this product line in general.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: Buyer beware if you will be purchasing this from Greek Product.  The lotion and water had separated inside of the tube and when I went to open the tube water shot out all over the place more than once.  The remaining lotion was extra oily and not as it should be.  Had I not ordered this product before I would have concluded that this was the fault of the manufacturer. style.Style:: Serum for Visible Pores and Uneven Skin Tone

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
This serum came in really attractive pink packaging that seems almost fluorescent.  The bottle is just as pretty.  It is almost a sit is trying to say that skin will be radiantly beautiful and pinkish after using this serum.  I was not familiar with LR2412 ingredient so I did some research.  As it turns out there is a new product from Lancme called Visionnaire that contains 4% of LR2412.  I found an article about this ingredient and here is what it says:
So, what is Lancomes LR 2412 ingredient (allegedly being used at a 4% concentration and now followed by a "Cx" designation)? LR 2412 is derived from the jasmine plant. Lancome maintains that this ingredient is a molecule designed to propel through skin layers. As it does so, it triggers a cascading series of micro-transformations. Sounds like a magic wand for your skin, doesnt it? And Lancomes constant reminder that this ingredient is protected by 20 patents makes it seem even more remarkablebut a patent has nothing to do with efficacy; it is only about a unique way to use any ingredient. A patent can be obtained simply by presenting an idea, not proof that the idea actually works.

As it turns out, simply propelling an ingredient through skin is not a guarantee of anything beneficial happening, and it may even make matters worse. For example, many ingredients, such as sunscreen actives, are meant for and should stay on the skins surface; you don't want them to penetrate through multiple layers of skin because they need to protect the skins surface. Also, lots of ingredients can propel through skin and cause beneficial changes along the way, such as most antioxidants, glycerin, sodium hyaluronate, ceramides, retinol, and numerous other repairing ingredients whose daily use helps improve skins appearance and healthy functioning. In essence, Lancomes claim makes LR 2412 sound innovative, when its really nothing new or all that exciting. But the ballyhoo sure makes it tempting!

On the ingredient list for Visionnaire, LR 2412 is listed as sodium tetrahydrojasmonate, which, as mentioned, is derived from the jasmine plant. Part of the original formula but now gone is another part of the jasmine plant, tetrahydrojasmonic acid. Both of these ingredients, in their natural state, are lipids (fats) that help the jasmine plant signal when repair is needed and that control the life cycle of the plants cells (Sources: Plant Physiology, April 2010, pages 19401950; and PLoS Biology, September 2008, page e320).

Lancome wants you to believe that these lipids, which in the jasmine plant repair environmental damage and control cell behavior, can somehow have similar effects on your skin, such as improving wrinkles, reducing large pores, and fading red marks when applied to skin via their bioengineered LR 2412 molecule. Unfortunately, there isn't a shred of published research to support their assertion. More to the point, even if these jasmine-derived ingredients were miracle workers for wrinkles, large pores, and red marks from acne, the amount of alcohol in the formula (it's the fourth ingredient) likely will harm your skin in the process, so any potential benefit is muted.

LHA another important ingredient in this product stands for lipo hydroxyl acid, which it turns out is a derivative for salicylic acid.  As someone who has combination skin, this is perfect ingredient for my skin. Apparently, according to another article, LHA is 6x more potent than salicylic acid.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: I would recommend this product to consumers with combination or oily skin, based on the product ingredients

Recently, I was sent two different Calvin Klein colognes to review. Being both busy and lazy, as well as eager to give both colognes equal treatment, I spent two weeks with my left half doused liberally in CK One, while I drenched my right half in Obsession for Men. Here are the results!

First, much less nausea than I expected. In fact, none nausea. They both pass test number one.

Next, my initial preference is immediately for CK One. Obsession smells like if baby powder grew up into man powder. It smells like a dentist's waiting room if it were also a Baptist church full of freshly showered senior citizens. Over the past two weeks, my right side got mostly "meh"s from the men I hit on. The women I hit on with my right side were more receptive, but not my much. None of this is conclusive; I haven't tried hitting on anyone in a long time, so I'm out of practice.

I also found that Obsession for Men was far too easy to over-apply. I know I previously joked about dousing myself in the stuff, but in actuality I apply cologne by spritzing it in the air and walking through the cloud, so it's less potent than when you spray directly onto the skin.  Even with this approach, the smell was almost too strong. The smell lingers for days.

Although I preferred it, CK One still smells similar to Obsession. It's got that soft powder undertone, but it's much less pronounced in One than it is in Obsession. One is brighter, fresher, and a little fruitier. Not in a gay way (unless you're into that), but in the pineapple and papaya in the top notes. After looking up the notes for both fragrances, I think the baby powder odor must be coming from the musk and amber that both colognes have in their base notes. It makes sense that these two smell a little similar because they have many of the same components (Bergmot in the top notes, nutmeg in the heart notes, and the two aforementioned scents in the base notes).

Anyway, I preferred the CK One to Obsession, although both left the linger of powder hanging on me for days. Like that Shower-to-Shower talcum stuff my grandmother used to use all the time. A clean if not terribly sexy scent.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: CK One vs. Calvin Klein's Obsession for Men

I think these lasers do improve your skin, but BEWARE, both the Tria face laser and eye laser lose power/effectiveness over time.  If you pay attention you will realize the laser is getting gradually weaker and weaker.  You will get one full treatment cycle at the full power and then the laser gradually loses power.  I think buyers assume they will get multiple cycles for the price of these lasers, not just one!  The eye laser loses effectiveness in 2-3 months depending on how frequently you use it, the face laser 4-6 months depending on frequency of use.  They still charge and appear to "working", but the lasers are just not putting out the same power as when brand new.  Tria will replace as long as you are within one year from your ORIGINAL purchase date.  You don't start a new warranty period with each replacement.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Beware -- lasers lose power within months

Needless to say, if you love gardenias you may love this non greasy shea butter cream.  It's hard to find shea butter products that don't leave you feeling greasy so you may enjoy this.  It would also make a lovely gift for someone who likes heavily flowered products.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: Bergamot and Ocean Aria smell like Gardenias

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
I purchased this dryer for my wife.  She refuses to use the hard-bonnet type of hair dryer, and her hair takes so long to dry that hand-held dryers are out of the question.

For years she has used ConAire dryers and had been relatively satisfied with them.  But the model she prefers isn't available any more, and a similar unit has proved to be mechanically unreliable.

In desperation, I tried purchasing this model.  It's about the same size as dryers she's used before.  The power cord is long enough, and the hose connecting the unit with the bonnet is adequate in length and durability.

The hear produced is higher than any she's previously used.  She wishes there were an intermediate temperature setting, but overall is pleased with the amount of drying air the machine provides.  She's now able to dry her hair in about two hours as opposed to the four it took with previous machines.

The biggest point of dissatisfaction is the noise level.  If the heat produced is twice the amount of earlier models, so is the noise level.  It's not only loud but irritating with its raspy whine.  Sadly, there's not much of a choice but to continue to use this unit.

Can't anyone make a reliable, hot, and quiet soft-bonnet dryer these days?

Short Review: It smells good, detangles well. and does help with frizzies, but..........

The product does do all the above, leaves the hair relatively tangle free just after the shampooing . My only problem with it is that I just don't think its for those with an oily scalp with curly and or wavy hair that wash their hair twice a week. When I washed my hair with it I felt I needed something a little more stringent to cleanse my scalp. My hair looked great.. But for people who have oily skin I would say this product would be good to use for the first shampoo as it won't tangle your hair as much as the average shampoo,but you are probably going to want to follow up with a second shampoo thats of a more stringent gel base. Im mixed, have combo hair, wavy and curly, and i get a very mild relaxer just to help tame the frizzies every 5-6 months or so. I have an oily scalp but wash my hair about every 4th day, as that keeps my scalp clean with out damaging my ends which are susceptible to drying out and splitting if washed too much because its curly.

But if you have straight hair that you wash daily and have what you would consider a normal to dry scalp this product would probably be ideal, given your needs and the frequency at which you can wash your hair.

This works o.k. for a fake tan, and does look like you've gotten some time in the sun, but it's a lot of work and time to apply. Mine came with a mitt for review purposes, but I understand that a mitt is not included when you buy the Xen-Tan. However, it wasn't all that easy to use and I think just using a plastic glove and a soft washcloth will do just as well.

I applied this thoroughly over my freshly showered bod using small circular motions as instructed in the directions. That took a while and I was working up a sweat just doing that, which caused me to have to re-apply in some spots. I couldn't do my back but I was able to smear enough on it so it was actually a good indicator of how much Xen-Tan stayed on after showering later on. I noticed I did look noticeably darker after applying the Xen-Tan. I wore loose clothing for the rest of the day and actually did not shower again until the next morning so I certainly left it on for the minimum 3 hours before showering.

When I got into the shower I saw the water run dark-ish down the drain and it had to be the Xen-Tan. I checked my back in the mirror and saw where some of the Xen-Tan had not washed off, but it was a lot lighter than when I initially applied it. I'm not really sure I'd want to spend $65.00 to work that hard, and not get much to show for it. I want to mention, that yesterday when I first applied the Xen-Tan, it felt sticky and I felt sticky for about an hour until it began to dry. Also, when I washed my hands any water that dribbled down my arms erased the Xen-Tan and I had to re-apply it. It doesn't tell you that water will erase the tan shortly after applying.  And be real careful with it on your feet because it will look like you just walked through red clay mud if you don't smear it around well.

It's 3 am in the morning and after thinking for awhile, I decided to write this review. This is considered as my first review ever for amazon, I don't like to write "stuff" but I think at this time this review might "save someone life " according to my experience with this miracle TOPPIK hair. I'm a nursing student and just in another 3 hours I have to be at Baptist Hospital to do my clinical rotation. So to let me take my hours sleep to write you this review, you have to trust me that I'm honest with my words and want the best for you. I bought this TOPPIK hair fiber at amazon, just like everybody reviewed above, it worked amazing ( I'm Asian, thin and short hair), I felt very confident and was supper happy to find this product. However, everything gone pretty well with first time. On the second time ( today) i went to bed at 11 and woke up in a middle of night with sign and symptom of shortness of breath, and itchy all of my body especially feeling severe itchy, burning sensation all over my head. When I turned on the light I saw redness, rashes all of my body. I know s.t was going wrong ( I almost called ambulance), I checked what I ate for yesterday but nothing appeared as abnormal. Then I started to do some interventions for myself, I washed my head with warm water for 10' , took 10mg Claritin, drank 2 glass of water. After 15 mins, I felt much better now. Luxury_Beauty.reviewText: I like Jan Marini facial washes, but I think they are getting a bit over-priced. This cleanser, for example: you can get the same deep clean if you use the Jan Marini face wash and some crytals to exfoliate. Or use any decent enzyme cleaner with some crystals. At least there, you can control how light or vigorous you want (light is probably better). The clean zyme does smell great. I just think the same results with a good wash cloth or corundum crystals (sp?) will do the job and cost a whole lot less. I started using Jan Marini bioglycolic face wash three or four years ago.  I put it on a dry face or as close to dry, and massage it in, then wait a few minutes (usually I brush or floss) then rinse it off. It seems to clean well without stripping all the natural oils. Doing that, plus two or three TCA peels over the course of the year, plus add in some extra exfoliating once or twice a week (using a wash cloth or cystals with a nice moisturizing cleanser OR an enzyme deeper cleanser will keep your skin healthy and decongested. Whether you use a gentler moisture cleanser or enzyme of course depends on how much oil you produce (ie how old you are!)  but that is all one needs -- over doing products on your face can be counter productive. Just my take on it.
Luxury_Beauty.summary: smells good, but you can get  good exfoliation with a less expensive product.

Luxury_Beauty.reviewText:
This delivers a very fine, fine mist.  It is in a aerosol type spray, and though it is loaded with chemicals, I really thought from the quality of the spray delivery that I would love it.  It has a bit of an odor, but it is more like chemicals and alcohol than perfume.  It quickly goes away, because this product dries quickly

It does not cause cosmetics to run or change color, and powder looks more natural.

It holds makeup on well for 3-4 hours.  After 3 hours my face feels stiff and dry with this product. I can't stand it much longer myself so I remove it.  It comes off with a soap based cleanser or Olay makeup remover towelettes.  It leaves my face dry though, even in this humid, muggy weather.

I can't recommend it if needed for more than about 3 hours.  It does prolong makeup wear on hot, sweaty days for a couple of hours,  so it might work well for a photo shoot or short special event.  I would never wear it daily.
