Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
Unlike a previous armband that was supposedly for the RAZR MAXX, this one actually does fit the phone. It's nice and snug around all four corners. My only 4 vs. 5 star is the bit of "rippling" that exists in the fit of the plastic cover over the phone's screen. It's much less than my previous one, but having any at all affects the phones ability to respond to attempts to use the phone's screen commands. I use it primarily when I go running or am working outside around the house. I have bluetooth headphones that I use to answer calls, change songs or adjust volume (Artic P311, also available on Amazon), and they are awesome! But trying to do so on the phone screen is somewhat clunky, and often the function I'm trying to select is not what responds.
I imagine, from having owned a different model as well, that this will likely be a difficult issue for almost any armband phone holder.
I'm very satisfied, but if I ever run across one that "perfects" that functionality, that will be my 5-Star.

I'm not the guy who is looking for the super-fancy,  multi-function iPhone type of handset.  I just needed something with simple web browsing ability and all the basic functions of a cell phone.  I don't like flips or sliders or any of those mechanical lever type phones, I only like these candybar type phones so my options are kind of limited.  This phones meets and exceeds my expectations as far as features go.  Came with a 2GB chip which I found impressive.  The phone works well, reception is good, bluetooth works perfectly with my blueant, web browsing is fast as heck for a little phone not really designed for it.  Overall, I'm very happy with the phone.  The only down side for me is that the buttons are a little small and not separated enough so I often push the wrong buttons when texting.  The reason I'm giving this 4 stars instead of five is because some of the menu systems are a little funky and go against logic.  I get frustrated with it a little too often, but overall, the phone is great.  It's SUPER thin, sometimes I can't find it in my pocket which is just how I like it.  It's actually a powerful little phone for the money, I definitely recommend it.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
Probably a 3 1/2 star vs 4, but since I had to choose, I chose 4.  Here is the lowdown:

1) Did tons of research, mostly online but also at a local Best Buy.  The best buy only had one pair of blue tooth stereo headphones period, and the sales kid (I do stress "kid") told me "This is the only pair we have in stock right now and these are the only ones on the market...no one else even sells one"  of course theirs were $149 and they would not let me try them out.  Also considered motorola, HK, samsung, and others.

2)  According to C-Net, amazon, bizrate, and others these were consistently the best performers rated for bluetooth headphones...amazon had the best price, even over bizrate, ebay, etc.

3)  Got the headphones in a very timely manner (it helps to live within one day delivery for supersaver shipping...heh heh heh) and set them up very easily for my wife to use with her new samsung cell phone to listen to tunes from the micro SD card.

4)  SHE LOVES THEM....they work well in high-noise environments (the gym) they have enough volume, intuitive controls that are easily accessible and the bluetooth connection is strong.  One of my worries was the fact that they were rechargable and how long a charge would last.  She used them until they literally died before recharging and it resulted in over 10 days total - turning them off when not in use, then with a solid 4-5 hours of playback time, about 1 hour a day every other day.  I imagine if you kept them on all the time and/or used the playback constantly it would likely give you 7 hours+ of playback time at relatively high volume.  Good performance.

5)  Here is the downside...they only fit medium sized people (if that is the right phrase).  I am 6'2" and large-ish (ok, 260 lbs).  The behind the neck band, which works great for my supermodel-ish wife only works for me if I keep my head down, staring into my lap.  If I move my head or look up (or even straight ahead for that matter) the neck band pulls the ear-pads off my ears enough to mess with the music.  Not a good thing.  Someone needs to come up with a neck band that is adjustable and will work for larger than average sized folks.

6)  #5 above and the fact that the headphones lack a very broad dynamic range (somewhat tinny highs, muted mids, not very low lows) is why I downgraded this to a 3 1/2 to 4 stars, but really the music quality I would rate just below Very Good and the fit and comfort, for my wife at least, is exemplary.

Nice job Cardo, now fix the head band and get a stronger driver and you will have a perfect set of headphones.

While charging the Energizer device it displays four large flashing blue light bars.  It is easy to see when the device has a complete charge since all four bars will be illuminated and no longer flash.  Pretty cool that the light bars work the same way when you draw from the device to another piece of electronics and the bars stopped flashing when my iPhone had a full charge.  Since I already had a household plug (AC) to USB adapter, this was easy to utilize; however, I am sure some would prefer a charger that just simply plugged directly into the wall.  The advantage of the device with the current design is one could plug it into a USB port on their computer or laptop and charge the charger (or items connected to it..although not at the same time).

It has enough juice to recharge my iPhone 4S twice over (from 15% left each time and it took around 2.5 hours each time) and then had some juice some left over.  It allows you to charge two devices at once and even has one of the two USB connections configured to charge your tablet [although the instructions warn for some people you might not be able to charge two devices at once (depending on the wattage of the devices)].  You can charge a tablet and a cell phone at the same time; however, cannot charge two tablets at the same time. I didn't have great luck charging my iPad from a depleted level; however, it worked fine on the iPhone and the specs on this are consistent with those results.  The micro USB cable that attaches to charge the device is magnetized so as to facilitate keeping it with the charger at all times to avoid misplacing it.  I also like the soft rubber exterior as that helps if it is bumping against other expensive electronics in a bag.  When not charging the device one could use the micro USB cable to attach to devices with that type of connection (which is great since several devices use that); however, you will need your Apple cord to accompany this device when charging Apple products.

While the device is fairly compact, it is also fairly heavy.  While this is a testament to its build quality (and purpose) other devices offer higher capacity at a smaller size and wieght. I don't know how practical it will be for some to carry this around regularly in a briefcase, purse or travel bag.  However, it is really handy when you know you will be in a remote area or outside and not around a power source for an extended period of time.  Or, this is great if one has a long flight or long layover in an airport without power sources.  Plus, the true value of this product can obviously be seen when one loses power in their home for an extended period of time.  I am in the suburbs of New York City and when Hurricane Sandy hit we lost power for several days.  This was a lifesaver as I had recently received this item just a few weeks before the storm and had an opportunity to charge it (took five hours out of the box to charge) and have it ready to go.  Note, once depleted it took me a bit over six hours to get the Energizer back to four bars and a full charge.  Plus, while I did not have power for several days, I was able to travel a short distance to relatives and not just recharge my electronic devices, but also this device to serve as a backup between charges.

Bottom line, this does what it is supposed to do and I already benefitted from its use on a number of occasions and will do so in the future as well.  However, I think this device is a bit pricey based on its size, weight and capacity compated to other devices on the market.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Great in an emergency...however, choose a higher capacity device for even better results

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
Placing a mount on the vents is the most optimal position you can put your phone in the car - suction cups will always lose their stickiness and fall off, freaking you out every time. It also doesn't block any view from your windshield. That's why I really like the minimalist simplicity of the device as far as air vent mounts go. There's no risk of it falling off or plopping down, causing you another mini-heart attack and risking a car accident. Downsides to this though - you can't turn the phone away/towards you side-to-side. It only rotates 360 degrees in a circle in a 2D plane (if that makes sense, you can see it in other video reviews here).

Also, the clip did not secure to the vent as tightly as I expected it to. I think it works best with vents that aren't curved but rather for vents that are straight and flat. I think it worked better in a 2014 Mazda CX5 than a 2010 Toyota Corolla. As a result of this, it can't really handle fairly large phones such as the Huawei Ascend Mate 2 (slightly larger than the iPhone 6 PLUS and Galaxy Note's). That Huawei is probably as big as a phone gets before getting to phablet territory, so I can't really fault it for not working on one of the largest phones out there. When the mount latched on to this phone, it would clamp down/hit the power and volume buttons on the sides, and when we tried to place it away from these side buttons, the weight of the phone pushed to one side would make it slip and fall off the mount.

It worked serviceably well for my old Samsung Galaxy SII though, so the smaller the phone the more stable it is on the mount. So if it works/fits in your car vent and you don't have a huge-butt phone, this mount is really great for the price!
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Nice simplistic design, dependent on car vent/size of phone for stability

The skin itself can be fairly easily repositioned until you set the adhesive with heat from a blow dryer.

The included screen protector was much harder.  Again, I'm quite sure the small sizes are easier, but it's extremely difficult to get all the bubbles out on an 18" screen.  I ended up with a number of little bubbles filled with the liquid you spray on.  If you don't get all of these out while the whole thing is wet, you can't squeeze them out the edges later.  I thought I would have to peel it off and start over, but it turned out patience is required.  The bubbles do shrink and go away over time, although it takes a while.  I've had it on a week, I still have one stubborn but now quite small bubble... but it's going away. The difficulty with the screen protector is the only reason I can't give this 5 stars.

All the pieces are cut very precisely and fit the device perfectly.  Once the screen protector is on you can't really tell it's there, and it doesn't seem to interfere with the touch screen at all.

best case ever for the S5.  I received as lot of comments on how it looks.  I have dropped it several times now and the case received only a small scratch.  The phone fits so well it is like your pushing air out of the case and creating a seal when you insert the phone.  The buttons on the case work flawlessly with the phone.  It is as if they are the phone's buttons.

There's not too many faults with this case and at first reading some of the reviews about people breaking their screens kinda worried me but I haven't had that issue. The case definitely seems very protective and it looks really good, though it is a bit bulky, but that's not much of an issue for me since i have big hands. The phone is slightly harder to take out of this case than past cases i've had but its not much of a struggle. I love the fact that they include the extension for headphones and a screen protector (though it would be much better if the screen protector was tempered glass). In terms of charge the case provides a quality charge and the first 25% of battery in the case lasts a long time. The next 50% doesn't last as long (maybe providing 30% battery or more for the phone depending on if you're using the phone or not) and the last 25% lasts as long as the first. So overall it does give roughly 200-250% battery depending on how much you use your phone while the case is on. The only two things im not a big fan of with this case are that you need an android charger to charge the case instead of a lightning usb cord like iphone (they provide one for you but its really short and I prefer the use of iphone cable instead) and that the extension isn't a metalic one because the one they give will break in around 3 months or so whereas the metalic ones will last much longer. Those things aside it's a great case and i love using it

Note - this case does not fit with the OEM Wireless Charging Cover.

I've been through many cases with my Galaxy S5. I've tried this Diztronic, Spigen SlimArmor, Cruzerlite, iSmooth, Tudia and the OEM Samsung Protective Cover. In the end each case had their own set of flaws except for my choice which is the Diztronic.

The feel is excellent. Not the most grippy but not slippery by any means. Compared to the other cases mentioned above the overall feel/grip and added bulk favors Diztronic.

Build quality is excellent and precise. The bezel is covered along with the buttons. The button covers offer a great tactile feedback and is welcome from other cases that may not cover them. All cutouts for the microphone are done well and not oversized. The headphone cutout is big enough for my Bose IE2 but may be too small for those with oversized plugs.

Overall a great case that fits well. The other cases went into a cabinet with other cell phone accessories while I stick with this one. Pair this case with a Tempered Glass screen protector and you got decent protection all around. I recommend Zagg Glass with this case.

One of the best purchases I've made and my favorite phone case for sure.  :)

Finally I'm reviewing this headset. Bought this headset in March 4, 2013. Haven't owned another headset to compare. But, fully charged 7 hours talk time. Have not  timed actual usage. Have not timed how long stays charged must be at least one week. Usually charge with 3 hours talk time remaining. Never has been dead.  Comfortable to wear. Use it  for one plus hour conversations with my family. No problems. Still in 2015.05.22 give the headset 5 stars.

I bought this case only on the reason that it looks futuristic. I just move to a new apartment and decording it with a new clean and futuristic look to it, and of course my phone case got to match. I got this case and was not dispointed, not only it match my life style look wise but it feel cool and safe in my hand, don't care if I drop it and kick it up when i need it(kickstand).

this is just what i was looking for. i bought the black 6x6 size and despite it's small size it's quite roomy; plus on the inside it has card slots and an extra pocket, which was a nice surprise. i use it as a wallet in the messenger bag i use for work; i keep the strap with it so when i need to run errands after work i have a quick and practical bag that holds essentials perfectly.

Just received this case today! It is absolutely gorgeous!  It is elegant and sleek. The crystals are on very secure and do pop out of the case a bit.  So you can feel them when you hold it. This is my first case like this so I will have to be careful. I do not believe that it will offer much protection. This case is just for looks.

*For only $5 this give you just as much protection as the otter box cases i have both.
*The buttons at the home button are squeezed in a little bit i easily still have functionally of them.
*The kickstand broke off for me :( , it was great when watching movies.
*The outer silicone has a nice grip & feel to it.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: For the money you cant beat it

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: This case is a nice quality, looks great--exactly as pictured--and comes with a stylus and cleaning cloth. It might be a bit more expensive than other cases, but in my experience, those cheap cases can be shoddily made (and often don't ship as part of Amazon Prime). It's worth the extra money for the quality and fast shipping.

EDIT2: Their support sent me a new band, and the pins are indeed different. These were more difficult to get in and look as if they should also be more difficult to get out (which is a good thing). Updating review as that was my only complaint.
--
Original review, since fixed: The pin pipped put while exercising, throwing my FitBit to the ground. I loved this band until that point, but I can no longer recommend or wear it.
--
EDIT: Their support responded my interaction and has sent me a new band stating they fixed the issue. I will update as soon as I receive it!

I didn't realize how great it would be to have one of these until I got it.  On my nightstand I charge the following items:

iPhone 6+
Nexus 7
Sony Bluetooth Headphones
Garmin Vivosmart Band.

I just used double sided tape and attached it to the back of the nightstand and ran the cables over using some velcro ties.  It charges everything considerably faster than a USB port on a desktop/laptop and appears to charge my iPhone faster than it's usual wall brick.  I've been very happy with this and will buy a couple more for family and other parts of the house.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: A must have if you're charging multiple USB devices.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: First time reviewing a product so here we go. First of, the Anker works perfectly as i imagined it would. Charging wise it those what it says quick charge from 20-80% under 30mins... and It could even charge my Vape so thats why i gave it a 5star. Ive bought a bunch of Powerbank in the past but nothing i mean not one could charge my Vape... so yeah im really happy about the purchase. It fully charge my iphone 6+ twice with 2 lights of battery left to it.... all in all i recommend Powercore 1000 if you're always on the go...
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: so yeah im really happy about the purchase

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: Great product, does exactly what it's suppose to do protect the phones screen. Use this on my teenagers LG G4 (was my husband's phone until he got the G5). Anyhow he put his phone on the back sliding door of the can the other day and it jammed up the door and smashed up the screen luckily it had one of these amazing screen protectors otherwise the phone would've been trashed. Its great price for amazing protection.

Works great and does what I need it to do. The plug fits snug in my phone and the cable seems heavy duty compared to some others I've had in the past.  I did receive a slow charge notification on my older phone when using this cable. Howwver, it charged just fine and my new phone works great with it.

The screen protector was easy to install and does a great job of protecting the screen. I had some questions about whether the screen protector would compromise the clarity of the images or be difficult to use. This product is transparent and resistant to damaging items. I am definitely glad that I have this on my screen.  the price is quite excellent for these sheets.

I wasn't expecting a high -end device for the price, but this is an excellent FM Transmitter. I use it with my LG G2x and the sound quality is great, the wings hold my phone perfectly as well as the feet, I can use it as a hands -free stereo device and my callers can hear my clearly,  and I can charge with the available USB output port on the side with the standard MicroUSB/charging canle that came with the phone. The value for the price is amazing. I'm really happy with this transmitter and would recommend it for others. Also, its comes with another 3.5mm input jack, so this transmitter will work on any device that has a 3.5mm output jack, just buy a longer cable. My wife had her iPad hooked up through it.

Works good except the USB doesn't snugly fit...it releases cord early...I have to play with it to keep cord in.... I edited this review after maker contacted me to find out the problem...sent a new one and this one works great...cords don't release early...fits snuggly in and charges fast...very prompt service and great customer service...would definetly buy from again

can't be beat...even if each piece was $20. way better than the original ZAGG sticker i had professionally installed on my old HTC Evo

- easy to apply (no soapy solution required)
- comes in a 3 pack (so you don't have to worry greatly if you you do gaff the install)
- dust sticker makes bubbles caused by lint easy to remove
- doesn't collect oil from your face
- remains clear (didn't yellow after a few months)
- didn't interfere with the S-Pen at all...in fact helped give it more traction for a "pencil-like" feel
- DURABLE. dropped my phone over the weekend, resulting it 3 separate nicks in the screen protector. I removed it, and NO CRACKED SCREEN!!

highly recommended.

Came quick, adds very little bulk to the phone and is very snug fit. The opening for the finger print scanner is actually a big plus as it makes you touch the right area almost every time. Kickstand is a bonus. I honestly forget that I even have a case on my phone. You would think it was made by the Huawei. Would definitely suggest buying this case if you were looking for one of for your honor 5x.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: better than I would have expected

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I just had to write a review, because today I dropped my iphone 4 on the pavement... for about the 6th time since I've had it (I have a bad habit of setting my phone on my lap in the car, then forgetting about it and standing up), and I didn't even have to panic because I knew there wouldn't be a scratch on it because of the case. The case itself has gotten a bit dinged up from all the dropping, but I expect that of it, and really its minimal, and it just needs to keep my phone safe... which it definitely has. 5 stars

I have been using this case for 6 months and it is still in great condition. I've dropped my phone on carpet, concrete, and more and there has been no damage to my phone. The case also came with clear plastic covers to stick on both the front and back of the phone, so the cards wouldn't scratch the phone. The rubber is tough and I haven't had any melting or peeling of any kind, even on the part that folds
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: ... case for 6 months and it is still in great condition. I've dropped my phone on carpet

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
It's great! The screen is crystal clear. It goes on fairly easy. They could have kept that cheap microfiber cloth though... that thing left mores dust than it picked up. I wasn't expecting a whole lot for a $4 glass screen to protect my Galaxy Note 4 but I am thoroughly impressed. People take note, it will not cover the entire  face of your phone. The device has curved edges so it's pretty much impossible to cover the entire face of your phone without it peeling up on the sides. However this screen does an awesome job of protecting the viewable area. Because of the curvature of the phone it makes it tricky to install. Take your time!!! What I did was place the screen on the phone (without removing the cover that exposes the adhesive), lined it up where I needed it to be, and then taped one side of the screen to the phone itself, almost like creating a book cover. This keeps the screen in place. Then I lifted the screen (like opening a book),  pulled the back of the screen off (exposing the adhesive) and gently closed it down on the screen. It's lined almost perfectly. There's no air bubbles. Pull the tape off and it's good to go!  I hope my review helps. I'll definitely be recommending this to my friend....

**update 4/3/15**
OK so a day after I wrote the above review, the stupid thing spontaneously cracked along the side. I've never dropped the phone or even sat it down hard anywhere.. I guess u get what you pay for....

The biggest problem that I have with it is that the button command has a delay with the phone. When I press the button to activate voice command, it would not accept the first command and tells me that it did not recognize any voices and tells me to try again. That is what I use the most with my bluetooth and that is why I gave it a low rating. I got another bluetooth and this will be use as a backup.

Within an hour of getting the case, I dropped and broke my phone :( Talk about being piss!!!! I was trying switch hands and slipped out my hand.  So this $3.99 purchase just cost me an xtra $100.00. And even if I wanted to use it again (& I don't) the strap won't stay close, so I would always be concerned that my cards would fall out. But on the plus side my 6 yr old daughter loves her new wallet.

I was all prepared to love this phone except, it has issues.  It stopped working, would not turn on.  I had to take the battery out and restart the phone.  The battery was still at 37%, nothing I did wrong.  This is a complete deal breaker.

I really liked the phone, perfect size, grip, features.  The problem is just not something I can ignore.

Love the picture, but hate the thin flimsy back rubber holder. The top and bottom of phone is not protected except by this thin rubber piece. The hard case only goes around the middle of the phone. The rubber holder has raised button covers that stick out and that makes the phone very difficult to find a carrying case. When you push the phone into a carrying case the protruding buttons hit and sides and the phones volume and the on off button goes on and off by it's self.

I first wrote a review on this item and at the time rated it five stars, and it deserved those stars. However, after having it for about a month, I've learned that this product is actually pretty cheap. It no longer locks onto my phone with that iron tight grip and if it does, it will randomly unlock, offering virtually no safety, besides the small, bottom ledge, that doesn't protect the phone on turns or sudden brakes. It also doesn't stick onto the windshield very well anymore. I'd love to say that this product was true to my previous review, but it really wasnt, and I regret my purchase.

It is more a salmon/pink/fleshy color. I like orange, but don't like pink, so I've basically thrown it in the cupboard and probably won't use it again (it's not worth returning). The iPhone 5 fits nicely in the case and it is soft and offers the protection I was looking for. It isn't too thick or thin. It's a shame the color was so far off what is described. It is really a hideous color and not even close to being orange. If you are not looking for an orange stripe on your case, this might be the one for you.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Case is nice, but the side is NOT even close to the color orange...

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
I bought this to use with an LG enV phone.  Very disappointed in this headset and am returning it today.

- No matter what I did, the much-hyped noise cancellation didn't seem to work.  People told me they could hear background noise.

- If I had my headphone volume above mid-range, the people on the other end of the call told me it was very echo-y. On my end it sounded static-y at the higher volumes.

- The overall sound quality was very tinny.  I had an old motorola S9 that I used and loved forever, with none of these sound problems.  I was totally taken aback when I put on the much-touted jawbone and got a noticable tinny sound quality to all calls.

- I could not get a good fit.  Given the need to keep the volume down to mid-range or below to avoid echo, I kept finding myself pushing the thing further into my ear canal to be able to hear - which caused awful sounds for those on the other end.

A colleague of mine has this headset and loves it.  But it sure didn't work for me.  Back to the store to find something else to try.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Didn't live up to expectations - sound quality, fit issues

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: This was installed for me by an AT&T store associate.  The glass itself seems very durable and thick.  The fit to the phone however is less than desirable.  The sides do not stick down all the way, this allows dust and dirt to be trapped under the sides and eventually will pop off and/or scratch your actual screen.  I tried many protectors when the S6 came out and it seems to be a problem across the board.  It also leaves a very large gap on the top and bottom of the phone so when you press your home and back buttons, your finger touches the edge of the glass - that is not ok.  It feels terrible.  I checked the box twice to make sure they put on the right protector but the fit is so poor.

This is a lesser quality tempered glass screen protector. The big factors are easy to notice when you hold it in hand.

The thickness is much less than the other temp glass on the market.

And the glass shows a GRID under the glass - a noticeable GRID pattern. The other temp glass I have bought and installed in the dozens do not have this GRID pattern.

I would rate these temp glass as the lowest quality on the market.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: The big factors are easy to notice when you hold it in hand

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I started using this in April. It was as easy to apply as any other screen protector. But, it is now September, and it did not hold up well. I found that it scratched very easily, and that pieces of it chipped off around the edges. It was also very difficult to keep clean. Fingerprints stayed on and were hard to remove. Compared to my last one, which lasted the two-year-plus life of my phone with no problems at all, this one is not worth even the low price. I gave it two stars instead of one only because the price is low. In short, I've already replaced it, and wouldn't buy it again.

I have been apart of the Apple family since the beginning of college. In addition, my family has really enjoyed Apple's macs, Ipads, and Iphones. However regrettably, I am taking a leave of absence from the Apple family after being treated so poorly by their associates and investing hundreds of dollars in a malfunctioning product. I have sent two messages to Apple corporate with no response. In addition, my experience at the Apple store was very much disappointing. Their associates were not helpful nor were they sympathetic to my situation. I was told that my malfunctioning Iphone could not be traded in since my product was one month over warranty. My broken Iphone which was confirmed by three individuals(AT and T, third party, and Apple associate) to have no water or dropping damage was deemed unworthy of a trade in or replacement. The associates said that this happens and they could not replace my lemon. When investing into an Iphone, I was told that my phone would be technologically and environmentally superior to other phones. On Apple's website, their products are advertised as being environmentally friendly, well designed, and technologically powerful machines. My experience has been quite the opposite. I do not wish to invest hundreds of dollars for a product that damages the environment, malfunctions, and has a poor support team. After my disappointing experience at their store, I visited a corporate AT and T store who deemed my Iphone to be worth a $200 trade in. I was quite confused since the Apple associate stated that my product was worth nothing. Apple, a billion dollar corporation, is more concerned about money then they are about customer satisfaction. Apple has forgotten that they are creating a product for people not making a product for themselves. After this experience, I will think twice before investing into another apple product.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Poor Customer Service and Disappointing Product

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I received the HTC Droid Incredible in about 4 days.  I was very excited to get it all set up but to no avail, after about 2 hrs on the phone with Verizon, I was told that it was not a clean phone and could not be used! NOT HAPPY! I sent it back and did get my $ refunded to my account! Now I'm still stuck with the stupid Blackberry Bold!

I bought this bundle for my husband new droid 3. He was impressed with the the price and quantity of the itmes. He don't use everything but he really loves the clear case and ear buds. The leather case is way too big for the phone and he hates it. overall he's ok with the case, earbuds, and screen protectors but I have one of those men who wants all items to be useful.

Fantastic for the car, but the magnet on the back of my phone case DID ruin two cards with magnetic strips. I read the reviews and thought it would be safe, but I had two (one old and one really new one) cards have the mag strip die I believe as a direct result of the magnet when they are all in my purse.
Functionality is great-- what if the ball was the magnet instead and just a steel plat stuck to the back of my phone? Then there would be no cause for even a concern about the magnet!

I got this in red and purple (one for me and one for my wife). The red one fit fine and felt fine. Not high end materials, but it'll do the job. The purple one, however, was clearly made of different material. Not only did it feel cheap, slippery, and awful, the rubbery inside had no sort of shape to it. It was too big, stretched out, and wouldn't even fit the phone.

Do not get the purple version if you want it to fit and not be a slip-n-slide.

If these thing would work for more than a few days, this would be a five star review. They charge devices very fast. I love the way it automatically adjusts the amperage, and I often have the need to charge multiple phone/tablet combinations, and is very compact. This unit is great  - until it stops working. This is the second one I have ordered. The first one had one of the USB ports fail and stop charging after just a few days of use.  I returned it to Amazon and purchased another.  The replacement one worked for about a week before two of the USB's failed, a third works intermittantly.  Thanks to Amazon's easy return process, I might try ordering one more time because I really want this thing to work. There are many more good reviews than bad for this product, maybe I just hit a bad batch?
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Two of these units failed within days of receipt

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I really liked the look of this case but am currently on my third one. The black rubber bumper has separated from the clear backing on the side where the volume buttons are located. It appears to be a manufacturing defect because I am not applying any additional stress to this area. The second case that failed was only in place for a couple of months and was never removed from my phone. SUPCASE has been very good to work with. They sent a replacement both times without hassle. I applaud them for that. My only complaint is that both times I suggested they send a different case due to my concern that it was a manufacturing defect. They chose to send the same case.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Nice case, great company, but doesn't hold up under normal use.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
II know white colour is hard to maintain and can get dirty. But, this is simply unacceptable that the white border turns yellowish or brownish, depending on how you look at it within a week's usage. It cannot even be wiped clean using any cleaning agent..

The so-called clear back scruffs very easily and can look very old within just a week's usage..

The positioning of the "SUPCASE" logo is over the beats logo and is very odd-looking..
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Do not buy White colour of this model

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I received my Mpero Screen Protectors today, and I am unhappy with what I received. The screen protectors don't fit the entire screen which is what the product review made it sound like. It literally only protects the lit up portion of the screen, leaving the outer portions of the glass exposed to the elements. I applied it after 3 failed attempts ( wasn't centered properly) and I'm leaving it on until I can find something else to put on my 920. Avoid if you are looking for a Full screen protector like I am.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: The screen protectors don't fit the entire screen which is what the product review made it sound like. It literally only protect

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
I gave this item 2 stars because while the fit and finish were excellent at first, the grippy rubbery part wore off after just a few months.  I'm not exactly easy on my phone, but I've had other Body Glove covers that lasted as long as I've had the phone it was intended for (usually 2-3 years).  This cover just didn't measure up.  It's sad because it worked great until the rubberized part just started flaking off.  It was a bit of a pain to get the cover off, but I didn't break it doing so.  The screen cover is easier to remove than the back section, which is the one you'd probably remove more often to access the battery and whatnot.

So, if you're looking for something that looks nice and will make the phone sit firmly on your car's dashboard while turning, this cover is great.  If you're looking for something that will last a while, you might consider something else.

Many retailers sell this exact same case under different brand names at different prices. The last one I purchased lasted me around 6 months. The "rubber" part of the one I had was too glossy and slippery and seemed to attract a lot of crud. The stand broke and eventually wouldn't snap back in place correctly. I ended up removing it.
As far as the buttons go, since the material is so stiff, it's pretty darn tough to press the buttons. I, and other reviewers, took a blade and cut slots into the sides of the buttons of the case for them to be easier to press.
As of this review this case is going for $6.99. Less than what I originally paid.

The Oneplus One doesn't have many available cases that are two-piece, or "hybrid"  cases for sale. Most cases available for this phone are one-piece,  slip-on TPU "sleeves."  I prefer these types of cases, but unfortunately there are just not very many to choose from, especially ones with stands of this kind. AFAIK, this case, and the higher priced Tudia case,  are the only ones available.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: it's pretty darn tough to press the buttons

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I bought this case back in January and it was a great case. It was slim so it did not add any bulk and felt comfortable in my hand. The other day I dropped it by accident for the first time and it landed on the corner. It broke the frame around the case and now it's hard to physically touch the buttons on the side. Would not recommend buying this product.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: ... this case back in January and it was a great case. It was slim so it did not ...

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
I really like the overall protection this case gives to the memory cards, but it is a bit oversized fo use with SD cards. We will be going to Europe this year and I wanted extra protection for my camera's SD Cards. This looked like it would do the job. There is only ONE criticism. It looks like it was designed to hold only 4 SD cards. That leaves a TON of room. I thought that with so much room, they could have made it fit 8 SD cards. My only thought is that in order to accommodate as many different type cards as possible, they did it the way they did. I will keep the case, as it was not really expensive, but I think that-  http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00D4AGNDG/ref=oh_details_o03_s00_i00?ie=UTF8&psc=1  - is a much better case.

UPDATE: OK... So now I have two criticisms. I just happened to open the case and 3 of the 4 SD cards were out of their slots. I reseated them and dropped the case on a carpeted floor from about 2 feet. ALL the cards were now loose. This case ultimately did NOT do a very good job of securing my cards. As I am typing this, the case is at my local UPS store being returned. I changed my rating from 4 stars down to 2. Not 1 star, as I am assuming that even though the cards were loose. the case would still protect them from moisture, etc. But I am NOT willing to take that chance now. Hence it is going back.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: IT WILL HOLD 4 SD CARDS .. BUT I HAVE UPDATED THIS REVIEW DOWN TO 2 STARS

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
It honestly is ok. I love it because it makes the phone lighter. And I have dropped it with it on and it has helped. I also have a front and back screen protector from zagg. The people that applied it for me actually trimmed the screen protector because they were aware that the case doesn't work very well with a non-trimmed film. So I would recommend finding a case first, then having the Zagg people trim accordingly (hopefully they would be helpful enough to be aware of this problem).

The thing is, I take the bumper off often to play music with an auxiliary cord (since every dock is meant for a iPhone 4 and the hole provided in the case does not fix an aux cord) and the bumper is already cracked in a few places. This is my second one in a month and because there was a severe crack in my first one after the guy put it on my phone they replaced it and it already is cracked from having to take it on and off.

Would not recommend if you are sort of clumsy with your phone, would not recommend if you take the bumper on and off a lot, but if you want some basic protection then it's fine.

Bought this from the Zagg counter at the mall. Sorry Amazon.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: for lightness and aesthetics its fine. But poor quality

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I ended up throwing this away after only having it a couple of days. I needed to get to the battery cover on the back of my phone and had a VERY difficult time getting this cover off. Had to use a flat head screw driver and in the process the case got chipped and the paint chipped off. If you don't ever plan on needing to take it off then I would say it is a good choice, but who doesn't need to have access to the battery! The color was also NOT the color shown here; though I liked the very vivid hot pink that it was.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Could not get it off my phone!!!!!!!!

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
I'm not crazy about this case - I'd say it's just okay. In my opinion, it's not designed all the well. It's very flexible in construction - that's not my personal preference, because it can get warped easily, and doesn't seem like it will absorb much of a shock if you drop your phone. It needlessly displays the Apple logo on the back of your phone through a hole that's not at all covered. Why? Sheesh! It just leaves that part of the phone to get scratched! The buttons are also difficult to press with the case on, and I found that my phone kind of pops out of it. Ugh.

It is true that the material is fingerprint-resistant, however, which is nice.

Also, it mentioned that it included a screen protector, but mine did not come shipped with one.

Overall, I would not recommend this case.

Disclosure: I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest, unbiased review. I am picky about product quality, claims and efficacy - receiving a discounted or complimentary item does not affect the outcome of my review.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Not all that well-designed or constructed

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: Button on the side stopped working unfortunately just outside of Amazon's return window. Now I have to squeeze my phone in and out of the clips without adjusting them. I did nothing abnormal to the holder, so I'm assuming that it is a manufacturers defect. Possibly cold temperatures did it, too. I noticed that the slides are harder to move when they're cold. Pretty disappointed that it only lasted a month. It did work extremely well before it broke, better than any other holder I've seen.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Broke just outside of return window

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
I bought this case in 2 colors, the white & the aqua.  I used the white for about a year before switching to the aqua, also for a year, & never had any problems, although I never dropped my phone on anything other than grass or carpet.

The fit was excellent for my Note 4, the ports were easily accessible, & the buttons pressed perfectly. I liked the color & style.

However. I'm giving these cases 2 stars because they failed to do what they claim: protect my phone.

Just a couple weeks ago,  while standing, I stuck my phone under my arm while trying to close my purse (bad idea) and my phone fell approximately 4 feet, flat on its face, on the sidewalk.
Right away I thought,  pssshhhhh, my phone will be fine... it's protected by an Otterbox & a high-end tempered glass screen protector!
Boy, was I wrong.

I picked up the phone & saw 2 hairline cracks on the lower half of my tempered glass. When I pressed the power key, the screen stayed black. The phone rang, but I couldn't use the screen to answer it. That night, I plugged it into the charger & felt the vibration feedback. Phone continued to ring as I received calls.

The next day, the phone no longer rang or buzzed. I tried calling it from another phone & nothing. I removed the screen protector & saw some cracks.

I'm extremely disappointed that the Otterbox, even backed up by tempered glass, did not protect my phone.  When I got a Note 8 to replace my beloved Note 4, I decided I would not be buying another Otterbox case. I read a bunch of reviews & watched a bunch of videos & decided on the Tech21 Evo Check. It's not available on Amazon as far as I know,  so I bought the white one from Tech21's website & the black one from BestBuy. I also bought the Whitestone Dome tempered glass (available on Amazon). Hopefully these new cases & screen protector will protect my phone better than those Otterbox Commuters.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Top-of-the-line case? Broken phone says no

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
Let me put this out there that I did receive this item on a discount. So with that said let me give you my opinions on this. This item is not great. It has a kick stand. That's about it. So why do I say it's not great? Well here's my list.
1) The cover that goes over the front has dotting on it. Very clear and apparent dotting.
2) Due to the covers more rubbery nature, the screen is protected but you can hardly Swype with the phone anymore.
3) I feel the front is protected from scratching, but the after having the phone for almost a year I haven't had any issues with feeling like the gorilla glass was going to get damaged. The back is just a piece of hard plastic and that's it.
4) I don't feel my phone is safe at all in this case if it were to be dropped.

Reason for two stars:
1) It has a kickstand. Hardly something worth winning over a person on a product, but hey it has that going for it.
2) Easy to put on.
3) If you are looking to protect your screen from scuffing, then sure this could be your case.

Overall:
I got this item on discount, but after using it for a day I put it back in it's packaging and threw it into a draw to be forgotten. I wouldn't suggest it to anyone. There are better options out there.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Skip This, You're Better Than It.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: Its really beautiful case but it blocks wifi and carrier signals. I checked this many times at many different place to compare wifi n carrier with case vs without case and i am 100% sure its blocking them. I would have given zero star if possible as your phone looks beautiful but doesn't work at all. Waste of money.

I was.  Love with this case at first... Slim, pretty and passed the waterproof test. I even wrote a review a few weeks after I purchased it. Now, only 5 months after receiving it I try to take a picture under water... I only sumerged the phone 2 inches under water level and when I took it out the water was inside... I panicked... Took the cover out and the bottom part broke... A day after that my phone has no sound, I can't hear any calls unless on speaker or with headphones. The phone thinks it has headphones the whole time. I am so upset because I am not up for an upgrade yet and I don't have insurance on my phone. I want to cry!!!

The case never charged. I tried multiple ways to press the button and charge it with and without the phone actually installed. Then when it barely did charge, I turned it on and instead of my phone charging, a popup on my iphone said something like "incompatible device detected" meaning it couldn't tell if it was a charger or usb connection or something else. the little peice that goes into the iphone bent, as its very hard to get the phone out of the case's grip.

The screen protector didn't fit my phone at all. The cut and fit of the screen protector was not for the Galaxy Note 4. It didn't even come close to matching the cutouts for the buttons, speaker or camera. While the material seems to be like most other glass protectors, there is no way for me to test it out on the phone because it doesn't fit. I wanted to give this a good testing prior to my review, but alas as this one didn't even fit my phone, there is no way for me to recommend this protector to anyone. The sticker on the product says Note 4, but the product on the front has the right number but not the right word. See picture.

If you do order this screen protector, double check to make sure it is the right one for your phone.

I received this product for free/discount for my honest feedback.

A have recently filed a complaint with the Better Business Bureau against T-Mobile. My story (real quick): I have a sidekick 2 with insurance on my phone. One day I started having problems with the phone. It just stopped making calls. I soon started to get an error message on the phone saying there was hardware problems and I needed to take it in. There was no physical damage to the phone. When I called T-mobile they informed me that there would be a free replacement since I did no damage to the phone and the phone was insured. I sent the phone back and 1 month later they had charged me for the phone. I called in to ask them why there was a charge and they tried to tell me the screen was cracked in half. Imagine my outrage. Countless phone calls to customer service and their management got me no where with the company. One of them even accused me of lying. As soon as I have the money to pay off my contract I am getting out of T-Mobile.

The screen protector leaves "bubbles", it doesn't totally adhere to the screen & it isn't anti fingerprint. I had 2 throw one of the 3 away already b/c I tried 2 adjust the screen & it wouldn't reattach correctly & it made even more "bubbles". Thanks for the free pen. I guess u get what u pay for.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: Purchased this set for my HTC Evo 4G as a back up charger to keep one at work, home and in the car. Received the product shipment within the promised time, quicker than I expected. However; when I went to use the car charger, it didn't work. THe LED light was lit up, but the battery did not show an active charge. When I went to try the USB data sync/charge cable, my computed didn't even recognize the connection. Nor did the phone sync or charge. I did not attempt to use the wall charger and instead contacted the seller. They replied immediately, thanked me for my purchase and apologized for my inconvenience. I was offered a full refund which was applied back to the card used as the form of payment. Product wise, I wouldn't recommend this purchase due to my poor experience, however; the immediate response, recognition of purchase and refund was handled so smoothly I would consider purchasing from this seller again.

Anyhow this awful item does not allow the stylus easy access.  So if you do not use the stylus, go for it.  Follow me down the fool path if you purchase this expensive Goodwill item!

If I would have seen this before I bought it, I wouldn't have got it. This really doesn't provide any protection. Its a very thin plastic cover that basically just protects again scratches. The plastic is already starting to flake off. Don't waste your money on this if you are looking for anything more than a scratch guard.

I'm usually wary of skins/wraps for my devices, and with good reason: they generally suck. That said, I grew tired of my bulky OtterBox case and decided to give one of these a try. I figured that in the 5+ years since I've bothered to try a skin, there MUST have been some advances in execution. Right?

Wrong!

Right off the bat, I noticed a half-crescent dent in the bottom of the back panel due to the idiotic way it is packaged. Secondly, it does NOT fit correctly. The cut-outs do not quite line up and one piece was actually too long, resulting in an overlap. For triple the price of what I could have gotten on eBay, I really expected better. I expected it to not look quite so cheap and to, I don't know, fit my phone. Finally, it did leave bubbles, etc. no matter how painstakingly I tried to apply these ill-fitting stickers. The only product claim that was true was that it didn't leave residue when I removed it from my phone to send back.

Avoid this product like the plague. I normally wouldn't bother returning such an inexpensive item, but in this case it was a matter of principle.

The metal plate in the case messes with the GPS.  I bought this case and really liked the look of it.  It fit well and didn't make the phone too bulky.  After some time I noticed things going wrong with the phone, in particular the GPS connection was very poor and often lost connection when in use.  This past summer (after some aggravation while traveling) I got to wondering if the metal plate on the case messed with the GPS.  Took the case off, haven't had a problem since.  Unfortunate because it is the nicest case I found, but it's not worth it if it messes up the function of your phone.

OK, this is an S4 case so maybe it's been sitting in a sun baked ISO container for a couple years, but my old phone is a trooper and works, fine. This case however, I've had for TWO WEEKS and it's literally falling apart at the seams. I'd give a better rating on "easy to hold" because ot was nice for several days, but the broken edges are now pointy and uncomfortable.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: The phone is more durable than the case.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: Bought this to convert a nano to a micro sim so I could gift an older phone to someone who needs it.  Very flimsy and nothing holds the sim in place, plus the sim does not sit flush with the adapter.  The tool to remove the sim card?  That didn't work either. The original Easy Flex just about handled my Droid Bionic + Otterbox Defender (big package). This one does not due to the thickness of the phone. Otherwise looks like another nice product. We'll use it for a different phone and will re-review later. Will have to buy the original again and hope it doesn't snap at the joint again.

Love the color (midnight blue), it's bulky but that's what I like about it, exactly what is shown in the picture. Complaint...the zipper does not work well on the wallet. You have to zip slowly otherwise the "teeth" do not close together. Semi-satsified, you get what you pay for.

This phone cover works well for my phone.  Fits well and easy to put on and get off.  The only thing I don't care too much for is this cover was photographed on a black HTC EVO.  I didn't realize that until I received the product and took a good look at the picture online.  I have a white HTC EVO, so this cover looks almost neon pink instead of the deeper maroonish type red it shows in the picture.  But it is a good buy for the price.

For one it took about a month to get here and didn't even give me the choice of faster shipping. The white paint around the edges looks like it got smeared and dried that way on one corner, but besides this it's a cute case, however, i don't think it will offer much protection in the long run.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: You get what you pay for, I guess

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: The only reason i give this one 3 stars is: layer 1 used to protect screen has so poor screen contact that it decreases touchscreen capabilities for your smartphone (writting messages or playing games was frustrating with it). At the end I had to remove it and add another screen protector. Also clip used to hold your cell with your belt is too fragile that it was broken within a year. On the other hand, silicone and policarbinate  cellphone shield are amazing. My cell has been so throwin to the floor several times and the only reason it is still intact is because of them.

Good: It fits fine.  Less work since you don't have to keep your old bezel or screen housing.  It's an okay screen, not quite as bright, and not quite as neutral color - slightly "cooler" blue-ish.  But not bad at all.

Bad: Does NOT include the GPS/Wifi antenna, ALTHOUGH IT IS VISIBLE IN THE PRODUCT PHOTO!
It is a flat metal sticker type antenna applied to the back of the screen housing (see picture attached), under the speaker and board on the camera side of the tablet.  You have to apply heat/alcohol and remove very carefully from the old housing.  Easy to miss, if you don't expect this, because there is no cable connecting, just some gold/metal contacts.  But you will notice you have no GPS lock, and weak Wifi reception.  I could not find this on ifixit or any guide on the web, just a forum post on android central pointing to the antenna.  Basically, I had to take apart a second time to fix it (after digging my old screen out of the trash!)
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Decent screen, Missing the GPS/Wifi Antenna!

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
After reading reviews and watching the installation videos on YouTube, I understood there would be imperfections that should clear up in time, and I am finding that to be true.  As suggested by a reviewer I did the installation in a bathroom after steaming it up to settle any dust particles.

The front cover installation was fairly easy.
I ran out of solution before getting to the back cover and was told by customer service to just add a little water to the bottle, and that worked. (I think I used too much to wet my fingers.)

The back cover is harder to install. It takes a bit or work to get all the cutouts for the camera, speakers and buttons lined up. The corners have to be nearly dry before they are tacky enough to stay down, so just leave them alone until then. The video did not include back cover installation, which would have been helpful.

There were streaks and bubbles initially, but here on day 2, most of these, including a quarter inch water bubble that was trapped over the Apple logo, have all but disappeared.

The screen appearance is crystal clear and finger prints and smudges are much less noticeable than on the bare screen.

When/if the bubbles completely clear up I will update my review.

I also received a coupon code for an additional screen protector shipped free,  which was a nice surprise!

Update: This update is long overdue, but I'm changing my rating to 3 stars, because the bubbles and imperfections never completely cleared up. I lived with it for a while and recently installed the complimentary one that I received. The result was even worse!  I really wanted this to work because it does provide good protection and I loved that it did not show fingerprints.  I gave in and bought a dry installed one instead.  I am leaving the back protector on though, because I don't have to look at it.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Very good full body protection from scratches, but...

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
This review is for the Innogie Air Thin 6600mAh Portable Charger External Battery Pack, Power Bank & iPhone Charger for iPhone, iPad and Samsung Galaxy and More (Pink)

Received this product and immediately charged it to 100%. I then charged a Galaxy Tab S 8.4". The tablet has a 4,900 mAh battery. The starting charge on the Tab S was 24%.

Device  Capacity  Start  % To Full  mAh used  Efficiency %
Tab S  4,900  24%  76%  3,724  57%  Power bank (PB) depleted.

Definitely not the best efficiency of all the batteries I own, but possibly acceptable. I will try a few more runs to see what the numbers add up to.
-The battery and tablet became warmer than when using other power banks (output of 1 and 2 amp). Not too hot that it worried me, but I feel that too much power is lost to this heat.
-There is no flashlight (which I prefer, regardless of brightness). If you have ever been in a blackout at night, ANY amount of light will be useful! -The build is nice and sturdy.
-Very nice looking aluminum housing. Another reviewer mentioned sharp edges, I did not not have this on my unit.
-The indicator lights for power level will only turn on when a charging cable is attached.
  --Checking on the current status of the PB is inconvenient.
-My wife really likes the size and color of the PB

I ordered this for its size. My wife liked another brand's size (but with very poor efficiency) because she could stack her Galaxy S4 on top and hold both while talking on the phone. I bought this hoping to satisfy her wish for a similar sized power bank.

I will update this review after doing a few more tests,

===== Update on Efficiency : =====
I have used the Innogie three times from full to depleted. The efficiency percentage has been 73%,54%, and 55%. If the PB does not get at least 60% efficiency, I will be requesting a return authorization.
===Edit==
I really am feeling a little leery that you cannot check the power level of the battery without having to plug in a charging cable. That is feeling like a deal breaker.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: So far so good...but not great. Will update. == updated, see end of review ===

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: I like many people was looking for an inexpensive wall adapter that would actually last me a while.  This seemed perfect as it had good reviews and the pink color matched the pink extra long charging cable I had. Unfortunately like other off brand wall adapters, it wasn't long before it died.  Youre honestly better off shelling out the money for a genuine Apple wall adapter.

Purchased these directly from the manufacturer as they weren't currently available on Amazon. Was hoping for a simple solution to protect the audio and charging ports on a Nexus 5x and Nexus 6p without special bulky cases, and picked these up as they are one of the few offerings designed for USB-C ports. The headphone plugs are decent enough; they fit snugly and fairly flush, but aren't difficult to remove. However, the USB-C port plugs are another story. They seem to be made of a different material than the headphone ports, and in the molding process they maintained quite a few errant 'strands' of excess material. This in itself is not an issue, but the tolerances of the plug itself are very poor, and only 1 of the 5 given plugs actually fit my phone out of the package without some minor modifications. Even then, some of the other plugs just fall out in use, making them wholly useless. At about $9 (I paid $7.35 with a 15% coupon) I feel like it's much too pricey for a product that only half works.

This case for the iPhone 5C is made well enough and I liked the way the black one that I bought felt in the hand but once I received it I realized that the cut outs for the volume/mute buttons are cut out way larger than necessary and the top of the phone is not protected because the case is open at the top. I realize these specifics are in the listing's pictures but I didn't look that close when I bought the case. I have purchased a lot of similar cases for several different iPhones I have had in the past but they all had a much more precise cut out for the vol./mute switch area and the top of the case was inclosed so that I had at least some protection for the top of the phone incase it dropped on it's top side.
For the price, there are better cases on the internet for less money.

This case is a beast, it takes drops and abuse like it's nothing.  But dust and lint beat it down!  The front screen cover has an opening that let's dust, dirt, anything small get in.  It feels like I'm taking it apart every few days to clean the inside of the case.  I'm sure there is a reason they left that open and closed up the Home button(5S).  But my screen being dirty inside the case drives me crazy...

That is my only issue with this case, but that is a big issue(I would have gone with something else if I knew it waqs going to irritate me so much).

If you don't have issues with lint or fine particles floating about, but need a beast of a case, get this case.  But it you like to keep your screen clean, beware.

PS: I never used the kick stand in the back, but it seemed to function as it was designed.
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: I want to love this case

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText: the handset  does not work with the sidekick 4g but it does work with the samsung gx2 it had a volume button but its no use for it being that it does not work the GX2 you can hear clearly and it very comfortable to hold when talking on the phone. the reason i did not give it 5 stars cause it said it work with all phones and it did not work on the sidekick 4g as well as the GX2

I am not so sure if its the quality or design as the phone is a slider.  The charger worked great.  The other case i bought for my girlfriends phone (triumph) is awesome so I tend to think its the way it has to snap on my phone.

Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.reviewText:
Android KitKat made some changes to how apps can use the SD card.  Unfortunately Google didn't give any of the app developers enough warning to adapt.  So, if you need to use an SD card stay away from KitKat.

With KitKat apps have very limited use of the SD card.  They can only write to restricted areas.  This is supposedly for security, but it's nonsense because the internal memory works freely.  This makes it so any app that used to write to the SD card is either broken or writing to internal memory.  Some developers may be able to adapt their apps to handle this issue, but that kind of development takes time.  More time than it would take Google to snap out of it and stop blocking SD card writing.  Not really a problem for Google Nexus users who don't have an SD card slot ...

Here's where the Moto G comes in:  The LTE version of the Moto G comes with KitKat and there is no older version you can flash back to.  So if you buy the Moto G LTE you are stuck with KitKat.  For that reason, I don't recommend the LTE version of this phone.

Unless rooting this phone will fix the issue I'm basically stuck with a brick and I'm back to my old phone.  It's a shame, because the Moto G worked so nice and smooth.  I would 100% recommend this phone if there was a way to get KitKat off of it.  I may update this review after I've rooted the phone.  If this problem can be fixed with simple rooting it would be more fair to give the phone more stars, but people should really be warned about this because not everybody can or should root their phones.

A Google-friendly explanation of the issue is at this link:
http://www.androidcentral.com/kitkat-sdcard-changes?pg=4#content

I was intrigued by the design and was in need of a new micro USB cable, so I gave this product a shot. The product came with a pretty nice package which included one micro USB cable, two metal plugs, and a plastic plank (to assist with taking the metal plug off from the device). I was quite excited and happy with my purchase at first, but after testing it out for a couple days, I realized how inconvenient this product really is. Below are the lists of pros and cons I found.
Pros:
1. There are two metal plugs. Didn't really affect me since I only needed it for my phone. Would be nice for people w/ phone and tablet or other devices.
2. The metal plug fit in the Micro USB jack perfectly. It clicked in tightly so I didn't have to worry about losing the tiny piece of metal plate.
3. The magnet worked well. It wouldn't come off easily when charging.

Cons:
1. The biggest problem I had with this product was that I had to bring this specific cable with me all the time if I wanna charge my phone when I was out. The metal plug fit in the jack so well that it's almost impossible to unplug it bare handed. When I forgot to bring the cable (and the plank to unplug the metal plug) with me to work, I couldn't charge my phone even there was a regular micro usb cable I could use...
2. It charged SO SLOWLY. Probably slower than charging w/ regular micro usb cable on a laptop.
3. The plastic plank is quite soft. I was struggling a little bit when using the plank to take the metal plug off from my phone. The front part of the plank already has some dents after being used only once.

At this moment I am going back to my old micro USB cable.
I like the design and the concept of the product; however, it is too inconvenient for me to use.

*Disclaimer: I received this product at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest review.*
Cell_Phones_and_Accessories.summary: Not as good as I anticipated...

I like to tinker with random projects in the garage, and for some reason, I really like to tinker with 12 volt electrical projects.  Recently, I have installed heated hand grips and an LED light bar on my ATV, LED light bar on my John Deere tractor, a linear actuator chute deflector and an array of other projects that all needed fusing.  Bring on the 120 piece Cal-Hawk variety pack!

The fuses came in a plastic case that leaves a lot to be desired.  The case has very cheap clasps and I broke one off after the second time I opened it.  The amperage rating on the fuses is very hard to read unless you get the correct angle or happen to be looking at the key on the box itself.  Those two minor issues aside, if you go to the hardware store and buy a 4 pack of blade fuses, they cost about a buck, so it's easy to see the value in this large 120 pack.

I also appreciate the variety of amperages the package comes in.  I have plenty to chose from for my custom wiring jobs and also all the standard amp sizes for my vehicles.  If you've ever blown an auto fuse before and had to run to the hardware store for a single fuse, you know how much of a time saver this will be.  5 stars for the value and variety, but go easy on the flimsy storage box so you don't play a game of 120 fuse pick-up!
Automotive.summary: Excellent value and variety, but go easy on the flimsy container so you don't paly a game of 120 fuse pick-up!

Threadlock or no threadlock that is not enough for me. Get ahold of your dealer to get the correct torque specs for your nuts and bolts. When I called their tech support I was initially told 110# for the rear end ubolt nuts. That didn't sound right so I had him check with an installer. He came back with 140#. That sounded closer but I called the dealer and for my application I needed to torque mine to 160#. Don't forget to get your torque specs for your front spring perches. There are no torque specs provided in the install instructions for any of your parts. Also the rear shock extender instructions are horrible. Tech support could not provide any clarity so I didn't use them and my truck is just fine. The ride was not affected. The end result the kit did what it is suppose to do. My truck is level and looks great. If you have a buddy that can spare a portion of their day don't shy about asking. I did mine by myself and it was work. Your alignment guy may suggest a camber kit to get you dead on. So far I have not had any problems with tire wear because the variance was so slight. Have fun and good luck.

Automotive.reviewText:
I got really excited when I saw an earthquake generator.  I am a seismologist, and think that would be pretty cool.  I could take it to the American Geophysical Union Meet or the Seismological Society of America meeting, and impress my colleagues with earthquakes on demand.  Could I control how big?  How does it work?  Is it like an explosion, or does it inject waste water deep into fault zones?  So many questions!  So few answers.

In the end, I discovered it generates electricity, but not from earthquake.  Actually, all seismometers generate electricity from earthquakes...moving magnet in a coil generates current.  But this is an internal combustion engine that converts chemical energy into kinetic energy; it is attached to a generator which coverts it to electrical energy.

So disappointing.
Automotive.summary: It generates electricity not earthquakes...way to disappoint a seismologist.

Automotive.reviewText: I wanted to give them a 5 star rating after I installed the passenger side until they DID NOT fit on the drivers side and I wanted to give them 1 star - the average is 3 stars.  Dorman claims these fit perfect.  They do, but only one side of your vehicle!  When something only fits on one side - its DOESN'T fit on the other side!  I replaced the seat heater pads on the seat bottom and seat back.  I ordered both Dorman parts (641-105 & 641-106) through Amazon.  Obviously with Amazon, great price, great shipping, etc.  Check out the You Tube video(s) I will upload shortly (under 'debandpete') on the actual problem/process with these.  One side went in without problems.  There are tons of videos on You Tube and instructions with the seat heater pad.  The problem is that since they are 'universal' and the wire does not come out of the seat heater pad in the middle - it comes out on one, which means that on one side of your vehicle it will reach the connecting electrical coupler underneath the seat, BUT on the other side of the vehicle it will not reach.  There are people that suggest pulling the supplied 'sticky tape' off and putting it on the other side.  DO NOT do this.  The seat heater pads are directional and designed to heat mostly in one direction.  If you look at the design close enough, you will see that.  The instructions even tell you to not put the tape side up to the upholstery.  If you flip the pad over and put the tape on what was the top and is now facing down, the heat will be going into the foam and not into you.  The answer ended-up being to simply route the electrical cord out the opposite side that the factory cable was routed through.  If both the seat bottom pad & seat back pad are both on the wrong side, then they will still plug into each other as designed and still reach the GM connector under thereat frame.  Sounds simple but wasted a lot of time, phone calls and of course happens on the weekend when Dorman was closed.  Dorman SHOULD add a simple paragraph to their instructions explaining this process.  Check out my You Tube video shortly!
Automotive.summary: Needed 1 Star and 5 Stars at the same time!

Automotive.reviewText:
COULD NOT INSTALL DUE TO BEING POORLY DESIGNED AND NO INSTRUCTIONS

FACTS, FICTION, AND SOME BS...

After some web research, I found that these "problem solver" poly bushings are actually made by a US company called Armstrong Distributors-  [ Dbl-U,Dbl-U, Dbl-U DOT armstrongdistributors Dot Com/indexDOT html ] (clean up this link or do a Google search).

The acronym "ADUS" on the plastic wrapper stands for "Armstrong Distributors United States". They are made in the USA, at least that's what they say.

My 98 Corolla is a daily driver with 100K on the odometer. It is NOT a low rider. It is in need of new control arm bushings, and since I never want to do this job again, I thought I'd go with poly and get a less mushy ride as a bonus. Oddly, I could not find any other choices for polyurathane bushings for a Corolla (one of the most abundant cars in the US). Go figure.

According to Armstrong, their bushings come in yellow or black. There is no physical difference between the two. I believe Armstrong said they were phasing out yellow. I also believe that Armstrong Distributors will sell direct to the public (please leave a remark if you find this to be false).

HERE'S THE PROBLEM....  I could NOT install these rear-mounted bushings on my 98 Corolla LE's front control arms, even with my new 12 ton press.  In order to press one into the control arm, you are forced to re-use the metal ring that encompasses the original bushing. That means after you press out the old rear bushing from the control arm and cut all the rubber out from the ring you'll be reusing, you must then press the Armstrong Poly bushing into the ring so you can press it back into the control arm. WELL FORGET IT!  These poly bushings are IMPOSSIBLE to press into the ring. In fact, you cannot press it in at all even after rounding the ring's metal edge with a file and using soap, grease, oil or any other lube. The bushing's lip just gets destroyed like mine did!!! Oh, and if that's not bad enough, the right side arm's front Armstrong poly bushing which I was easily able to install (the fronts go in easy), creeks like crazy over bumps. We've tried everything to fix this. No luck.  ARMSTRONG BUSHINGS ARE HORRIBLE!!! no instruction, no pictures, no help from company, no nothing.  I WANT MY MONEY BACK!!! Your results may vary.
Automotive.summary: THESE BUSHING ARE MADE BY ARMSTRONG, NOT AST!

Automotive.reviewText: At the top of Amazon's description page of any automotive part, a pop-up will come on and state: "Make sure it fits" your vehicle.  DON"T RELY ON THIS INFORMATION!! When it arrived, I took it out of the box and it became obvious that it was way too large for the windows for my Ford Ranger.  Upon reviewing the shipping information on the box, it was for a full size Ford 150 pickup.  I contacted the manufacturer to request information and found that the correct manufacturing number for the items to fit my Ranger was EGR 563041.  I returned the items to Amazon and am currently awaiting for Amazon to provide me with the full purchase price on my credit card.  I then ordered the deflectors, through Amazon, utilizing the correct manufacturer's provided number.  I got an excellent price, got free shipping, and they arrived quickly.  Unfortunately, when they arrived, they were broken in the package-apparently by UPS.  I will write a separate review on that item. I have found that several items I was interested in purchasing (in the automotive section) had incorrect information provided through the Make Sure it Fits info provided by Amazon.  If you are interested, definitely keep Amazon in mind for their pricing and delivery, but conduct your own research through the manufacturer's website or by phone contact.
