Musical_Instruments.reviewText:
Good and bad.
1- On the one hand the booster is one of the best I've tried and heard, it's totally clean, much more than the rc boost I have now achieved. Fatten your tone saturating the valves and achieve a simply beautiful sustain.
2- The truth is that the distortion is a little skinny, not as organic as it should and does not clean when lowering the volume of your guitar as promised. The girth knob removes attack on the tone, so you can not use it to fatten it as you want. It is noisy at high volumes, even with batteries.

In conclusion... this is a pedal with nice sound but nothing professional, does not serve as extra distortion to your valve-amp, yes like a floor sound, but forget but forget about using the neck pickup, it sounds totally drowned.

The instructions that come with this package are disappointing to say the least. PreSonus makes this way more complicated than it needs to be. This should be a fairly simple step-by-step process, but sloppy management of their product makes it quite difficult to understand which software you're supposed to install and exactly how to use it. I have to wonder if they do any research whatsoever before rolling out a product like this. Do they bring in a couple average customers, give them this package as delivered to a purchasing customer, then find out how easily they can figure out how to make it work? If the instruction manual were clearer (and had better pictures) then it wouldn't be a problem. But the manual is almost useless. This very well could be an amazing product. I don't know. I haven't been able to use it yet. I have everything set up and what I think are the correct versions of their software installed. But PreSonus has a real problem with how they tell their paying customers how to use their product, and it gives me pause about doing business with them again. if I figure out how to get this product to work, I'll review it again and adjust my rating accordingly. It doesn't need to be this difficult just to get it to function. I don't expect PreSonus to give me instructions on how to be Rick Rubin. I just need to get their product to work at all. I can't get the software to even acknowledge the included microphone. What does PreSonus say about this in the manual? Oh, simply "verify that your track is armed for recording." That's it. Well how the hell do I know what that means? Who do they think is buying this product? It's not Rick Rubin.

I wrote a review of the Mix5 in February and gave it 3 stars. After playing with the Mackie mixer for a few months, I've decided to knock it down a star. Even my little Behringer Xenyx Q302USB auxiliary mixer sounds nicer than this Mackie unit, in spite of the fact that the Behringer mixer doesn't have balanced jacks (except for the single mic input).

I suspect the preamps in the Behringer mixers are just better than these Mackie Mix-series preamps. If you want to go for sound quality, and can live without balanced main outs, I think you should go with the Behringer Xenyx 502. It has the added benefit of being cheaper than the Mix5.

I have never used any of the Mackie high-end project boards, meaning the VLZ series, so I can't make any comparisons to those, unfortunately. Some people absolutely swear by them. I'm not knocking them. But if you don't want to spend $100 on a 402VLZ4, I'd recommend going with the Behringer Xenyx 502.

I am a big fan of sennheiser products and have several headphones and cardioid and lavalier microphones from the company, but the MKE 400 is a let-down for the entire brand. First, it's poorly titled, because this is not a shotgun microphone in the most remote definition of the term - it catches just as much audio from in front of you as it does beside and behind you. Furthermore, if you happen to be recording anywhere that has any sort of HVAC system, even if it is barely noticeable to the human ear, this mic will pick it up, amplify it and make your audio absolute garbage. Sure, you can try to remove the hiss with a high pass filter in various applications, but the hiss is so incredibly strong that, in order to remove it all, you end up garbling up the dialogue you intended to record. Ultimately, this is not really any better than your in-camera microphone, and there are significantly better options out there from other, better manufacturers. To sum up:

Pros
-shock mount hasn't broken and doesn't noticeably transfer rattling to the microphone
-battery life is good, but it won't tell you when it's out
-plugs straight into the camera

Cons
-sound quality sucks like a vacuum (and sounds like one is running too!)
-no built-in high pass filter
-captures sound around the subject, rather than just the subject
-no live monitoring option
-looks, feels and is flimsy
-everything else

Buy a Rode or step up to an NTG2 or other alternative. Almost anything is better.
Musical_Instruments.summary: Perfect Mic for all those moments you just have to capture hissing

The XR8600 I purchased a few months back had a cheap feel to it, the knobs feel like they are going to come off if you so much as look at them, plus, the XR 8600 replaces older "wood box" models like the XR 696F, which was I.M.H.O. a far superior, professional-grade product, with more bands of master EQ and a ninth channel.  The new ones don't have that, plus only one output per channel (one for mains, on for main/monitor)  What, the cost of one more output jack per amp was too much?  At least they've corrected that design error on the XR8600D.

Now, regarding the PVI 4B:
It was defective right out of the box.  Two of the volume pots were binding, and channel #2 had a loud hiss, even when nothing was plugged into that channel.  How did this get passed Peavey Quality Control?  Maybe they should return to manufacturing their products in Meridan, Mississippi and stopped exporting the build (and jobs) to China.

really wanted to love this one. it was $180, and the look is just awesome. but, in studio and on stage, i am pretty disappointed and here is why...

other amazon reviews suggested that it is pretty good about plosives / pops, but it's really not. even in the video demonstration one of the top reviews posted here, you can hear it popping almost immediately.

as for live settings - with any sort of louder rock band - it picks up a lot of the drums, no matter where you're standing. it seems to get excited by the highs of cymbals in a way that it doesn't for just your voice. it's also not super directional, so you really have to eat it on stage.

i also don't recommend it for anyone using any vocal processing (compressor, delay) unless you are using in-ear monitors. this thing feeds back way too easily.

after giving up on it, i went for a completely uncool looking mic - the EV 967 - which has brighter highs, deeper lows, an all around more "studio" sound on stage - and seems to pick up my voice and only my voice, even when i'm right next to my drummer.

the Super Deluxe 55 seems to be much better about anti-feedback and side rejection. might be worth the extra money if the style is super important to you. but remember that while you are committing to this look, you are buying a microphone that you NEED to be RIGHT AGAINST to pick up properly, covering a huge chunk of your face in an unflattering way.

PS i kinda hate that this is labeled "The Elvis Microphone", but i guess that's what it is.
Musical_Instruments.summary: wanted to like it! bought it for the look, but here's the truth.

I've never felt compelled to submit a review for any of my Amazon purchases, but this expereince with Fender warranted some comments.

I ordered this guitar package from Amazon and received it in 3 days even with super-saver shipping. Great service from Amazon.

I opened the kit and was prepping to plug it in and try it out when I realized there was no guitar cable included - pretty useless without a cable. I contacted Fender and they mailed a cable at no charge, but it took them a week (7 days) to do it. Once I was able to actually test the guitar, there was no Volume control knob, only three Tone control knobs. Obviously the top control was for the volume and it had the wrong knob assembled to it. I also realized there were no "setup/adjustment sheet" included. I contacted fender about these additional errors and they said they'd send them. I received the paperwork with no Volume knob. At that point, I cut my loses (and headaches) and I returned the package for Fender to deal with as there were simply to many quality control issues with the package I received, and the Fender rep seemed rather "slack" about the whole deal, calling it a "simple error" and didn't consider it "poor" quality.

The guitar and amp themselves seemed okay (I guess), but I received the impression that Fender has some quality control/assurance issues that they're not real concerned about addressing, which lead me to wonder what else may be wrong.

Great price, shipping and return policy for Amazon, poor quality control and slacker attitude from Fender.

I have five cats and managing the litter boxes has become...interesting. This box is just what the doctor/vet ordered. All three of my cats LOVE this scratcher! I should have gotten more since they are constantly chasing each other off of it. It's sturdy and at 3" thick they won't be destroying it anytime soon. I love that it can be recycled after they destroy it and that it's sturdily assembled and arrived right in time! It comes with a bag of very finely ground catnip which I sprinkled on the scratcher.  Now comes my only complaint, I noticed when one of the cats moved the scratcher the catnip had gone through the spaces between the cardboard and onto the floor. Maybe the bottom should have been solid to prevent that, but then we wouldn't be able to flip it over when/if one side begins to wear down. Not a big deal since 2 of the cats and the dog love catnip and cleaned it up right away. Regardless the cats are leaving the furniture alone and when one of them isn't scratching it, then one of them are laying on it and purring like the happiest kitties in the world!!  I will update in a few months to see if their love affair lasts and if the scratcher holds up well. So far though this meow mommy loves seeing her fuzzy children so happy!

So it hasn't even been a month yet, and I have ordered a second one.  Not because there is anything wrong with the first one, but because my cats fight over it constantly!!  So far the first one is holding up well, but with three cats in the house there was always someone who wanted to scratch while someone else was taking a nap on top of the scratcher and then one would end up pummeling the other!  Now with two in the house there seems to be some semblance of peace restored in my home!  Who knew some cardboard would make them so happy!!  As long as it continues to hold up well and make it worth the list price of $34.95 I will be ecstatic!!

We have had both of our scratchers for 4 months or so, and my furry children still continue to use them as both a scratcher and a bed every day. Granted the cardboard has shredded some but when I vacuum  every few days I just pick up the scratcher and knock it a few times over a trashcan and it's good to go again! The scratcher is holding up great even with 3 kitties constantly abusing it with their claws.

~* UPDATE -- 8/2016 *~
Yes Another Update! We ended up with 3 scratchers in our house - which worked great since there were three kitties in the house at the time. Sadly :( one had to cross the bridge, but he loved his scratcher, (yes they all seem to have assigned scratchers,) until the day he left us! Anyway - it has been over 2 years since we purchased our first one, and even though it is a little worse for wear, it is still going strong! We haven't even needed to flip it over yet! We just knock the loose cardboard shavings over the trash can a few times a week and call it good to go! It took a few weeks for the third one, that belonged to our old, fat cat to be used by the other two - but now it is being shared by both of them as a secondary bed/scratcher. So it is still definitely worth the purchase price as far as I & my fur babies are concerned!!

I Thought I was paying for a name brand product that I usually get (Precor) but didn't catch that mistake until purchasing this knock off brand. I sprayed it on my cats and all it did was make the fleas more active due to its irritating effect. It did not kill on contact like it said it would. I don't recommend this product. You are better off getting a topical treatment from the vet if you want to eliminate the flea problem on your animals.

The breeder I got my kitten from told me this was all she used and that I'd "love it!"  While it's true that it doesn't put dust in the air the way clay does, that's all you can say for it.  The smell is atrocious and the pellets break down into sawdust when wet, which the cat then tracks all over the house.  Smelly sawdust, impregnated with cat urine and feces.  It spreads not only unwelcome odors, but bacteria, and no amount of cat mats or carpet under and around the box prevents the tracking.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Smelly and tracks all over the house

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: I recently purchased the 20-pound box rather than the 10-pound I usually do. For whatever reason, the difference in quality between the two sizes is egregious. I (and my guinea pigs) was very pleased with my first few purchases of the smaller size, but the 20-pound box I received is very dusty and leaves splinters in my hands when I go to handle it. Additionally, it has what appears to be branches of small shrubs that have been pressed flat - they are very large, brown, and tough and, again, leave splinters in my fingers. Do yourself and your pets a favor by buying the smaller sizes of this product.

Impossible to clean.  My cat can hang her bootie over the edge of the box and pee on the floor, which is why I bought this mat.  It does a good job of catching the pee and keeping it from streaming off onto the hardwood floor... but it does TOO good a job.  The mat is made to have nooks and crannies, the holes on the top are off-set from the holes on the middle section, which are then off-set from the bottom rubber.  It makes it impossible to rinse off, the pee just nestles into any of the crannies and hides.  I've tried washing in the sink with a stiff brush, soaking it in a bathtub full of bleach water and finally blasting it with a hose.  I cannot get the pee out of the crannies.  It also warped completely out of shape from the heat on my porch.  If it was made to completely come apart to clean each of the three components separately I would give it a higher review.  But the warping would still keep it at a 3 star.

I had this harness for about 2-3 weeks, using it about 4 times with my dog. One night I was unloading groceries and took my dog inside the house with the harness on.  She is still a puppy (11 months), but within the five minutes she was alone, she tore apart the harness. I was sad to see that the quality couldn't withstand a couple minutes of chewing.
Pet_Supplies.summary: I was sad to see that the quality couldn't withstand a couple ...

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: I've worked in the Veterinary industry for a long time, and my animals are my kids (no two legged babies). These are OK, but not the best I've seen. One word of CAUTION is that the glue burns. My wife accidentally got some on her skin and said it was a sensation like getting hot glue from a gun on her skin. Our cat is pretty compliant and he was digging at his feet after putting these one. Probably due to a foreign object being on them, but can't help but to think that it burns when touching his skin also. These are a decent option, just consider using different glue, and make sure you put ones on them appropriate for the size.

I was excited to install this product, especially after reading the reviews. We have two large and very energetic dogs, and we wanted to let them play in the yard more often, until we have our property fenced.

Installation of the product couldn't be easier. Simply plug it in, then walk around your property with one of the collars turned on in beep-only mode.  This will help you find the boundaries. Adjustment of the boundaries is simple via the boundary adjustment wheel. Once you are satisfied with your boundaries, mark them with the included flags.

Training the dogs was simple, using the included training instructions. After 3 days, my dog was trained.

However, I did notice a "dead" spot in our boundary. The collar simply would not  indicate it had left the boundary. Sometimes, after walking a dozen or so yards, it would immediately start to beep and initiate a shock, with no warning. I did not try this with the dog, but it would have been very confusing for the dog to try to find the boundary at this point. Since he would have had no warning, this simply would not do.

I also noticed the boundaries were very inconsistent. Sometimes by a matter of 5' or more. I could not reliably place the flags because the boundaries would differ so much from test to test.

I called PetSafe technical support, after 4 days of tweaking the system and training our dogs. PetSafe them began asking me a series of questions about placement and devices I had in my home. None of this was included in the pre-purchase information, the manual, or any of the technical information on the site.

Here's what it boils down to:

Do not place your transmitter near electronic equipment, including stereo speakers. PetSafe states 3', but when I notified the tech that it was approximately 5' away, the tech stated this may still be an issue. This should be printed in pre-purchase information.

The transmitter may be affected by certain types of WiFi routers. They did not tell me which ones, but this is critical information for a buyer to know. Practically everyone has WiFi in their home these days. Since they are aware of these issues, this should also be printed in pre-purchase information.

Finally, these transmitters are not compatible with wireless security systems, at all. The operate on the same frequency and I was told by the tech that this was likely the source of my problems. This can cause the transmitter to become unreliable, even shocking the animal while they are inside the zone. Essentially, these units are useless to you if you have a wireless security system. This is important information for the buyer to know, and a very common scenario. Since they are aware of these issues, this should also be printed in pre-purchase information.

The product seems decent. Easy to set up, easy to use, and clear training documentation for your animal. However, the lack of pre-purchase and post-purchase support information on product compatibility is very poor, and unacceptable for a product in this price range, especially given the time commitment required to get the system up and running and your pet trained. Because of this, I am only giving two stars.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Good product, but a warning to the buyer: It may not work at all for you.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I was excited to get this.
It is big enough for two small chihuhaha's, if you're having a party and are going to supervise them. However, the bottom vel-cro portion will come off and my dog figured out how to open it within two days. In addition, he figured out that he can jump through the top of it.
So, it really does not stay enclosed; however, we have had BBQ's in the yard and have been able to put him in there for short periods of time. Eventually, we started using it with our 14 year old dog, who has lost his vision and tends to run into the wall. It is perfect if you have a senior dog or a dog with a disability and don't want them to wander around the house.
Other than that, your dog will hate being in this cage and try to break out. Cute idea, but not effective.
Pet_Supplies.summary: It is perfect if you have a senior dog or a dog ...

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: I could only give 2 stars because my dog would not eat these. I tried breaking them apart but he still wasn't interested. He is not food motivated so I wasn't too surprised by his reaction. Since he wouldn't eat these "treats" I can't say if they really work or not.  I gave the container to my son whose Boxer was more than happy to have them.

The medium is fine, but I am not able to write a "product" review for the small because my review was rejected because only reviews about the "seller" are allowed.  Here's my review:  The "T" part of this is not extendable, and I found that to be too short for my dog.  It pulls on her legs and she has cuts under her arms now.  It was also hard to get over her head, though once I did it was fine.  The two measurements (neck and girth) were correct, but the "T" being too short made it tug at her legs too much when she moved her head.  Maybe that's the intent, but she won't wear it.  I got the medium instead, and it's large around her head (so I worry it will slip off) but the small is too small.
Pet_Supplies.summary: order up a size if your dog has a long neck

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: I have this for my mouse and it is okay, but it does contain molases and other things I cannot pronounce. It's an okay food, but not the best. (Also, the mix I have has these in the mix, as far as I can tell they are the exact same. I would only feed one of these once a week. Fresh veggies, mealworms, yellow millet, (not white) and quinoa are the best and most natural way to go. Oats are also good, my mouse likes those!

Beware that thus unit doesn't come with the carpet piece as pictured. No finish on it but that's in item description.  It assembled fairly easy but the bottom router cut wasn't perfect on one side. It still sits level though. I had to remove the cut out insert to get poop to actually fall into bag. This bagging technique doesn't block any oder. I had to rig up a piece to block the lower area were bag hangs from cat access.  Not sure if all cats will try and shred the poop bag but ours did. Terrible mess. For the cost this platform needs some design adjustments to make it great.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Could be great with some work

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: Read all the reviews before buying. Managed to get the x-large over our 72 lb Lab female head but after she's worn it a few days I feel it is really too tight around her neck. There is no adjustment for the neck part. Just took if off to brush her and don't have the heart to put it back on after tugging if off her head. Very disappointed. Her hair has stuck to the material also and there's no getting that off so it doesn't look as nice as day 1 either. Also no hookup on top for leash so really doesn't work in lieu of a collar.

It's litter. Cat's will use it. But really, are you sure you want them to?
1) No odor control.
2) Creates an ungodly odor when mixed with cat urine. I would go so far as to say it's vomit inducing.
3) It sticks to the bottom of the box so that you're "going at it" at every angle to scoop it off the bottom. I have some sturdy scoops - they've held but but we've worked at it together to clean that box.
4) Gooey sticky clumps.
5) Too light that it just flies across the room - tracking it everywhere in the house

Yes, it's environmentally friendly. As we were trying to transition to this (and we've used it for about 3 months now) we recently purchased clay litter again... we have 5 boxes in our house (yes, insane, I know) 3 in the unfinished basement and two on our main level. There are 2 out of 5 boxes with clay.... they're the ONLY boxes the cats are using.

I agree with them. Once the litter's used, it's gone!

I thought this would be a wonderful way to carry my 10-lb chihuahua mix. Unfortunately, she hates it. The bottom is unstructured and the material is cold and slippery so my dog does not feel safe and comfortable in it. She immediately tries to climb out and up my chest. That certainly defeats the purpose. Maybe if the bottom had a more structured shape and the bag had a removable fleece lining, she would have liked it better.

I bought this system just before Christmas for our two cats.  While it significantly reduces the odor and the mess, we go through one cartridge every week to 10 days.  With a 6-pack of refills costing about $100 plus shipping, that means I am spending over $50 per month (and possibly up to almost $70!) on CAT LITTER!  There is absolutely NO WAY this product costs more than a few dollars each to make.  While I really like the product, I really dislike the price, and if the pricing doesn't go down in the next couple of months, I will be looking at other brands/options.

I wasn't happy with this product. It leaked through the padding and attached to my dog's paws, so when he walked away it spread the mess around. I have 120 lb senior dog and thought these would do the job since arm and hammer makes such good products. Maybe these are more suitable for a smaller dog with less waste? I did like the size of the pad and that they are blue trimmed to differentiate front and back. I went to COSTCO and ordered their pads, which were remarkably better, in my opinion.

This feeder sits so close to the water that the food gets wet fairly quickly. We first tried fitting it to the back of our tank but the bubble stone made a mess of the flake food. We then  moved the feeder to the front of the tank, as far from the bubble stone as possible. Still collects moisture but not as bad.  The actual feeder door doesn't open consistently so your fish will go hungry from time to time. The only good to say is the about the timer. Its easy to set up. Just don't trust this thing to feed your fish every day.
Pet_Supplies.summary: not worth the wait or the money.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I've been using this Diatomaceous earth for a few weeks. I started with a tsp a day and am now up to a tablespoon, sometimes 2. I don't notice all the effects people claim, yet, so perhaps i haven't been on it long enough? As far as the product and taking it goes, it is as described; kind of muddy water when mixed with water.  I don't find it unpleasant at all... tasteless, slightly chalky, no issues. So, I don't know if this particular brand is better or worse than any other. Anyone care to chime in about that? I wouldn't mind some advice as to what you find best/superior. In the meantime... waiting for my skin to glow, to feel over all better, and all the other amazing claims. I'll keep taking it religiously until I come to a truer opinion then will update. So, 4 stars for easy to take and no issues.

UPDATE on 3/27/15:

Thought I'd report back. I'm changing this to a 2 star because I honestly feel no different than I did since starting it about 4 months ago. I take it daily. I won't order more. Maybe it just doesn't work for my personal system? Who knows.
Pet_Supplies.summary: I don't know if this particular brand is better or worse than any other

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
OK what's the deal.  Why did they change the formula????  First I have to say that when I bought the 90 count old version of the Oxbow vitamin c they were much cheaper by $3 not to mention 90 count vs this 60 count.  So we are getting less and paying more.  Great.  Also, my daughters piggy's have grown to like the old version.  It took a while but they now like them a lot.  I have not tried this version but looks like it's the only option out there unless we go the liquid route.  Thanks Oxbow for changing a perfectly good product.  Ive given this a 3 star rating even before trying the product because of the reduced quantity, higher price and new formula.

Update 12/22/14:  Ended up ordering these because it was my only choice besides the liquid. Well the pigs love them and have no issue gobbling them down.  So good job with that.  However, after looking at the ingredients they cut the potency in half.  It went from 50mg to 25mg.  So I'm changing my 3 star rating to 2 star for not only offering less quantity and increasing the price but for also cutting the vitamin c potency in half.

Took my Golden Newfie all of 4 hours to surgically remove the squeaker and all of its stuffing. He has now proceeded to shred the rest of the poor fish into tiny peices of fabric. I had hopes that this one would last at least a day, but I guess it's back to searching for another plush toy that can't be destroyed by him. Two stars because he loves it, otherwise not worth the $17 I paid for it unfortunately.

Well gosh, I hate doing this but I've had a problem. When I first got the collar I thought it was Amazing because of the good build of the product and the collar being waterproof. And wrote a review to that effect. After using for a week, I could only get the collar to go off on three occasions when he barked. I turned the sensitivity all the way up to its most sensitive setting which is 'T' for Test Mode. No luck. I put the longer probes on to make sure there was contact. I tested it in both vibrate and shock modes. I could get it to go off but it was difficult.
There was a letter in the box asking that any problems be resolved through the vendor instead of writing a review like this. Well, I emailed them at the address given (support@masterpup.com) three times. I waited and waited. No response. I got it for a good price and had trimmed the collar. So, instead of returning it to Amazon, I just wrote it off and bought a more expensive collar from another vendor.
Well, today 6-29-16 I got an email from JESSICA thanking me for posting a positive review about the product but I posted where your supposed to post seller reviews. She asked me to please post a review here. I'm sure Masterpup is a good vendor and the collar is probably a good product. I believe I just got one that had a defect in sensing a bark. Oh, my dog is 75lbs and has a very loud low bark. I just wish I had been able to resolve my problem another way.

It looks like decent quality for the price, but two of the three upper posts have broken off. The first break was repairable with gorilla glue but it's totalled after this last break. I've had it about a year. It's a little unsteady too and the cats have knocked it over a couple times (6lb and 10lb cats). It was the perfect size for our small apartment and the cats loved it but I'll definitely spend more on the next one in hopes of better quality.

I had used this collar years ago for another dog
but maybe their manufacturer has changed since this collar rejects the citronella when I try to fill it.
If I wanted citronella all over my hands I would simply buy a cheaper option for sure!
I got new batteries thinking it didn't have enough power to work correctly
alas that didn't help the situation.
Could be a fluke or just a sign of the times.

I'd hate to give a bad review, but my cat does not look forward to dinner time when this is on the menu. She absolutely hates the flavor and refuses to finish her food when I put this out. I unfortunately will not be buying again. I love all the natural vitamins and minerals it provides and wish that my cat would eat this stuff, but what am I to do? My cat goes on hunger strikes when she sees this stuff!
Pet_Supplies.summary: Lots of natural vitamins and minerals, but flavor needs some work!

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: So its cute I will give it that. I bought them for normal size weiner dogs and for another small dog. So I guess you get what you pay for. How they are made is weird and I waited forever on these I ordered 3 so they could all match after an hour they were ripping. And the card they send you to complain and going to website it is impossible to read due to the nature of the language.  Maybe some can read it but I cant. So honestly I am not really happy with this product. I would look at others first before you buy here.

The fabric on this harness is really soft and breathable.  However, I wish it had an elastic band around the neck.  It's like dressing a small child, I have to practically force it over my little dog's head.  Once I get it on, there's room around her neck, so I know that she can breathe.  And then when I take it off of her, same thing, I have to turn it inside out and force it off her head.  It scares her.  I like it enough and will use it to strap my pup down when she's in her booster seat in the car, but I don't care for it too much.  The strap around the body is a bit big, but it works.  I am more nervous about the neck area.  If they start making it with an elastic band, just giving it the slightest stretch, I'll buy another one.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Sturdy and functional, but there's no "give"

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
My dog loves this toy! But it is not indestructible. It really depends on how much of a veracious chewer your dog is. Mine is a 30lb schnauzer mix and he was able to chew through the material of this toy just the same as all his other toys. That's why I gave it only 2 stars. My dog is relatively small and he chewed right through this toy!

Update : It's been a month now and the toy is NOT completely destroyed, which is surprising for my dog. He really does love this toy so I gave it one more star. And only the wings have been partially chewed off. Just be aware that this toy is in no way indestructible and it depends on your dog.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Not indestructible: varies from dog to dog!

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: The metal seems really cheap, almost aluminum like. I ordered the medium play stand with the ring and it seems a lot bigger than I originally thought so get out your tape measures and find a place for this before you buy. Also, there is no bottom grill to keep the bird from hopping down to the bottom of the stand on top of the newspapers, which is my amazons favorite thing to do. Other than that though, for the price it is good, and both my Eclectus and my Yellow Naped Amazon love to play on this.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Few things to consider before you buy.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I read all the reviews - I wanted this sytem to work for me, but...
FYI: I have 2 cats (normal sized). I bought 2 boxes, as instructed.

Pros: Works as promised; urine easily flowed thru pellets onto pad.
  Pad (in each box) lasted 1 week, however, I began to smell it on he 7th day (badly).
  Pad never had "overflow" or "spillage" in drawer.
  Cats probably thought the system was weird (new type of litter) but took to it rather quickly.

Cons: One cat insisted in scratching all the pellets to 1 corner to cover poop (defeating purpose of pellots to drain urine thru).
  Had to add slightly more pellets every few days since they stuck to poop (even when poop had dried out) and because cat moved everything over to corner. Poop stuck to other pellets and I had to try and fish them out too.
  To change the pads earlier than 1 week, I realized that for 2 litter boxes, I would be spending ~ $5.00 every 2 weeks just in pads. PLUS, I kept having to add  pellets.

This system did work, just not for me. My little cat is not fanatical w/ covering poop  with normal clay clumping litter - I just think he was weirded out by the pellets.

style.Flavor Name:: Puppy Chicken, Sweet Potato & Pumpkin Recipe

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: My puppy doesn't seem to like this flavor as much as others.  We feed our other dog Nature's Recipe Lamb & Rice Adult, and our puppy always wants to eat her food, so we switched the puppy to the 'puppy' version of Lamb & Rice and she gobbles it up!  I mixed the last of per pumpkin food in the new bag of Lamb & Rice and she picks out the pumpkin pieces and eats the rest.  Sorry to say...
Pet_Supplies.summary: My puppy doesn't seem to like this flavor as much as others

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
This is not the marvelous deterrent I'd hoped it would be.

When I got the mat, I immediately added double-sided tape to the top of it as an extra measure against my cats.  They are constantly getting up on my kitchen counters and stovetop in search of food, or who knows what else.  I am a stickler for clean eating and food preparation surfaces, so the idea of nasty litter-box feet all over my counters was disgusting!

I bought the mat, and my cats pretty much ignored it.  They would stand on whatever piece of counter top wasn't covered by the mat, step over the mat, and be on their way. Several times in the middle of the night I'd hear it go off, and come downstairs to see that the cat is standing on the mat, not a care in the world for the ridiculously loud beeping going on.  I mean, if that sound could wake me up while I'm on an entirely different floor and sound asleep, shouldn't it bother a cat's sensitive hearing?  Apparently not.

That, or my cats are just spiteful jerks who are purposefully setting this thing off....

Anyway, really all it does is prevent the cats from LAYING DOWN on the mat, and that's only because of the tape.

I did notice that the mat really scares the bejeezus out of my dogs when it goes off, so I'm keeping it for those times when we don't want them in a certain area, such as on a patch of freshly shampooed carpet or somesuch.
Pet_Supplies.summary: so the idea of nasty litter-box feet all over my counters was disgusting! I bought the mat

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I purchased this item at a reduced cost to give my honest opinion.
I put brand new batteries in the unit.  I have a fleet of five dogs, my mom has three.  I have a yellow lab that loved the comb because it scratched so hard, but she didn't have any mats.  I have two maltipoos that my ex-sister in law got from a breeder (grrrr) and wanted to dump them when they became dog teenagers and chewed.  So one has curly hair, the other straight.  I tried it on the curly hair.  It just didn't have the power to cut through the curly hair to get to the mats in his fur.  The noise made him uncomfortable, but not scared.  One of my mom's dogs is one of mine that is in retirement now.  She gets mats and has soft, straight hair.  The comb did get the mats out, but it took a few attempts to clear out the hair because the hair clogged the comb.  Overall it is a good product, but it needs more power or different blades for the cutters, maybe alternate serrated and straight blades (they are circular).  So my advise is great for straight haired dogs, not great for curly hair dogs.  I have not tried grooming myself for summer with it....yet! : )
Pet_Supplies.summary: Great for straight haired dogs with mats, not great for curly haired dogs at all.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText: don't see why this is being sold as a hamster cage - hamsters are ground dwellers from the deserts of the Middle East and would not enjoy this habitat. easy to assemble - once you realize you need needlenose pliers to close the loops holding the thing together, C clamps or some other device to keep the wire portion of the cage firmly attached to the base, and some serious bending and reshaping to keep the doors firmly enough closed to keep your critters securely in the cage. glad my rats are pretty mellow, as this cage wouldn't stand up to rough treatment - pretty flimsy. I expect I'll need to replace in 6 months. even on sale definitely not worth what I paid.Ware Manufacturing Chew Proof 4-Story Cage for Hamster

I thought with mostly high reviews that this item would be absolutely adorable and had high expectations for it. I've always spoiled my cat and she has lots of beds, but I thought this would be perfect for her and even though it was just under $27 plus another $15 for shipping, my cat was worth it, so I decided to spend the extra money (more than I've ever paid for with a bed for her) and get what looked like an adorable bed!

I was highly disappointed upon receiving it with the quality for what I'd paid for this bed. Upon opening the box, the frilly fabric on both ends had long strings loose EVERYWHERE, so needless to say, I had to cut those excess strings off so it did not become a hazard to my cat if she got hold of them and ingested them. Then I discover that the vinyl bottom was coming loose in MANY areas from the foam bed itself. I in turn super glued the vinyl to the bottom of the foam (which I should NOT have had to do) but contacted the seller (Rowland Direct Wholesale) as I only saw this as a temporary solution and really poor quality that I'd have to go to these lengths to "fix" a pet bed that I paid enough for that I expected A LOT better quality for.

The seller's reply to all this was to provide pictures. I told them that is kind of hard to do when, as I'd already told them in my 1st email if they would have read it, the strings were removed IMMEDIATELY before my cat even got the bed as it provided a hazard to my cat if swallowed, so I told them it's not possible to provide pics of that but since the vinyl was super glued back onto the foam, that too is hard to take pics of unless they wanted me to try to pry it apart where I'd super glued it and then have to either "fix" the bed again OR have a more damaged product than I had to begin with. Their response was something along the lines of they would check into the issues for the future and if I had further questions about the item to contact them back by email again.

So really the seller was of no help at all. At no time was it asked that I return the horribly made product to them in exchange for getting a different one sent and also a replacement was never offered.

I advised the seller I will NEVER order anything from them again if this is the quality with which things are made from them when I paid a significant amount of money and that for what I paid, I should have gotten a better quality product. In the emails, they never directly replied to that comment even though it was said several times.

My cat LOVES the bed- if you choose to purchase this product, I'd advise anyone about the pillow it comes with as there is a rhinestone on the pillow on the ribbon that could easily be chewed off and become a choking hazard - my cat is always trying to chew at it, so I have to keep the pillow facing down so she doesn't chew it off and swallow it and have it become a choking hazard. As I stated in my title for this review- cute concept, horrible quality!

I will NEVER order from this seller again with the lack of help and lack of good customer service, and would honestly never recommend this product. I know of someone else who ordered the same bed and got it around the same time as I did and they had the EXACT same issues with the quality of the product-- so knowing it was not just me that got a faulty, horribly made product, I would never recommend this product since you expect better quality when you pay this much or at the very least better customer care- the product and seller failed in both those areas.

My 95lbs Bernese Mountain Dog totally ripped off the straps along the collar within 5 minutes of having it on. I sewed them back on myself but never used it again. It fit nice and much more comfortable than a plastic cone, but in the end he is too long for it to have made a difference since his wound was near his butt. Probably would work on a dog that is smaller or less likely to tear away at a cone...
Pet_Supplies.summary: It fit nice and much more comfortable than a plastic cone

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
Well when I received this in the mail I had high hopes the nozzle they provide didn't work well so I swapped it out with a nozzle from a mist bottle that helped to disperse the water a little better than just a stream but if you're looking to mist this will not do the job the pump is just not strong enough they should have done a little more research on the power of the pump needed to give you what the product calls itself Habba "MIST"
After 3 days I noticed that the water that it sprays onto my plant and glass for my reptiles dried up quickly but it was making a lake under the Repti- Bark so I took it out and bought a waterfall which is much better the waterfall keeps the humidity up just have to make sure it does not run dry
hope this helps you make your choice
Pet_Supplies.summary: Close but could have been better

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I love this bed. My dogs however, do not.

I was getting real tired of standard dog beds getting flat and lumpy too fast, requiring frequent replacement. This got me to thinking, my couch cushions don't need frequent replacement, why don't I get a dog bed made of that! Then I searched form some beds on Amazon and found a MEMORY foam dog bed. Even better! Old Rufus can sleep like a king on his own doggy Temperpedic!

Wrong

My dog friends have emphatically decided that memory foam is terrible and they would rather lay on the rug or even the hardwood floor than use their new bed. Ungrateful.

Dog preferences aside this bed seems well made. They probably deserve a better rating from me. But then again, it's made for dogs, and my dogs hate it. So, 3 stars!

I have 4 cats and 3 dogs, so treating all of them for the mites has been a challenge! Otomite appeared to work on a few of the pets, but on a couple others, it seemed they got worse. Pet_Supplies.reviewText: We first tried this on a camping trip in August in an area with deer flies. We put it on our two weimaraners, on their backs and ears, and haunches. It did a good job keeping flies away for a day or two with one application, not bad. But one dog licked at the ointment and started to drool a lot and seemed to have trouble swallowing. This cleared up after we washed off the ointment, but took at least 24 hours for the symptoms to stop. The other dog did not lick the ointment and was fine. I think the key is to use very little of the product at a time, and put it where it cannot be licked. Start out with a small test on your dog. I really think flies make life miserable and this does repel them.

Just because the toy is a hit with cats doesn't mean customers should be ripped off. So, four stars for a great toy and one star for the price. Pet_Supplies.reviewText: This is the very definition of a mixed bag.  First, I've tried a variety of crystal litters over the years after my elderly cat nearly died from a bladder infection.  This type seemed to work the best.  Smaller beads are better than the larger ones because they give you a greater surface area which means faster absorption.  So that part's good.  Second, within the last ~4 months I've noticed that my bags of litter do not last as long as they used to.  Easily tracked via my phone's calendar.  The weight per bag hasn't changed.  I can't figure out if it's suddenly absorbing more urine or if something else is causing it.  Either way the net effect is that the litter doesn't last as long as it used to.  Third, and this is the reason this review is not 4 stars, their packaging blows.  I regularly ordered these from amazon, generally two at a time.  Out of the last 8 bags I ordered only 3 made it to me without the bag popping open during transit.  Amazon was very accommodating and kept replacing the burst bags.  That was excellent.  Unfortunately what I *really* needed was for some of those bags to actually reach me intact so I could change the @#$^ litter.  Not dropping crystals on the carpet or in the entry to my apt building would be a plus too.  Amazon actually removed this item from their store for a while (according to the customer service rep I last talked to) and was supposedly investigating the packaging.  Well, it's back, and I just changed my litter today so I'll try ordering again and see if I can get an intact bag to me in the next 3 weeks.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
We rescue/rehabilitate/train Irish Wolfhounds.  About 20 years ago it would have been unheard of for new owners to give up their $1,000.00 plus dogs -- especially as puppies.  But now for various reasons, which can include buying something they've always wanted, not understanding what they are getting into, or because of a change in circumstances, younger IWH's are being put up for adoption.  This year we have rescued two hounds and refused two others, all under the age of 17 months.  Rescuing/adopting an IWH reminds me of Forrest Gump talking about his box of chocolates, you never know what you're going to get.

One of the first physical problems we notice is the tartar buildup (or yellowing) on their teeth.  Evidently many owners don't understand how important dental hygiene is for a hound's quality of life.  This is easily fixed by buying either raw femur beef bones or natural white knuckle bones.  Since we are usually trying to sort out their diets and/or food allergies, we always start with white knuckle bones.  We avoid the barbecued/colored bones since they stain just about everything they touch, especially since our IWH's live with us in our home.  Outside might be another story but any  flavoring could prove to be problematic as far as potential allergies.

It is really amazing how quickly these bones can eliminate any tartar build-up.  You  must exercise caution when giving any dogs something to chew.  Occasionally pieces can break off and be swallowed by an enthusiastic dog so it is very important to supervise your dog(s) when giving them anything to chew or play with.  Chew toys thought to be indestructible often aren't.  It never ceases to amaze me what strong aggressive chewers are able to accomplish once they put their minds to it.  Some Irish Wolfhounds are "shredders", tearing up rugs, doggie beds, boxes, pens, or just about anything within reach.

We've had good luck with these Redbarn Natural White Knuckle Bones.  Our hounds get to chew on them from 10-15 minutes every day before we pick them up.  Anything longer and they get bored with it so the bones typically live to see another day.  While we prefer to use raw bones instead, these are a good way to get your dog's tartar buildup under control.  After their food allergies are sorted out, feel free to give the raw bones a try.
Pet_Supplies.summary: You Too Can Rescue A Dog Breed Of Your Choice -- Just Be Sure That You Know What You Are Getting Into.

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
Posted this back on Feb 16, 2016. Happened to be updating some reviews and noticed that this was here anymore though the link to it was still available. Reposting.

We had a neighborhood stray cat and at the start of winter, I was really concerned at how she would do in the cold. At first we tried just creating a shelter for her. While searching Amazon for another option, I came across the K&H Outdoor Kitty House. It was close to perfect.

I've seen a lot of the questions people asked and I want to say that mine came with a plastic flap that attaches to the back with Velcro. This allows the cat to be able to enter or exit via either side. This is really important is places that may have predator's as you don't want the cat to be trapped inside.

The heated pad does work. You do need to put pressure on it to feel the heat. When I first plugged it in at home, it did not feel warm to me. I followed the suggested steps and put a throw pillow on it. Within minutes, I could feel the heat on the pad. After I set it up, I checked it after the cat stepped out and it felt warm inside the house, even before I put my hand on the pad. The construction of this house seems to do a good job of retaining the heat. Between the heat from the pad and the cat's own body heat, it seems pretty cozy. Not warm like if the cat was indoors, but that isn't aways an option with strays.

It did take a day to get the cat to go in the house. We had put out some blankets that the cat was sleeping on and I took one and put it in the house so that the cat's scent was there. That seemed to do the trick and the cat has lived there all winter.

The only reason for four stars instead of five is that I wish the cord was longer. I read different things about using an extension cord. After going to Home Depot to get an extension cord, I spoke with someone from the correct department and felt confident that using the proper gage extension cord would be safe. I also purchased a cord cover, Farm Innovators Model CC-2 Cord Connect Water-Tight Cord Lock - Green for some added safety and have had zero problems this winter. With this plugged in since about the second week of November, I have not noticed any different in the electric bill.

It is pretty good with rain and snow if you can put this in a spot that offers some protection from above. I also angled it so that the wind is never blowing directly in the opening. During the snow, it is easy to put this up higher.

When I purchased this in November, it was about half the price it is now ($77 as I'm writing this - $45 when I purchased it). I wish the cost wasn't almost double as I wish more people would invest in something like this to help make the lives of the local stray's a bit better. I do recommend this for anyone looking to help an outdoor cat who needs some help from the elements.

If this review was helpful, please click yes. Thank you.
Pet_Supplies.summary: Helps Make Our Neighborhood Stray A Little Happier

it's small and convenient to pack in the doggy travel

Pet_Supplies.reviewText:
I'm a dog trainer for a local rescue, and was asked to test this product as a means of helping our volunteers walk the dogs that pull so hard they're hurting themselves or the humans. Harnesses are not an option for most shelters due to disease control methods...we must unfortunately (for now) use the harsh nylon leashes we can bleach multiple times a day. Anyway...after reading instructions and testing this device on almost 50 dogs (we have more but those were our 'pullers') ....let me tell you...there is NO effect on pulling on any of these dogs. Not one. Not after a solid two week attempt. About one third of the dogs do seem to hear the device - indicated by a head tilt or ear twitch. But a reduction in pulling? Zilch. Save your money for more effective training aides...or buckle down and do it with positive training alone.

I did not test this device as a training aide for any other commands, as the literature states it could also be used. I tested pulling only.

Henry Fonda did a great job in this early World War II film where he portrays a Canadian corporal who suddenly finds himself in charge of a combat patrol in the Sahara desert when their sergeant dies. The title refers to the late sergeant, whose words of wisdom occasionally come to Fonda's mind throughout the film as Fonda is deciding what to do now that he is the leader.  The central focus in the film is the corporal's character as he evolves from someone who is unsure of himself and lacks confidence to becoming a mature person and able soldier who finds the inner strength to be a decisive and effective leader.

This is a lovely video about the United Kingdom from *Families of the World,* and like the other films in this series, it's all about two kids, their families, and their daily lives. Jessica lives on a dairy farm in the west of England with her extended family on their ancestral lands, plus some they rent from Prince Charles. She is a cute kid who is almost overshadowed in her video profile by the adorable animals whom her family raises (primarily very young calves, at their most engaging). James is 10 and lives in Bath, an ancient seaside resort that is part of a modern city. The kids in our family were intrigued by James's narration about the freedoms that British subjects enjoy, which the kids recognized from our own Constitution. They were taken by the beautiful place where he lives and by the mix of the very old and the very new in his life and Jessica's.

Our kids noticed the differences in what people call everyday items (biscuits for cookies, orange squash for an orange juice drink, football for soccer) and were intrigued by the lives of two children who live surrounded by architecture and culture that seem much more storied than our own. This was a good issue to discuss after we all watched the video: What does it mean when we say a country has a culture? What does it mean if a country has a state church, but also has religious freedom? How do the freedoms of these English kids differ from our own, and how are they the same? The Teacher's Guide included with this video has other useful information about activities, history, and a complete transcript of the video narration, which is done by two kids and is in English. (My friends who are ESL teachers love these videos, because the narration is straightforward, interesting, and easy to follow.)

If you go on YouTube, two trailers are available from this video, one for Jessica's section of the film and one for James's: "Families of the United Kingdom (Families of the World)," Rural Trailer and Urban Trailer. Well worth watching, as is the full-length video. This is one of my favorites in this great series.
Movies_and_TV.summary: An interesting and charming visit to two families in the UK

Movies_and_TV.reviewText:
Back in 2007,Robert Redford made a film about the Iraq War in which he starred and directed entitled "Lions For Lambs".Despite co- starring with Meryl Streep and Tom Cruise,it became both a critical and commercial flop as it was talky,verbose and lacks a central theme. It took him a while to star in another film as he's done documentaries and directed films. Then he starred in a political thriller "The Company You Keep" and finally starred in a film as the lone cast member in "All Is Lost". This film written and directed by J.C Chandor is about a man who tries to survive after he finds himself trapped in the sea.

Redford,who is simply known as "Our Man",finds himself in the middle of the Indian Ocean. When his sailboat collided with a ship container,he finds the floor of his yacht flooded. This only requires him to abandon it and leave on a ship and try to survive many obstacles in the middle of the sea like a tropical storm,the absence of navigational and communication systems, and lack of food.

This triumph of this movie is the fact that Robert Redford at his age of seventy-six years when it was made has shown that he still has the ability to carry a movie on his own. Also,he provided a memorable performance - probably one of the best if not the best in his career - as the sailor trying to survive being in the middle of the sea considering the challenges he is facing. Despite the fact that there isn't much dialogue in it and many questions aren't answered like why is he alone in the sea,J.C. Chandor provides us an thrilling and entertaining movie that deals with survival in the sea. No question that Redford has gladly rebounded from Lions Of The Lambs and still has the talent to wow his viewers on the big screen.
Movies_and_TV.summary: Robert Redford Remains A Great Actor After Many Years

I've done my time in rural Texas and in urban Texas too.  Tender Mercies, Duvall's brilliant film about a country western singer got it absolutely right.  And this film, The Apostle,,is bold, uncompromising and unforgettable in its portrayal of a minister who truly loves the Lord whom He serves, and will not give up his ministry and his vocation even when his own faults nearly destroy him.  This is a remarkable departure for "Hollywood" which so often presents evangelical and other conservative Christians in a cynical nasty light with shameless abandon.  The film affirms faith; it's complex; careful; fascinating, and completely gripping.  All performances are terrific, and Duvall of course is The Apostle through and through.  This film brought me closer to God, and closer to commitment to God.  It's also a film that non-believers will find entertaining and beautiful because it is so well done.  Highly recommended for viewing and for gift giving.
Movies_and_TV.summary: Brilliant, Honest, Moving and Christian in the Truest Sense

Richard Roxburgh (Dracula) definately stole the show. He had such a presence (and fine presence that is) on the screen that litteraly put me in a trance. He was too pretty to die (But then he died when he was that ugly demonic bat- so that was ok. I would have been upset if Van Helsing killed him when he was his pretty self). I would have to say the David Wenham (I hope I spelled his name right) was also quite ammusing in the film. Roxburgh and Wenham are the two that really made the movie.

I went through this whole dvd and each day I realized that my fear of public speaking was just a hoax in my head. Scott does a great job of explaining and giving good pointers to talk clearly to get your point across while also emphasizing the importance of making a connection with your audience. Im going to recommend this to everyone who has dealt with public speaking issues. I wish I could give this video 10 stars!!!
Movies_and_TV.summary: Clear and great way to learn the best skills!!

Movies_and_TV.reviewText:
This movie gives a gritty look at the racism faced by many, and a protaganist who is struggling to over come his many years of misunderstanding with his neighbors of different ethnicity.

One of the biggest complaints I have heard about this film is the acting. Eastwood made this film focusing on a Hmong (pronounced mung) family living in Michigan - rather than cast Hollywood no-names to inaccurately portray the Hmong, he cast all Hmong actors with little to no acting experience. It really is an interesting story - the Hmong acting in the movie that is - and it made me quite a bit more understanding about the weak delivery on some of the lines.
Movies_and_TV.summary: Gritty Eastwood Film - not for the faint of heart

Movies_and_TV.reviewText:
As has been said, this film is truly a masterpiece. It's director George Cukor's first film in color, and  full of brilliant acting, singing, set design and cinematography. The "Born in a Trunk" sequence is spectacular.
Judy Garland was "dismissed" from Annie Get Your Gun just a few years before she made this movie (she would face a similar fate in The Valley of the Dolls shortly before her death; ironically, Patty Duke's character, the brilliant, boozing Neely O"Hara, is said to be based on Garland). But she recovered and made this, perhaps her best, film. It was a phenomenal, almost unbelivable comeback, one of many for her. When you watch the scene where her character loses it as she, on the set of a film she's making,  discusses her husband's battle with booze and his failed career, you can't help but wonder how she managed to get the words out, because she could be talking about her own life. But as grief-stricken as she is, the show goes on, which she demonstrates as she wipes away the tears and performs "Get Your Long Face Lost." It's almost chilling, certainly moving, absolutely one of Garland's finest moments on the screen.

One word: AMAZING!  This movie is one of the greatest films ever!  It revives the swashbuckling pirate adventure flim genre where the last good films of this genre were made decades ago with the likes of Errol Flynn.  There is a little bit of everything for just about anyone...action, adventure, romance, awesome digital effects, etc.  As I sit in my dorm room, longing for finals to be over, I think about the time when they will all be over and I will be able to watch this awesome DVD during winter break!....this DVD is totally worth it.  Do not be disinclined to acquiesce to my request....buy the DVD, savvy?
Movies_and_TV.summary: You Would Be a Cursed Pirate NOT to Buy This DVD

Movies_and_TV.reviewText: I'm a teacher is a juvenile detention facility.  When I first introduce Glee to classes, a lot of the boys whine and grumble.  They think it's a show for girls or pansies.  But it is not very long before they are all engaged.  If the plot doesn't first get them, the outstanding musical performances do. Eventually they are all interested in the story and the characters.  The show is very funny, clever, interesting and pushes the boundaries.  Each episode has a positive message (or messages) that underlies the plot.  All of the characters are interesting and believable. Some are classics. Jane Lynch (Sue Sylvester) is a treasure. Even though their are plenty of homophobes in my classes, they seem to develop compassion for Curt (the "gay kid") after watching the episode when Curt tries to shield his father from pain caused by anonymous homophobic coward. Some of the writing is outstanding.  The common theme that underlies all of the episodes is acceptance, overcoming obstacles and working hard to accomplish something worthwhile.  The result is immense pride.  Since I've shown these episodes to multiple classes, I've seen each of them myself countless times.  Nevertheless, I can't stop watching and enjoying this show.  I love it!  Since it's chocked full of music, watch it with a great sound system. (The music is highly varied....from classic rock, standards, & broadway show tunes to a little funk and hip-hop (the better of that and not too much.) I can't imagine anyone not liking this show IF THEY PAY A LITTLE ATTENTION.
Movies_and_TV.summary: Glee Excells for Entertainment that All can Enjoy

I really can't say that I can tell that much difference, but still love the movie.  It is very entertaining and thought Keaton was very good.  I would say that you would like to watch the science fiction, thriller types of movies to like it though.  Just an FYI, that there are 2 of these movies.  This one and a sequel.

Drew Barrymore is convincingly both strong and insecure as Cinderella and she makes the movie both believable and fairy-tale like.  This may seem like a contradiction in terms, but see it if you want to understand.
At times sad, dramatic, funny, and romantic, this movie is sure to become a timeless new spin on a classic love story.

One more film about lawyers but a useful one. One more film on pollution but a necessary one. Yes lawyers may believe in what they are doing : fighting for justice, even if justice does not exist really, just, at best, some damages for some damage, one tooth for one mouthful of teeth lost by the fault of someone else. No hope to recuperate your eyes, not even one, when you have been blinded by the corporate delinquent that lives on the other side of the road. No hope and yet some lawyer maybe might be on the track and might catch that delinguent corporate criminal and get some damages for the damage he caused. But there is such a narrow chance it may work, you may prefer to, you might have rather stop the whole machine and cry in your corner, try to forget the damage for which no damages will be enough. This film is so pessimistic that the last page of it does not erase the feeling that there is no hope on this planet, and that we can only hope to die fast and in not too much suffering.

Dr Jacques COULARDEAU, Universit Paris Dauphine, Universit Paris I Panthon Sorbonne

Movies_and_TV.reviewText:
D.O.A. is a film noir drama film directed by Rudolph Mat, considered one of the best classics of the genre.  D.O.A. reflects the photographic roots of director Rudolph Mat. He compiled an impressive resume as a cinematographer in Hollywood from 1935 (Dante's Inferno, Stella Dallas, The Adventures of Marco Polo, Foreign Correspondent, Pride of the Yankees, and Gilda, among others) until turning to directing in 1947. The lighting, locations, and atmosphere of brooding darkness were captured expertly by Mate

 "Film noir" refers to a genre to refer to films that highlighted the seamy side of life and carried a cynical message.  It typically has certain stylistic (night shots, rain, shadow) and plot (good mix of shady characters. femme fatale, double and triple crosses, ordinary person makes a bad choice, & results in a fatalistic ending.
.
The frantically paced plot revolves around a doomed man's quest to find out who has poisoned him and why  One of the film's many ironies is that his last desperate search involves him in his life more forcefully than he has ever been before... Tracking down his killer just before he dies  discovering the reason for his death  turns out to be the triumph of his life

"DOA" starts with a bang. An accountant (Edmond O'Brien) shows up at a police station and reports a murder - his own! In flashbacks we learn the details as he tries to track down how he was murdered, why, and by whom. Along the way we meet his secretary (Pam Britton), a crooked businessman (William Ching) and his secretary (Beverly Garland), and a gangster (Luther Adler) and his chief henchman (Neville Brand).

Location shooting was just coming into vogue in the early 50s. "Side Street" (1950) gave us an up close noir look at New York and this film does the same for San Francisco.

This film is mandatory viewing for fans of film noir, and a pretty good mystery thriller for the rest.

SPOILER ALERT

The film begins with what a BBC reviewer called "perhaps one of cinema's most innovative opening sequences." The scene is a long, behind-the-back tracking sequence featuring Frank Bigelow (Edmond O'Brien) walking through the hallway of a police station to report his own murder. Oddly, the police almost seem to have been expecting him and already know who he is.

 Marla Rakubian threatens Bigelow when he comes to her for information  A flashback begins with Bigelow in his hometown of Banning, California, where he is an accountant and notary public. He decides to take a one-week vacation in San Francisco, but this does not sit well with Paula Gibson (Pamela Britton), his confidential secretary and girlfriend, as he does not want her to accompany him.

Bigelow accompanies a group from a sales convention on a night on the town. At a "jive" nightclub called "The Fisherman," unnoticed by Bigelow, a stranger swaps his drink for another. The nightclub scene includes one of the earliest depictions of the Beat subculture. The next morning, Bigelow feels ill. He visits a doctor's office, where tests reveal he swallowed a "luminous toxin" for which there is no antidote. A second opinion confirms the grim diagnosis, and the other doctor implies that the poisoning must have been deliberate. Bigelow remembers his drink tasted strange.

With a few days to live at most, Bigelow sets out to untangle the events behind his impending death, interrupted occasionally by phone calls from Paula. She provides the first clue: a man named Eugene Phillips had tried to contact him but died the previous day, purportedly a suicide. Bigelow travels to Phillips' import-export company in Los Angeles, first meeting Miss Foster (Beverly Garland) (whose on-screen credit reads "Beverly Campbell"), the secretary, and then Mr. Halliday (William Ching), the company's comptroller, who tells him Eugene Phillips committed suicide. From there the trail leads to Phillips' widow (Lynn Baggett) and brother Stanley (Henry Hart).

The key to the mystery is a bill of sale for what turns out to be stolen iridium. Bigelow had notarized the document for Eugene Phillips six months earlier. He connects Phillips' mistress, Marla Rakubian (Laurette Luez), to gangsters led by Majak (Luther Adler). They capture Bigelow. Since Bigelow has learned too much, Majak orders his psychotic henchman Chester (Neville Brand) to kill him. However, Bigelow manages to escape.

Bigelow thinks Stanley and Miss Foster are his killers, but when he confronts them he finds Stanley has been poisoned tooafter having dinner with Mrs. Phillips. He directs them to call an ambulance and tells them what poison has been ingested so that, in Stanley's case at least, prompt treatment may save his life. Stanley tells Bigelow he found evidence that Halliday and Mrs. Phillips were having an affair. Bigelow realizes that the theft was merely a diversion. Eugene discovered the affair and Halliday killed him.

Halliday and Mrs. Phillips used the investigation of the iridium as a cover for their crime, making it seem that Eugene Phillips had killed himself out of shame. However, when they discovered that there was evidence of his innocence in the notarized bill of sale, Halliday murdered anyone who had knowledge of the bill of sale. Bigelow tracks Halliday down and shoots him to death in an exchange of gunfire.

The flashback comes to an end. Bigelow finishes telling his story at the police station and dies, his last word being "Paula." The police detective taking down the report instructs that his file be marked "D.O.A."
Movies_and_TV.summary: Action packed in the traditional fashion. A high-concept movie before its time

Movies_and_TV.reviewText: This is my 4th order of this Cathy Smith DVD - I ordered the first (in videotape) in 2001 as a jump start to weight loss and distance running, and it worked wonderfully.  I've used it over the years in a variety of ways:  as part of a regular program, as a way to get an aerobic workout in winter weather, as a way to regain fitness.
