I got 5 free with the handle that I bought,  it works great.  You cannot return this product.

This is not the real McCoy.  It is not even packaged in that CM signature box (which should have been my first clue!).  I sprayed some on and knew right away.  The REAL Elixir of Love (the seller even misspelled it!) has a soft almost grown up baby powder scent.  This one had such a strong cheap alcohol odor.  The cap was even a fake.  Kudos to Amazon for making good on a seller pushing a knock-off.
All_Beauty.summary: Not the real Caswell-Massey's Elixir of Love

All_Beauty.reviewText:
The sponge rates a 5 but the cost is so out of line that it makes impossible for me to buy new supply here...thus it is really a zero raring.
The description of this sponge is very accurate based on my experience.  I love the sponge for application of very thin liquids....tinted moisturizer and BB/CC creams.  The sponge is surprisingly soft yet absorbs little product.  It goes on your face not wasted in the sponge. Glides smoothly even in tight spots around nose and eyes. The white side is for application while the black side is great to buff to air-brush like finish.  Easy to clean, can use soap and water.  Best to always use clean sponge for great results.
Problem is the price listed here.  Way, way, way too high.  Needs to at least meet competition or preferably less. Then suggest you stock up so you have plenty of these amazing sponges suited to thin liquids.  Let the sponge do the work, not your fingers and get lovely finish and clean hands. Beautyblender and brushes seem better suited to foundations, blush, eye shadows etc.  It appears to be a matter of density.  I find the Sephora sponge best for thinnest liquids.
All_Beauty.summary: Right on Description... Dollar cost way off!

All_Beauty.reviewText:
I bought this stick instead of the Neutrogena Wet Skin Kids Sunscreen Stick that I've been using for the last 5 summers.
Comparing descriptions, this stick has all the same components but the stick is a little bigger and wider  so I decided to go with it instead. But something is not the same...
I tried it before going to the beach on my face just to see if I could use it a an every day face sunscreen and my face broke down in million itchy bumps (I did not even went outside that day.)
It was to late to go get the other kind and we left for our vacation. l applied it on my girls, my husband and myself, and we all got a bad rash and sunburn, on our first day at the beach...
I stopped using it and only used the Neutrogena Wet Skin Kids Sunscreen Spray for the rest of the vacation, applying it on our faces by spraying some in my hand and rubbing it in. Not ideal but better than getting burn and itchy.
Too bad it can not be returned...
All_Beauty.summary: and we all got a bad rash and sunburn

All_Beauty.reviewText: the first time I tried the recommended dose.  The second time twice the recommended dose.  The third time I took a mouthful or about a third of the bottle because it was doing nothing.  Still nothing after the big swig.  So with half a bottle left, I am returning the item for a refund.  Very disappointed because I was really hoping this would be a good natural/non-perscription method of helping with relaxation and better sleep.  sigh........the soich continues.
All_Beauty.summary: the first time I tried the recommended dose. The second time twice the recommended dose

All_Beauty.reviewText:
I love water flosses, and because my love to this kind of devices, on April 28, 2013 I have ordered a WaterPick WP-100.  I received it in Miami and carried it to my country.  After unpacking the unit I have followed the instructions stated in the enclosed Manual.  I plugged the device, turn it on and poured a small amount of water into the sink.  It worked fine, but when I tried to use it on my mouth the device did not started any more.  I have tried to contact the manufacturer through its web customer service and I did not get any response.  After that, over the web page, contacted the company through the chat service and I didn't get any solution.  To send back the device to the States is quit costly, almost the same value of the device, therefore I have sent it to be repaired by the local representative.  The problem is that the plaque that rectified the alternate electricity burned out, because it was a defective.  The repair cost me more than the amount I have paid for the device.  The repair was $U 1,500, equivalent to US$ 75.  Will Water Pick Inc. reimburse me for the repair cost?  If its service is the same the answer I have got in relations to my inquires, for sure not.  Anyway, I'll try.

June 5 up-date: I'll like to actualize the information:  Early this week I have send a message to Amazon describing the problems I feced with the Brand new the WaterPik.  They immediately answer my request and bring a prompt solution and make me a refund to cover the repair.  Now I'm using the device and it works fine.
All_Beauty.summary: Stop working in the first use!!!!!  Was repaired

All_Beauty.reviewText: I purchased this item twice and received both of the items with the same defect: the stem is loose. The whole stem rocks back and forth to the point that it is unusable. Unfortunately, short of removing the glued on mat at the bottom (and damaging the item), there's no way to screw it in. Since the reviews are generally excellent and thinking this may be a one-time defect, I ordered a second one (there was no exchange option available on Amazon) and the issue on the second item was identical. So I will be returning both. 05/06/16: Per my comment below on this review, I have attached a video for reference. This video was created using the second stand that I purchased. I did not initially include the video as I did not think it was necessary; however, since Jessica, the representative, is stating that it is a 'shipping' defect, this may be helpful in showing that it is actually an assembly issue.

The T970 from NORELCO is the sorriest trimmer i ever ran across.

The writeup of this product gets one to think that this is a real great product, but it turns out to be a "dog".

When I turned it on, after charging the battery, I thought the thing would fall appart in my hands.  It does not hold a charge and all around is not what I expected for NORELCO to put on the market.

 recommed not to purchase this thing.

Why isn't there an option to leave zero stars?

As soon as I put water into the tank, it started to leak.  How do I know this?  I had walked out of the bathroom for no more than 20 minutes and came back to find a puddle of water on the counter.  The culprit?  The bottom of the wand.  Drip....Drip....Drip.  I never even used the thing (I did follow the directions to prime it) so I have no idea how well it works to actually clean teeth.  However, I can assume that it cleans teeth about as well as it holds water.  Oh wait!?  It doesn't even do that!

My old hot air brush died and I couldn't find the same model, so I tried this one. Sadly, it's going back. I don't know if mine was defective, but this puts out very little air, even on high. After spending twice as long as I used to with my old brush, I still had damp hair. Finally I had to break out my regular hair dryer and flat iron. For me, the benefit of the hot air brush is to dry and smooth in one step. This item did neither.

So, I take a nice hot shower and shave every part of my body. I have an incredibly sensitive bikini line so I knew I would need to use something to keep from getting those horrible razor bumps. I use bikini zone and I'm ready to welcome my boyfriend home from a long hard day at work. We start having our fun and next thing I know I am smelling the worst fishy smell of my life.  At this point I am done. I just want to shower and get this smell off me. My boyfriend had to scrub his hands for a good 5 minutes and he looked SO grossed out. I have never had an issue with my scent so I explained it was the product and how embarassed I was. I washed the product off and used coconut oil instead. I don't know if the creators of this product want to ruin your extracurricular activities or what but it certainly ruined ours... and scared the hell out of my boyfriend. Skip this product and avoid smelling like the seafood restaurant.
All_Beauty.summary: Foul, fishy odor is not a good look when this is used for your bikini line.

All_Beauty.reviewText:
Yes, doll heads are made to work on, but who in the world would want to purchase one that looks as if most of her hair has been pulled out!!  The hair is EXTREMELY thin and is NOT 18", you can look at it and tell it isn't that length.  The doll has a "growth pattern."  The hair has been made to stay in one position making it impossible to style (that's why you only see the French bad in the other pictures posted by other "buyers."  Do yourself a favor and research a better doll head.  This one is good enough for a 3 year old "stylist."

Feel free to Refer to my pictures as proof.

And the doll smells fishy.  Yuck!!!!

Just got it and I start it up for the first time and its already broken. Fill it up to the line and drop in the oil and go to plug it In and as I plug it in to the unit it sparks....yeah. No thank you. I don't wish to burn down my house cause of a faulty piece of junk. Returning. If I could give it zero stars I would.

I usually do not buy magic things that make all your problems vanish but this time I wanted to believe. But I was Very Wrong! The device is utterly and completely worthless, even after trying to hold on to one hair for 20 minutes made no difference whatsoever - when I finally pulled the hair, it felt like using tweezers. Add the fact that keeping the jaws together is a hard labor and the patches do absolutely Nothing and you have yourself the worst known (to me) product on the market. Now that all the negative reviews have hopefully kept the Amazon shoppers safe from this comes next step - BBB.

I have used Lotil for many years but I am extremely unhappy with the new bottle. Within a week the top came off along with the spring. The top of the new bottle does not easily come off like the old bottle did...so,short of,sawing the bottle open, I have lost $30 some dollars worth of product. I buy the larger size for the value. As much as I hate to give up my Lotil cream I will not order again unless the packaging changes.
All_Beauty.summary: The top of the new bottle does not easily come off like the old bottle did

All_Beauty.reviewText: Do NOT buy this product. Do not buy from Infinite Surplus. These are FAKE, COUNTERFEIT products. The blades are duller than rusty tin can lids and will tear the flesh off your face. The orange lubricant strip that is on genuine Gillette blades and works wonderfully is nothing more than a cleverly colored piece of rubber on these forgery knock-offs. Demanding refund and disgusted that these prodcuts are available on Amazon.

I have had this razor for perhaps 6 months and wish I would have had the sense to return it within the 30 days allowed.  The main problem is the low speed at which this razor runs.  Previous Norelcos that I have owned ran at much higher speeds and cut far more efficiently.  The 7140 is hell on the neck, particularly with a 2 day growth and tends to pull hairs rather than cut them.  I would pass on this razor unless you have a light beard.  Don't ignore the 30 day return policy if you do decide to try this razor.

The product seems to be of good quality but it would not suction to the shower wall very well. Tried several times following the instructions but it just would not hold up to any weight being placed on it. Our shower is not tile, it is fiberglass. Very smooth but maybe it would do better on tile which is less porous.

This product makes lips tingle upon application, which is not my major complaint.  After wearing it for a couple of hours, it causes lips to feel dry and flaky, even when I applied it with Lip gloss after application.  I have since tried Revlon 24 hour lipstick which stays on at least 24 hours, and doesn't tingle or cause that dryness.  I would not recommend this product to anybody when there is a better and less expensive option out there.  I wasted my money.
All_Beauty.summary: Product caused dry and flaky lips.  I do not recommend this product.  I found a better option (in my review).  Wasted $20

All_Beauty.reviewText: I used the reviews on line to select the Waterpik Waterflosser Ultra. I used it and liked it very much...at first. It is compact and was effective, with a great choice of pik heads. One evening about three weeks into using it the darn thing slowed down on its own, sending a spray with hardly any pressure. The next day there was no pressure. The pik no longer worked! After 21 days of use it no longer works. Amazon won't take it back. A waste of money. I am now looking for a better product.

I'm very disappointed in this product. I was so excited to receive and use it as I do my own nails. This is my first electric file so I am unfamiliar with the techniques and product all together. I watched many videos on how the thing works since there weren't too many instructions for it. I liked the fact that there is a turn dial to adjust the speed and the plan was to start at the lowest setting. The lowest setting is extremely fast so I never turned it up to even see what the highest would be. The first time I used it, it scared the shht out of me because the speed was so high at the lowest setting and I burned myself, ruining my nails. My nails are really ruined! Therefore I haven't used it much, I continued to use my hand file in fear of hurting myself. I decided to practice on one of those fake hands because I thought I ruined my nails out of inexperience. As I got better with the hand on the lowest setting I decided check out the highest setting using it and found that IT DOESNT CHANGE! It's permanently set at the HIGHEST SPEED no matter where you turn the dial To say the least I'm pi$$ed and its too late to return. Now I have to buy another so I can use it as I planned.

Ok, for something advertised as non-irritating and calming, this toner burned my skin like the dickens and leaves it red for hours afterwards. Also, it's a tiny 4 oz bottle, smaller than any other toners I've purchased (ok, i guess thats my fault if it said that somewhere in the description), but I really think $20 is high for what seems like almost a travel-size container of toner. This is the first Paula's Choice product I've tried, and sadly, I'm not impressed. I think I'll steer clear of this brand going forward.

Had this for about 2 years now and its pretty good. It has a nice vacuum feature but some hairs still escape the vacuum, but it's beats cleaning up the entire sink!  What I like most about it is the option to plug in to AC directly and not have to wait for the charge.

Probably the best trimmer out there from what I researched.  Two years later still don't have the same features for new trimmers.

Buy one.

Very good shaver.  Battery life is outstanding.  I'ver had it for over a month and only charged it twice.  Very comfortable on face and neck- I've haven't gotten that typical razor burn you get with an electric shaver.  I have sensitve skin so this shaver works well for me.  However, it isn't as close of a shave as my last Norelco or the company claims it to be.

  Overall I would recommend this product :)

Flossing is terrible. Admit it. Your options before were jamming thread between your teeth to dislodge food particles or lying to your dentist (Yes, I swear I floss daily. No, I don't know why my gums are bleeding profusely!) I bought this because I tend to get floss stuck between my extremely tight back teeth (I know, quit bragging).
This thing works. Period. Only downside is the fact it's a fairly big appliance. I keep mine in a drawer, because I'd rather take up half a bathroom drawer with this than floss again.

Purchased for a Halloween costume.
They seem like OK quality for the money, and stretched well to fit my large hands.
If you have long nails - I'm talking any extra length whatsoever - be very careful putting the gloves on, because they will catch on every hole, and then your nails may want to poke through the mesh at the fingertips. I had planned on snipping off the tips to show off my manicure, so that isn't an issue for me. If you're leaving intact for wear, I'd recommend filing your nails short an rounded for comfort/convenience.

This sunscreen is amazing -- has the leading mineral sunblock ingredients (titanium and zinc), but leaves far less white residue than my second favorite sunscreen with the same ingredients (Neutrogena Baby). But this stuff is prohibitively expensive for me -- the Neutrogena sunscreen works just as well and costs about $9 a tube when not on sale. In sum, amazing sunscreen - just too expensive.

This body shaver does what it's advertised to do and it does it well.  The only complaint I have is that the 3 'guard' attachments are a little hard to remove from the shaver.  There's no release mechanism or anything, you just have to pop them off, and since its made of plastic I can foresee it breaking after not a lot of uses.  Other than that the shaver works great so far, I've used it several times.

I love Pagan perfume. My older brother who was in London brought me a bottle of it in 1968. I have been trying to find it for years and was unable to do so. Finally found it on Amazon!  The Pagan they have now is a lighter oil and doesn't seem to be as long lasting but it still brings back so many great memories. Happy that I ordered it.
 About a week after receiving my perfume, I got a notice from my bank that my credit card had a fraud alert on it. Since this was ordered through Amazon, I was really surprised! This has not happened  before when ordering other things through Amazon. That scared me, now I'm not sure about ordering things online.
Would really like to receive a response to this message

I got this straightener. It meet only my few requirements not all. The temperature only go to high up to 230 Celsius and lowest 80 only. My most professional straightener temperature goes upto 350 Celsius. It works way better than my old straightener. It works great for just quick detangling your hair but remember it takes little time to heats up. The whole purpose for this straightener is to distributing equal heats between the hair bangs. The bristles are soft and work easily with rough kind of hair like mine. The best thing about this product is come with long cord and extra soft bristle. I was sent this product in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.

It was time for my granddaughter to begin shaving. But razors can be a bit scary with sharp blades! Even though an electric shaver does not shave as close as a blade shaver, it also does not nick! This is a pretty device (I ordered the mauve, kind of a pearlized pink color) and is easy to hold and to use. It holds a charge for a long time. For closest results, go over the area in every direction and do both straight and circular movements.
All_Beauty.summary: Great choice for girl's first shaver

All_Beauty.reviewText: This is a great piece that I purchased for my husband's birthday. I finally got his razor off the bathroom counter and it looks great. The only reason I have deducted one star is that it arrived loose. I was disappointed and thought I was going to have to return it the day before his birthday. I tried many times to tighten and was unsuccessful, it seemed that it would not thread properly to the base. However, after my persistence and attempting to tighten using pressure it went together and I was able to give it as a gift on time.

I have purchased this product throughout the years, using sporadically as needed. I have had noticeable results. As a medium toned brown skinned black american, I can truly say that this soap does indeed lighten the skin. I am interested in correcting spots caused by acne or slight injury to the skin. I also purchased Piona Bleaching to see how it works in conjunction with the soap to see if I get faster results when trying to correct my skin. I would recommend this product.

I bought this hairdryer for an international trip. It has tourmaline ceramic, which I like because it always dries my hair more quickly, and makes it shine more, and, therefore, a must have for me. I also wanted turbo which my home hair dryer has, but could not find one in a travel size with dual voltage and tourmaline/ceramic. Even though it doesn't have turbo, the Berta seemed to have plenty of power to do the job I needed.  It's wasn't noticeable quieter, as advertised, but it wasn't particularly noisy either. So, all in all, I found it to be a pretty good travel dual voltage hair dryer, at not too high a price. It's not tiny, but it was small enough. The handle twists to lay flat against dryer, and the cord was a pretty good length. The only problem or complaint I have with it, is that the air concentrator kept falling off whenever I would even a little hit it against something, so that was quite annoying. They delivered it to me within 2 days with Prime, so I was able to take it on my trip to Europe. One caution: It's very difficult to turn (change) the voltage, the button being very small and tight, so change it at home using a small screw driver before travelling internationally, or take the screw driver with you. I almost stripped out the ridge trying to get it turned. It's fairly light weight, which was nice. For this reason, I considered using it regularly at home, but I love my Conair turbo too much.
All_Beauty.summary: Pretty Powerful Tourmaline Ceramic Ion Dual Voltage for Travel

All_Beauty.reviewText: Getting my son to use dandruff shampoo has been a lifelong struggle because of the smell. He uses this every day now and it smells great. He isn't embarrassed to use it and go to school, and for a teenager, smell means a lot. He has brutally dry skin, and it does a fair job of helping with the actual dandruff. The best controlling shampoos smell too awful to get him to use. This is our compromise.

While this soap has excellent lather & feels nice on the skin, it doesn't smell like gardenia.  Gardenia was the scent for my Wedding Moon, whenever I smell it I feel like I'm back in our room in Jamaica.  Not so with this soap.  I can't even say what it smells like.  It's just a floral perfume smell.  I was looking forward to the smell of gardenia.  So even though the soap itself is nice, I took off a star for the fake scent.
All_Beauty.summary: Nice Solid Long Lasting Bar But Doesn't Smell Like Gardenia

All_Beauty.reviewText: Appears to be of the same quality as the name brand impellers. Worked great for my 1998 Larson. Installs easy, doesn't come with a end cap, but probably not necessary anyway. I've been running it all summer with out problems. For the price, I will be changing out this impeller annually, as last year my previous impeller failed after the second season and caused overheating and I had to be pulled back to the dock.
All_Beauty.summary: Worked great for my 1998 Volvo Penta

All_Beauty.reviewText: Nice product, the only thing is that it is not working as well for as I expected. I think it might be because my hair is too short for it. It is in the in between stage. I think it will work better when my hair is just a bit longer. Otherwise, the quality is pretty good. Can't wait to use it soon.

Love it. I will say that this wig has the hardest lace I have ever felt in my life, for that reason I took a star away. Feels like some sort of industrial paper. BUT! After cutting the lace, customizing the part, and cutting off about 9 inches. I absolutely love it.

Things to know: this is not a lace frontal the only thing about this wig that's lace is the part and the areas that are supposed to be cut off. You can not part this wig wherever you want, you have to use the part it came with, however you can kind of have that part wherever you want by the way you position the wig on your head. Now, I must say that the part it came with is pretty much perfect. I didn't need to pluck it at all. I only added power make up to make it match my scalp.

Before cutting lace and length I did get a small amount of shedding while brushing but it wasn't a big deal at all. I believe this wig is definitely worth the price.

I used the 7 day treatment. It definitely made my teeth less yellow. Frankly, my teeth used to be unacceptably yellow, now they are just slightly yellow. I did not experience any of the side effects that some users had (burning gum).

That said, my friends who have had dental treatment to whiten teeth end up with beautiful WHITE teeth. I don't have that, even after this treatment.

This product suits my purpose, but, it is definitely not a substitute for a whitener treatment by a dentist.

Love Potion: Red is great for 99%-100% of people, I'd say. I'm probably in the 1% that it still needs to grow on, but admittedly, I'm not someone who likes even the hint of cinnamon in anything. That being said, the base of the fragrance has great vanilla notes, and is warm, sweet, and sexy. I have gotten compliments while wearing it, and it's long lasting. I keep huffing my arm whenever I swipe it on. It's one I would absolutely suggest if someone's starting out with trying fragrances from this company and wanted to know where to begin. I know it's a staple of a lot of the customers, so that also has to say something. One thing I will add about this is to let it age. It's not that the notes change, but the way they meld together deepens, as will your appreciation of it. I know that's certainly worked for me!

Wonderful wig, but DID NOT COME CUT. I had to cut it myself, simply easy but was still pretty disappointed. It is a beautiful wig, no tangling and little shedding. it even came with a color card "1b" and its code. For thirty dollars this wig is very impressive, it came wavy from how it was packaged but after i gave the wig some tlc of brushing, cutting and using a heat resistant flat iron for weaves and wigs it was so silky it felt like really real long silky hair. This wig is a godess. To find a long wig that does not tangle is very hard. This wig is a life saver to any satsuki kiryuin cosplayer. However it did come with two diamond and pearl hair clips that look somewhat like satsukis but before hand i made my own hairclips out of scrap polymer clay that i shaped and painted white with a simple but shortcut way with clear nailpolish that works just as expensive glaze. but make sure you test your surfaces.
find me on instagram @loli_rose_bunni :3
All_Beauty.summary: A beautiful long non tangle wig! But did not come cut.

All_Beauty.reviewText:
I have owned the Norelco T980 for a few months now, and it is great.  I had a previous Norelco model for about 4 years and finally it just stopped holding a charge so I bought the T980.  With the old Norelco my wife used to complain about little hairs all over the sink.  No more!  It may not capture every single hair, but I would say it gets a good 90-95% of them.  Regardless, it vacuums up enough of the hairs to keep my wife happy!

In my mind the only two small items that keep it from being a 5-star product are: 1) it does not have a pop-up trimmer like my old model did - you have to take the regular blade off and put on the trimmer blade, but that is the price you pay for having the vacuum feature, and 2) its harder to get up close and trim under my nose - it can be done, it just takes more effort than before; again I think its the price you pay for the vacuum feature.  Overall I have had great luck with Norelco trimmers and this one is no exception.

So first things first I was given a promo to try these out and write a review but as someone who doesn't wear make up I chose a different route. I had them send the item to a friend of mine who use a multitude of different brushes for make up and is always in need of something like this and this is what she had to say about the product. She absolutely loved the case that the brushes came in, the multitude of brushes is a definite plus for anyone who uses make up. The brushes themselves are super soft and have no fallout (no clue what that means), The black tipped ones (which seems to be most of them) kinda suck, as they are plastic and don't have to much give to them. So all in all she absolutely loved them and will enjoy adding them to her collection of make up items and it helped give me brownie points. Not a bad purchase for the price given.
All_Beauty.summary: I bought these for someone else

All_Beauty.reviewText:
I ordered a small. Fits nicely. Light, flowy, just as I expected. Can't wait to wear it when the weather starts to get warmer.

But, I should've paid more attention to other reviews re: color.  On the seller page, first 2 photos of the kimono looks to be beige with pink undertones.  But, the kimono is definitely a dimmer beige-tan color very much like the other pictures shown on the page.

Also another thing that can be improved is shipping.  I placed an order for this kimono on December 1, 2015.  I received it in the mail yesterday (January 4, 2016).  It took over a month!  I've ordered plenty of things that shipped from China. THIS by far, took the longest to get to me.
All_Beauty.summary: For the price that I paid, it's really a great product.

All_Beauty.reviewText: SUPER stick after it dries. It dries more mousse textured than matte. It is long wearing and really hard to get off. It took 3 weeks to get here the day after estimated delivery. I'm a brown/black girl and it comes off as a dark vibrant red on me but it comes off as dark maroon on lighter skin tones.
All_Beauty.summary: It was pretty good besides the stickiness

All_Beauty.reviewText: I have loved this color for awhile now, but I have not been able to find it in my local stores. I was so glad to find it on Amazon. I think the color works well by itself (but it may be a bit light for some skin tones), or to tone down a harsher or too-bright shade, i.e. when I buy a color that doesn't look good on me. I can use this to blend it out so it looks good and allows me to use the wrong color without throwing it away.
All_Beauty.summary: Great color-glad I found it again

All_Beauty.reviewText: I've been using this cup (it was my first) for every cycle for the last year and a half. It has served me well with very minor leakage. I don't wear a panty liner or anything with it. This cup is definitely on the soft side which can make it hard to get open at times. I'm an experienced cup user and have given up and put a tampon in on multiple occasions which is why I'm upgrading to a firmer cup now. Overall, for the price, it's a great cup to start with. Time will tell if the firmer one I've ordered works for me.

Love the shaver, but I wasn't prepared for the three weeks of rough, yet sensitive skin due to razer burn.  THis shaver doesn't get as close as my disposable razer, but that's a given with shavers, right?  I am wondering if my face will toughen up over time, or perhaps I'll have to just slap on some aftershave and take it like a man.  In a perfect world, I would've given this a 5 star rating, but the razer burn is leaving me a little raw....
All_Beauty.summary: Dad never told me about razer burn...

All_Beauty.reviewText:
I have traditionally been a Braun shaver user, but have always wanted to own a rotary.  In the past I have tried several of them, but have not been sufficiently satisfied with the shave they gave.  When I recently decided to look at a new shaver I decided to look into the much touted Arcitec.  Unlike most people, I didn't think the appearance of the shaver was particulary cool.  (In fact, I would say it's just short of "weird" though the 1090X is better looking than the 1060X model generally seen in stores.)  However, looks are less important than performance and valued features, so when I saw a promotional code available on the Internet that allowed me to pick up the 1090 for the same price as the 1060 at my local Wal-Mart I jumped on it.  Here is the overview:

Shave and Handling:

The razor gives a good shave, especially if you give your beard/face the adjustment period (21 days) recommended.  The only drawback is that can take a little longer to get a really close shave than would be ideal.  (I believe it might actually shave a little closer/quicker if the heads were slightly LESS flexible.)  Just as advertised, I find that the razor is easy to hold and that the flexibility of the heads gives you the ablity to rotate the shaver from almost any angle and while still keeping contact with your beard.  Its new design allows me to cut around my goatee much better than any rotary I've ever tried before.

Indicator Lights/Warning Beeps:

I like the minutes of power left and low batery display features in particular.  I find this really comes in handy as exactly when to recharge a shaver can otherwise be a bit of a guessing game.

Precision Tube Trimmer:

Not good.  As many other posters have commented, the placement is awkward at best.  This must have been the only place Philips/Norelco could place it and still keep the felixibity and ergonomics they wanted, otherwise it is simply inexplicable.

Cleaning:

Fairly easy.  The heads are washable under water and there is a brush included if you want to do it the old fashioned way.  I believe you can also buy a cleaning unit and use Norelco's cleaning fluid if you wish, but there is significant ongoing expense choosing that route.

Accessories:

The charging stand works well and (if I keep the surface of my bathroom counter fairly clean) the suction cups placed on bottom for stabiliy work fine.  The power pod that the razor can be charged in or stored for traveling also works well, but it would have been better if it had been designed so that the razor could go in there with the protective razor head cap on the heads.  As for the head cap itself, I don't leave it on the razor between shaves as recommended in the manual because I want to make sure the razor heads are thoroughly dried out.  From past experience w/ other washables failure to so can eventually lead to a mildew smell coming from the razor blades and, frankly, I think the cap makes the razor look sort of "clownish" when it is on.

Other Observations:

The shaver is quiet compared to my Braun and seems to better conserve power too.  It is also fairly light-weight and feels pretty sturdy.

Conclusion:

For some people this razor will not be worth the money even if they get a reasonable deal as I did.  However, if you are not daunted by the price (which is lower than Braun's current premium "Pulsonic" model) and want a razor that combines good overall performance with the bells and whistles associated with an upper-end shaver, I believe you will be satisfied with the the 1090X model.
All_Beauty.summary: Overall a good shaver, especially at the price I got it.

Beware of the hype.  Read the ingredients!  It's erythritol and monk fruit.  They cleverly don't list how much of each ingredient but by law the most plentiful ingredient must be first.  You guessed it, erythritol is first so you can assume it's mostly that plus a pinch of monk fruit sprinkled in.  Of course the price is 5 times what erythritol costs.  Read the label.  "On the slopes of a primeval forest, the monks discovered and cultivated a rare fruit prized for its sweetness.  This sacred fruit was named Monk Fruit."  Please.  Read further under the list of ingredients and you'll see "Erythritol, Monk Fruit Sweetener."  Greatest piece of deceptive advertising I've seen in a long time.  If you're tired of being played like a fool, buy your own ingredients at 1/5 the price and mix them to your liking.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: I was excited to find a natural sugar substitute when I came across Xylitol. When I got it, my kids and I made lemonade: lemon juice, water and XyloSweet. About 45 minutes later, halfway through lunch, I noticed my 6 year old daughter stopped eating her lunch, and she didn't look too good. She told me she didn't feel good and so I put her down for a nap. Ten minutes later, my son didn't feel good either. Long story short: my daughter got diarrhea, and luckily, because she hadn't had that much lemonade, her diarrhea wasn't too severe. Unfortuneately for my five year old son, who had a lot more lemonade to drink, he first started throwing up, and then also started having the runs--both at the same time! Poor kid. About the time I almost had them both settled down, my stomach was churning, and next thing you know I had to rush to the bathroom, for the first of what would end up being nine trips. In between bathroom trips, I Googled: "Xylitol reactions" and was surprised at the number of listings that popped up. I found that supposedly about 20% of people that try xylitol will have a reaction. I think that figure is on the low side because my two kids are adopted from totally different sets of parents. So when you consider that the three of us have different genetics, and yet we all had a problem with this stuff, I'd say that probably more than 20% of people that try this, will have a reaction. BUYER BEWARE! Xlear - Xylosweet 5lb, 5 lb, 1 bag
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: XyloSweet gave me and my two kids diarrhea!

Yes, there was the tiniest box of Godiva, containing 4 wrapped milk chocolates about the size of Hershey kisses.  Also, received were 3 small Ghirardelli squares of individually wrapped dark chocolates (not 4 as shown).  There were two decent size chocolate bars (5.3 oz) labeled Fine European Chocolate "Sweet Obsession" made in Poland.  We only just sampled the milk chocolate with peanuts variety.  It tasted more like sugar than chocolate.  The first ingredient listed on the package is sugar.  Then there were the cookies.  The packaging and the photos of these products looked like they would be exceptional gourmet treats.  One called Mia Dolci, manufactured in Washington, looked and tasted more like a wheat thin covered with powdered sugar and spray painted with the thinnest coating of chocolate.  I could spend an hour describing each of these items.  But, I hope you get the idea.  Also,  the outside packaging of the candies and cookies are arranged and stuck together and to the faux basket using a booger glue that still retains its stickiness when you try to separate these items.  Not too appealing.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Beware! Many of the items displayed in the image are not the ones you will receive!

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: False Advertising.  Read the back of the label.  The headline on Amazon says "it is not from corn", BUT if you read the back of the label it says it is not made from corn from china, but from the USA.  Very misleading.  We need to make a complaint to Amazon.  This is the only reason I gave it one star.  I won't even order it if it's made from corn since it doesn't matter if it's from the USA.  USA allows for GMO corn and are not forced to label as such.  Health Garden USA, please change your headline

After reading many positive reviews on these tea K-cups I ordered them and anxiously waited for them to arrive to try them. My anxious wait to try turned into a great disappointment upon fixing and tasting the Raspberry Tea, oh my gosh it was horrible , it was bland and had no flavor. The tea if I could describe it's taste would be watered down kool aid, I added sugar to it in attempt to add some flavor and found it of no help. I also tried the lemon tea as I read some saying it was so good, once again I was disappointed. This tea actually gagged me. It is non refundable something I didn't read before buying so that's my fault but if it could be returned I would be returning it.

Use a different brand!! Ive used nutritional yeast before and this is the first time ever getting solid hard chunks of something and pieces of wood in it. I cannot use this and if I did Id break a tooth if I bit down on some of the pieces. Ive only looked through a third of the container so who knows how much more Id find. It also isn't eligible for a return which is frustrating considering its inedible.

I thought that the first reviewer may have been overexaggerating, but this one really does taste bad. I believe the only way to come close to enjoying the cheese part of this is to store the box, in its entirety, in a humid environment so the cheese can, well, get soft. Other than that, it's horrible and you should simply discard it. The Slim Jim, on the other hand, is "so-so" but may taste better with a dip or something. This is not the same as the skinny Slim Jims (you know, the addictive ones) so if you don't want to ruin your taste buds with so-so beef and horrible cheese, move on.

DECEPTIVE DESCRIPTION --Name says "Watkins Original Gourmet Baking Vanilla Extract, with Pure Vanilla Extract".  NOTE THE **WITH**.  Only by zooming in on the label do you see the fine print that says "naturally and artificially flavored".  The ingredients are: Water, sugar propylene glycol, vanilla extract (water, alcohol, extractive of vanilla beans), alcohol, artificial flavors, fruit juice (color).  Although the words "Pure Vanilla Extract" appear prominently in the description, it is anything BUT "pure".  To their credit, Amazon is refunding me without my having to return the product.  But the product should be accurately described, or withdrawn.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Only by zooming in on the label do you see the fine print that says "naturally and artificially flavored"

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
I bought this specifically because the ingredient list said:
"Sugar, Corn Syrup, Gum Base, Softeners, Artificial and Natural Flavoring and Red No. 40 Lake."

However, that is not the ingredient list that arrived on my package.  Instead it says:
"Sugar, Corn Syrup, Gum Base, Less than 2% of Acesulfame Potassium, Adipic Acid, Artificial and Natural Flavoring, ASPARTAME, ....AND SUCRALOSE"

I'll be asking Amazon for my money back since I don't like the taste of aspartame nor the accompanying headaches.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Ingredient list LIES!  This HAS ASPARTAME IN IT!  It is not the all sugar brand.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: I bought these at my local Safeway (1# bag = 3.99) and ended up returning them the very next day.  The color of the "wasabi" coating was not appetizing, which should have clued me in before even opening the bag.  There wasn't much to them, and what "flavor" they did have, barely resembled wasabi.  In fact, to me, it tasted of chemicals, however the other reviewer thought it was a cheap soy sauce; regardless, they were disappointing.

It was gross. I can eat bottled cheese sauce and tolerate it but this stuff tasted like...I don't even know how to describe it. I hated to waste it so I used it on burritos, casserole and even in soup but I couldn't stand it. It has a very strange taste. No one else was fond of it either.

I wish I would have waited and read the review that someone did a few days after I ordered mine!  They don't work with a newer machine!  I was so disappointed about this!  Will not order again unless I am sure it works with a 2.0 machine!  Who can I contact to get refund or something for the waste of time and product?  Thanks!

I ordered this product for my son who is away at college. He said he was jealous of his roommates ramen but because he has celiac cannot eat ramen. I ordered these because they claim to be 100% gluten free but the flavor packet contains soy sauce. My son has been vomiting all day after having eaten just one serving last night. This product is NOT gluten free and dangerous for those with celiac. I should have read the ingredients more closely and so should we. Extremely irresponsible of the manufacturer!

The shipment was completely melted due to the ice pack being inadequate to handle June Texas heat. I noticed that once I complained, the company began warning customers on Amazon NOT to order if they live in areas where the temperature exceeds 85 degrees (F). The company offered to replace the product but I declined since the chocolate, itself, once solidified, tasted great. So, take their shipment warning seriously!

These are delicious. No problem with the quality or taste. But the three stars are for the price. $3.50 per package, each package containing six pieces. Do the math. $.58 for a 1 inch by 1/2 inch piece of candy. I think you'd do better taking the money and buying three or four Mounds bars. They taste the same and you get more for your money.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: I think you'd do better taking the money and buying three or four Mounds ...

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: I am new to tea and with time I may grow to appreciate this tea. I favor a darker, spicier flavor rather than the "grassy" taste. I tried steeping four tablespoons in 12 oz to see if that gave me more taste. It definitely gave me more of a kick! I do not advise doing that. I felt like I drank two pots of coffee.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: I felt like I drank two pots of coffee

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
I would have been saved a lot of effort, loss and waste had someone included the photos I'm including here but it is essential to know what you are getting. The product isn't bad per se, but if you're expecting Wasabi peanuts and instead end up with a container largely filled with anything but peanuts (which have little to no Wasabi on them) you can understand my sadness and confusion.

The product isn't bad I guess? I mean it tasted like some Wasabi powder thrown over some random trail mix. Not something I would particularly enjoy but maybe you like rice snacks.

That said, a healthy 3 star because the product isn't bad, it just isn't up to my expectation of quality.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Warning: These are not Wasabi Peanuts

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: I smoke meat weekly on my Big Green Egg and have done hundreds of ribs and briskets and have tried 25+ store bought rubs since owning my BGE the last 5 years.  Most instructions, articles, recipes, reviews, etc, say to apply dry rub very liberally on ribs.  This means to virtually cover every bit of meat surface area with a light to medium coating.  After a 5+ hour smoking at 225 degrees it yields fantastic flavor and a great accompaniment to pork and beef.  BUT-  This rub is WAY too salty, spicy, and powerful for that liberal of a rub coating.  I would recommend a very light dusting with this stuff.  I look forward to trying it again while using much less.  It also has does not list sugar as an ingredient and I would NOT recommend using this exclusively as a rub on briskets with no brown sugar.  Personal preference, but I feel rubs can't be 100% salt and spice with no sugar.

I just tried these are here are my thoughts:

1-you get a lot per serving! 41 pieces (bigger than a normal goldfish cracker) are 140 calories. That is about 1 cup. About 6 servings per bag.
2-Gluten free if that is a concern of yours
3-Baked not fried
4-The consistency is a little different than I expected. Somewhere between a cheetos puff and a crunchy cheetos. I'd say cheetos taste better, although these are a bit healthier.
5-They are coated with quite a bit of flavouring, so they are definitely not bland.

Overall, I liked them. Prefer the Mega Cheese flavour the best.

I'm not blaming Amazon on this purchase because they shipped it out in plenty of time for it to arrive on December 31.  Somehow after dozens of orders that were shipped using UPS that came to my home this package fell into the hands of a new driver and he couldn't find my house. I find that very hard to believe since it is well marked and on a street but for whatever real reason it was disappointing since I needed it that night because of a New Year's Eve party and some guests drink coffee over alcohol.  The cold air and slower shipping must have caused the beans to dry out or freeze because when I opened the bag, that great smell that usually accompanies good coffee was very minimal plus the color of the actual beans were a lighter shade of brown with very little oil on them.  I then preceded to grind some beans and brew a pot. I used bottled spring water and a Bunn coffee maker. The taste was average. Nothing bad but nothing to write home about.  Seriously it also appears the coffee was bagged on Aug. 29, 2012.  I'm not sure if that would be considered old but seems like it could have been a little fresher.  If you ever order coffee in the winter I suggest going with 1 day delivery if you live where it's cold.  Then hope that UPS doesn't get lost!  I might try some other brand next time.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Probably would have given at least 1 star higher if.....

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
It seems the reviews for all the flavors are now combined. Here's my breakdown for what I've tried:

Buffalo Ranch: 2.5 of 5 stars. Really tasty pretzel bits, packed with buffalo flavor. The flavoring itself is much more hot sauce than ranch. The corn nuts are adequate, not as good as the Corn Nuts brand, and the corn sticks are adequate as well.

Salted Caramel popcorn: 4 of 5 stars. The first two ingredients are sugar and butter, followed by corn. So you know its going to be tasty! Delicious-- but quite salty. Just don't expect to find any nuts. The "nuts" are just tiny shavings mixed into the coating on the popcorn, and don't really even add to the flavor. But the buttery caramel is great anyway.

Spicy Pizza: 3 of 5 stars. Good flavor, same mix as the Buffalo Ranch, but with a nice spicy pizza-sauce flavor. Again, the corn nuts are just adequate, not as good as the Corn Nuts brand.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Good, crunchy, spicy, not much ranch flavor

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: My title pretty much sums it up.  Had a taste for the old Mars bars and this is not them.  The original had almonds, these are small and only have Carmel and nougat.  Add to that the shipper merely put them in a padded envelope so they are smashed, taste kind of stale and a messing smashed Carmel mess.  High hopes.  Bad outcome.  Onward I suppose.

I'm giving it 3 stars because it is organic and delivery/packaging was perfect and on time. Unfortunately, the flavor and color didn't exceed my expectations. For people who are not matcha snobs or experts it will do, but if you've ever tried fresh good quality ceremonial kind then you will not like it. It is of average quality in my opinion.

I made these as directed, except used egg replacer because we don't eat eggs.  My family apparently hated them because nobody ate them and I ended up throwing them away.  Unfortunately, I had 4 more boxes.  This time, instead of egg replacer  I used "flax eggs."  Basically I took about 1/4 cup of flax meal added water and let it sit until it was a goop.  Then I added that in.  I also threw in about 3 handfuls of oats to soak up some of the excess sugar in the mix.  Finally I tossed in about a cup of chopped almonds to add some nutrients.  I mixed these with my bare hands and pressed into a 9x9 glass baking dish instead of making cookies.  I baked at 350 for about 20 minutes.  They taste much better, are a bit healthier, and my family is actually eating them!

I use Cream of Tartar for the potassium. I mix it in OJ with a pinch of CoT and a pinch of sea salt. I feel better taking this cocktail than when I don't take it. My problem isn't with the product, it's with the shipping. It's taking forever to be delivered. Two weeks is too long in my view.  I was running out of the little spice jar I have and order this bulk type right away to avoid having to purchase another small jar. It didn't work out so well. Yes, I guess I'm wanting instant gratification but when I order something from Amazon, I do expect and I do usually get quick delivery of my goods. This package of Cream of Tartar will most likely last a long time so I probably won't need to order it again but if I did, I would order from another vendor.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Shipping is very slow for this fine product

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
I brought this product after eyeing it up at the stores a couple of times in the tea aisle. I finally got my mom to buy after running out of my old faithful Typhoon tea.
So far the tea has kinda been somewhat of a hit and miss. Not all the tea bags are filled equally (because of lot of the leaves ended up on the outside of the box sandwiched between the plastic)making the brewing time fluctuate (And I do let my tea seep the longest recommended time because I like it strong). Those few times I've gotten the tea just right it was a pretty good cup, and it holds both cream and sugar well.
It might just be my box. I do live in the states and the tea does go a long way before it ends up on the shelve of my local supermarket. I also live in the south. Hot tea isn't that popular down here so it might have gone stale just sitting there. I don't really know...
I'm only half way through the box so there's still room for my opinion to change!
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Good but not blow your socks off

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: Although my mom loved the flowers. The reason I picked this boquet was because it was full of purple and lots of small daisies. I'm disappointed in the arrangement sent as it looks small and not as full with the flowers they substituted and looked somewhat cheap. The flowers did come in fresh and alive but didn't have the wow factor of purple. The roses Did look nice. I ordered 3 different arangments from this company for Mother's Day, hoping the other two are sent in somewhat of a resemblance to the arrangement ordered.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: He flowers were alive and fresh

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: I can't really attest to the quality of the penuts themself, but my complaint is that 2 of the 4 containers were dinged up when I receved them.  They were meant to be inexpensive Christmas gifts for those hard to buy for men who love ECU, but I'd hate to give them something that is damaged.  Looks like I'll have to find something else to give in it's place.  It's a shame because they look awesome, just wish they had been packaged a little better.

I generally really like beef flavored ramen, and this one was good, but not a favorite. I'd describe it as more of a pepper beef rather than just beef, and I am not a fan of pepper. The pepper wasn't overpowering though, since this one has a lot of broth, but the pepper pieces were visible.

The noodles are standard ramen noodles and held onto the broth's flavor pretty well. There's a buttery undertone which I really enjoyed. I liked these, but I doubt I would buy them again.

I was really excited to try this cashew butter.  It does taste just like cashews but compared to peanut better it is very bland.  I think I would have liked it more if it had a roasted taste which would have given a bit more depth.  It has a little bit of a raw nut taste.  I do think it would still be a nice flavoring agent to add to spreads, salad dressings or marinates but it just doesn't deliver on that flavor as I thought it would.  Still if you love cashews you will definitely enjoy this product.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Solid product which has a nice, creamy texture but is bland compared to peanut butter wish it also had a roasted taste.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
I got this last December for my boyfriend, and it was really cute when it came in the mail. However, the instructions say to soak the moss and plant before starting a regular watering schedule, and when I soaked the moss, all the green coloring came out of it! It looked pretty gross after that-- as if it had been dyed and lost its color. The water was neon green, which I dumped.

Turns out, my boyfriend broke the glass anyway so I just told him to toss it.

Just purchased another set for a good friend a few days ago-- hoping there's better luck this time!
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: It looked pretty gross after that-- as if it had been dyed ...

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
To me, they just ween't as good a the regular salted style peanuts.
They were't awful or anything like that.  Just not as good.
I read a lot of the reviews before they arrived.
One guy said they reminded him of beer nuts.  They weren't quite as sweet but I could see how these could be similar in taste.  But the beer nuts had more sugar and salt.  They were just better than these lightly salted peanuts.
It takes a bit of courage to go against the crowd.  And there is also the psychological pressure to give a good, high rating to a free product..But I say taste them for yourself.  Chances are some of you will think " Yep, Wildman was right.  They are OK but not really great."  Others will truly love them.  Everybody has different tastes.  Mix them with some pretzels and M&Ms and Corn Chex and you'll have a pretty good snack to watch a sporting event with.
I appreciate the free sample and take my reviews seriously.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: I know there are a lot of 4 and 5 star reviews but for my taste buds I just didn't love them.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
Pic #1 = front of wrapper

Pic #2 = back label with ingredients and calories

Pic #3 = I compared this with Trader Joe's Milk Chocolate and See's Candy Milk Chocolate

======================

My four kids and I shared this bar and shared samples of the other two chocolates we had around the house.

CREAMINESS:
Because this product is almost all milk (see ingredients) it seems creamier than the other two brands. But at the same time this bar is thin and the thinner slice seems to melt in one's mouth easier.

CONSISTENCY:
On the note of being thinner, without putting this in the fridge, the bar is very LIMP and bending in a 75 degree house. Both See's and TJ's are nice firm blocks of chocolate...they are also 3-5 times as thick as this thin, thin Cailler bar.

TASTE:
This is the most subjective part of the process. Out of five of us we all 5 agree the Cailler is the LEAST tasting like chocolate. It's a milk bar with a tiny bit of chocolate. See's was in the middle with a milky taste by plenty of chocolate. The TJ's is very chocolatey and as you savor it, it has a creaminess to it too (my personal favorite).

COST:
Both Cailler and See's cost around $1.30 per ounce.
The TJ's cost $0.30 per ounce or to put it another way, it cost 75% LESS than the other two brands!!
TJ's definitely does NOT taste like Hershey's cheap chocolate. Also the TJ is the one that has more chocolate!! Maybe because milk cost more than cocoa that is why the other bars are more expensive. . .or it's simply a jacked-up-price by Cailler and See's.

OVERALL: I like candy. . .especially chocolate.
If someone gave this to me as a gift I sure would not look a gift horse in the mouth, but I'm not a huge fan. I expect my chocolate to taste like chocolate...not sweet milk with hint of cocoa.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Consider the price (objective) and preference in 'creaminess' (subjective)

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
This is more of a medium coffee. Not unpleasant or sharp, but definitely not "jazzed up" in flavor. Tastes like a rather ordinary decaf and a bit flat. I tried it with smaller cup size, still did not measure up to bold.
I really like Tully's French Roast Bold Decaf but thought for variety I would give this a try. Back to Tully's.

So, I've been drinking this coffee for about six months (about a bag a month, in my household), and it's pretty good! Sometimes.

In some shipments, the coffee is uniformly roasted and the beans are good quality and everything's awesome. However, every so often I'll get a bag that's not that great- the last one was rather weak, even by light-roast standards. And there was one bag a while back that had some definite overroasted notes.

So, while it's usually really great coffee for the price (it's hard to beat that per-pound price, if you want decent coffee), sometimes you'll get a dud. The duds are infrequent enough that I keep buying it, but, buyer beware. It is a bit of a gamble.

While these were great as cupcake toppers, they might want to change the title of the product to "cute finger deathlock twirl stem rings". They were tight on little fingers (age 4 and up) and the bottom point of the "stem" (not pictured, but imagine plastic curly fries) digs into the finger as well. BUT, for the price, they were great cupcake  topper flourishes.

This product works but the advertising is misleading. Zipp Fizz claims that it's a natural product and on its website says that it is sweetened with xylitol.  Xylitol is a natural sugar made from the birch tree, and used in Europe for over 100 years.  I use xylitol on a regular basis and agree that if it comes from the right source and not from China, where it's made from corn, it is healthy and has very good side effects such as cavity prevention.  But,on the ingredients list, xylitol is the last ingredient, meaning, that it is the smallest ingredient in the formula.  On the other hand Sucralose (also known as Splenda) is very high on the list of ingredients.  That's where the aftertaste is from.  If you don't care what you put in your body then this is a good product as it does work as advertised.  Why add Splenda if the xylitol is in there? Because the splenda is cheaper. So obviously there is no need for the xylitol other than to use it as a marketing ploy.  They know this and have told me that their new product - immune fizz - has no Splenda.  Why not take it out of the regular zipp fizz too and make it healthier too?  I was sucked into the purchase by the xylitol reference only to find the sucralose in the product.  I wonder what else they aren't saying?

The price stated is for one jar, but the product description states " Othentic Soup Vegtrn Red Beet Borscht 16.2 OZ (Pack of 6) "
I have not tried the product yet, but at this price per jar, it must be good.

UPDATE 6/25/14
Tried this soup and it's pretty good but not worth the price.  Would not buy this again.  Web page still says that this item is a pack of six.

It is an okay cereal. It has tiny grains after being cooked, which I am not fond of....I like more of an oatmeal consistency. It doesn't have much of a taste, especially in the way of being roasted.

I will finish them off by mixing them with my steel cut oatmeal and not bother to buy them again.

I'm more of a coffee drinker so I wasn't in love with this tea..in other words it didn't change my opinion.  I do think it is aromatic and has more flavor than other teas I"ve tasted.  It's really nice to see all the spices in the pyramid shape bag, tho I don't know what the shape has to do with anything.  AS for tasting "flavors", I'm not sure what chai and cinnamon should taste like in a tea, so I can't answer any of this.  It did leave a little aftertaste in my mouth after drinking it.  The tea bag did hold up quite nicely except the liquid was soaked up quickly in the string, which I don't recall other teabags doing that.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Not a tea drinker but tried anyway

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: It was ok. I bought it for a recipe I found but  the spice - harissa - was way over rated -  you could just use sundried tomatoes with chili. So I have no issues with brand. The package was lost and it took a while for the seller to straighten things out with UPS  but not their fault.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: It was ok. I bought it for a recipe ...

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: "NOT" sprinkles - these are NORMAL SIZE  "imperials" or Red Hots, easily able to locate in grocery store for a fraction of the cost. Was excited to have finally located. Should have known better than to believe they would actually be the tiny sprinkles, as in mini ones I was searching for to use for cookie decorations. Ordered per misleading description "sprinkles" &  previous review stating it was difficult to find the 'LITTLE ones,"  If you're looking for sprinkles, these are slightly smaller width-wise than a regular size M&M, not as flat - rounder. Not Little or "sprinkles" size, Live & learn.

The cookies themselves were very good but the way they were packaged most of the cookies were broken and in pieces. I had got this for a gift to someone but ended up keeping alot of the packs because I was too embarrassed to give them as a gift because of their condition. Also the expiration date on the cookies were less than a month from the date received, I thought the date would be longer.

This pancake mix tastes good but the construction of the canister is a huge failure.
2 out 3 canisters were dented and leaked near the bottom where the metal bottom lid is attached to the round soft carton body.
Ditched all of them because of fear for contamination and bugs.
The nuts probably had gone stale as well because of the exposure.
Won't buy this again because who likes to go through the hassle with returning it and getting your money back.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Leaking canisters Kona Coast pancake mix

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
I don't like this tea. This is not a good milk oolong. I have seen better ones which have more aroma and flavor. I will pass next time.
I was looking for a creamy, aromatic flavor that I have tried before. If you are looking for a more regular green tea, you might like this one.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: This is not a good milk oolong. More like a regular Green Tea for me than Milk Oolong.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
The first batch I made was with fresh ground beans and I used a little too much. Although it had a nice velvet/silky, full-bodied taste there was some bitterness.

The second batch, I used less and there was no bitterness. However, there was a stale aftertaste, even after a few hours. I will be chunking this coffee.  Maybe I just got a bad batch.

Read an article about two options of gums in the market that are considered to be safe, more or less. Xylitol was one of them.
Bought the gum online, but exactly the same was sold in the Organic Store.
However, it contains Soy Lecithin, just like all other gums out there. Based on some research, it's all GM! It's Soy Oil byproduct, and apparently all Soy grown in US is GM by now. So unless it says NON-GM, wouldn't recommend it. Even though, i wouldn't be 100% sure of that either, since there were findings that proved that not all NON-GM were actually non-GM. Hence the 2 stars.

I found this too sweet and not much flavor.  I should have just used chocolate extract and added a little fresh mint .  Maybe I would have gotten what I was looking for.  The thing is, you never know until you try something and these flavors couldn't be found at any of my stores.  I'm not unhappy I purchased it...just not for me.

Stick with other Thai brands. I don't like this brand maybe the Viet fish sauces are supposed smell & taste this way but it's more pungent (horrible) than other Thai fish sauces I use and also a lot saltier. Then there's the after taste which I never had with any other fish sauce I tried. I don't like the taste or the smell of the food that I cooked with Red Boat!

I guess I was envisioning making a veggie wrap or something tortilla-esque... but these wraps are not bendy (I didn't try heating them up, as I am on a raw diet and I was unsure of the protocol on microwaving things since I normally just eat raw fruits and veggies and whole foods). So I ate them by themselves, un-warmed. You can literally snap pieces off of it... I don't even know if heating would make this wrap much more flexible.

As for the taste - it is very coconuty. I am not sure that I would want to pair it with savory ingredients unless maybe it was thai or something else that works well with the coconut flavor. Not super sweet... just coconuty. I put cinnamon on it and it was decent as a snack. I like that it is only 70 calories per wrap, but it was not worth what I paid. $12 for 7 of these so-so wraps is outrageous.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Not sure exactly what I was expecting but this wasn't it

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText: When in both Korea and Vietnam (yes, Vietnamese also love ginseng and value its medicinal properties there too) I came to love the scent, taste and its stimulatory effect and since this is from Korea I was sure it would be great. Well I was wrong. I had to put 5 packets in one cup to even approach the scent and taste I was used to. I'll try regular style that I have to steep in hot water. The problem with this may be it is instant meaning it was most like made by steeping in hot water which was then removed leaving just the ginsenosides and gintonin residue (the primary agents in ginseng) and losing a lot of flavor and scent during the distilling process. That's just a semi-educated guess on my part but I have noticed this in instant coffees and teas, less of the original scent and complex flavor of the brewed varieties. If you like mild ginseng flavor and either don't care for or about the scent you might find this just right for you. I personally have to give it just two stars. I would've given it 1 star if I hadn't been able to get close to what I was expecting but like I said 5 packets made it drinkable but expensive!!

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
My husband and I made one of these Canterbury Naturals Chocolate Orange Pound Cakes last weekend..... I say "we" made it w/my tongue in cheek because these are, indeed, very simple and definitely do not require any help.

I was glad my husband was there for making the glaze, however, (so I would have a witness and would not get teased later)...... because I was VERY surprised to see the Orange Glaze recipe:

1/2 cup orange juice & 1/2 cup GRANULATED sugar - not confectioner's sugar as I have only ever used in glazes before.

I've baked a few things in my life that call for glazes and I've never seen granulated sugar called for in a recipe. Not being a baker by trade I thought there must be something I don't know about this simple concoction......so, w/my husband's encouragement I proceeded to go with the box & not my instincts....

Incredulous, we decided to do what the directions called for: combine the o.j. & granulated sugar, simmer for 5 min. over med. heat, let cool 5 min. then pour or brush over top of cooled cake....

Just as we suspected, the glaze was a disaster and not only tasted odd but looked even worse - the "glaze" never got to a glaze consistency and just soaked into the (already dense) cake and pooled around the bottom in the sheet pan........lol

The cake itself, mind you, was delicious, just as the other reviewers have stated (more so before the soaking of the odd "glaze"). I checked and ALL SIX boxes of the mix that we were shipped have the same directions. I feel CERTAIN that this is a typo and that you are supposed to use 1/2 cup of CONFECTIONER'S SUGAR and NOT granulated....

Otherwise, we like the cakes and will continue to bake them..... just a heads up for all you other bakers out there that follow the directions and not your instincts......

Cheers,
JA
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: Directions are WRONG for the glaze

I hardly noticed a difference from the regular Splenda. Except for it taking a little more stirring to desolve, I found it almost identical. That in and of itself is not a bad thing, but if you compare the prices - currently $17 for 320 packs of this and $19 for 700 packs of regular Splenda - I have a hard time justifying buying this rather than sticking to regular Splenda and using the money you saved to buy a supplement. I guess if you would forget to take the supplement, this could be a good compromise.

Mom, however, hated the stuff. She could not get it to dissolve in her (cold) iced tea, and in fact most of the Splenda stayed on top of the ice rather than falling to the bottom. She also noticed a slight difference in taste. Finally, she had issues with the packages, which are actually foiled on the inside, which make them harder to open than the regular packs. Anyone with arthritic or particularly thick fingers may have issues here.

All in all, while not a BAD product, I can't really recommend this to anyone. No matter how you slice it, there's a better option out there.

Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.reviewText:
The South prides itself on producing an aged whiskey so smooth that you can sip it instead of throwing it down your throat and hoping for the best. This drink is a good compromise for those who like the taste of matcha and want the health benefits, but who want a smoother, gentler drink.

I love matcha and have used a number of different varieties.  There are two main grades - culinary and ceremonial.  Culinary is intended for cooking and smoothies, although I've drunk it and lived.  There are grades within the ceremonial category and some are smoother than others, but I think matcha is an acquired taste.

Everyone agrees about the health benefits.  All green tea is rich in antioxidants, but since matcha is ground up tea leaves, it has many times the antioxidants of drinking tea-flavored water.

If you're a matcha purist, this probably isn't for you.  If you want to get some of the benefits of matcha in a smoother, more pleasant drink, I don't think you'll be disappointed.  I got the "blood orange/cranberry" flavor and I could taste both the cranberry and a slight hint of orange.  This mixture also dissolves easily.  Pure matcha has to be whisked again and again and some people don't have the patience.

Each packet is supposed to be enough for one large cup of tea (12 oz) but I like my tea weak and I ladled it out 1/2 teaspoon at a time and it was fine.  This is a wonderfully handy and relatively inexpensive way to have a healthy, delicious drink anywhere that you can get a cup of hot water.  I hope that this company will eventually offer this mixture in a jar or larger packet for those of us who want larger quantities.  Meanwhile, I'm going to try the other flavors.  Who knows?  I might like them even better.

This makes a delicate, delicious cup of tea (assuming you like the taste of cranberry and orange) with a fine, smooth taste.  An enjoyable way to ease yourself into the matcha habit. And it IS addictive!

Free sample provided for review.
Grocery_and_Gourmet_Food.summary: The matcha equivalent of "Tennessee Sippin' Whiskey"

I bought these sheets of paper for craft purposes (cards/scrapbook), I like the patterns on the paper, not too bright not too faded.

I gave them three stars because it's not Washi paper its just regular sheets of paper with print on only one side and there is just too little to justify $4.50 for this product. In fact it would be more economical to pay $8-10 for those 12"X12" scrapbooking pads that have more sheets in them, with print on both sides and the paper is thicker.

The patterns are nice though, neutral which is good for all kinds of projects. I don't know if the people who sent this out intended this but it says in the description there are 14 sheets, I received 20 sheets, 10 patterns/styles so two sheets for each pattern. Two of the patterns are printed on this thin crumpled like paper, not sure if it's Washi because I keep hearing Washi is suppose to be thicker than regular paper and these were almost as thin as tissue paper. I purchased both this DVD and Disc 2.  I am not sure why either of them have 5 star ratings.  First off, you certainly do not get $29.99 worth of value on the disc....there is literally 4x more time spent on showing completed projects in their gallery than there is on instruction.  While Andrea does say what to do, there are not nearly enough close ups on the technique...rather everything is pretty much shot from a 12 foot distance, centered on her and the workspace.  Instead of actually moving the camera angle so you can see what she is doing, most of the time she holds a piece up towards the camera and then pantomimes the technique.  You get a general idea of what to do but you don't actually see it as she is doing it.  There is roughly 10 minutes of decent instruction on each technique and she repeats many redundant steps...which IMO, wastes instruction time.  For example at the start of each Technique, she demonstrates how to mount the base print.  When you are on an "Advanced Techniques" lesson, you shouldn't be spending time going over the 1st and most basic steps.....especially not 2 times in 20 minutes.  I am very unhappy with this disc and I will not ever buy another one from these guys.  I have seen much better, free, videos on YouTube.
