Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: I wear a size large in all hoodies I've ever purchased and this fits as an XL. I also processed my order for a different color(dark brown) and was sent a HiVis orange. Not happy considering what I spent on the hoodie, it's comfortable material however I am unable to wear it.

Great idea. After two uses the left shoe LEDs stopped working.  Good thing did not spend a lot. My two stars are LEDs for not working so soon.  I have a different second pair and samething happened on the left foot LEDs. Going to reach out to seller on this pair.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Great idea. After two uses the left shoe LEDs ...

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText:
Like many many things on Amazon I should have paid attention to the reviews.  For the life of me IDK how this seller can justify the large price tag.  This is costume jewelry at best.  The pendant is way undersized and paltry, and the necklace itself is so fragile I'm going to have to replace it.  Im going to take it to my local jewelers and have it tested to see if its even gold; I'll report back after I find out.

I do however like the design of the pendant, that's basically the only thing it has going for it.

I've had a horrible time finding comfortable shoes that fit.  I was really happy with my first pair and planned to buy more.  I ordered a second pair in the same size as my first and I couldn't get my foot in one shoe at all and the other was too tight.  Don't know if I'll try another pair or not.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: I've had a horrible time finding comfortable shoes that fit

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: This bag was not what I expected. From the pictures online, it seemed to be made of a good quality leather. I loved the look of the purse. Upon receiving it, I was disappointed in the inside compartments. Within a week of use, the zipper inside broke. The purse has lost its shape and I ended up throwing it away after about 3 months of use.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Not what I thought it would be

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: These gloves are stylish, but they run small and are very scratchy. There is no fiber content label attached, so I am unable to determine how much of the glove is actually wool.  They did not feel like warm wool gloves, so my guess is they're probably  mostly acrylic.  That being the case, they will not be very warm.  I am returning them.

I ordered a size 10. I had found this ring at a local jewelry store but they wouldn't get it in until the week of our wedding. Once I found this I was so excited to see it in a size 10 and in enough time.  We recieved the ring nicely packaged and when my fianc put it on it was too big. My family does business with local jewlers so I asked each of them (3) to size it. It was a 10.5. It is exactly what he wanted but too big. Nice quality and people raved about how unique it was for a wedding band. Sadly it doesn't fit.

I purchased this jacket in 12 months for my granddaughter who is 8 months, but large for her age.  I fit much the same as most of her 12 month clothes are fitting, a little long in the arms, but otherwise a good fit.  It's a nice lighter weight jacket, and my only small complaint is that I wish there was a pull to fit the hood tighter to her head.  I love the colors!

I have had Whiting and Davis Double Frame Clutch bag before.  I love them very much.  The only thing I don't care for about this one is the closure because it is difficult to open and close.  I never had one that was like that before.  I believe for the money that one pays for it, it should be a perfectly excellent product.

Not much to this thing, but it works and that's all one can really say.  It's engineered for watch backs with notches 90 from one another, but you can use just two of the keys to open most other watches.  The case is nice since the little, interchangeable bits can get easily lost.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Very simple device, but it works

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: The fabric was a little stiffer than I expected. I am not disappointed though. I have looked everywhere for a bra like this. Since I am a 34D, it's hard to find my size and to simultaneously find a bra that gives me the support I want. This bra is super supportive. Fits better than anything I tried on at Victoria Secrets.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: The bra I've been looking for!

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText:
This bathing suit is very pretty and figure flattering.  The way the top and bottom are broken up between the black and blue colors really makes me look slimmer.  The black portion is great because black hides flabby areas really well.  The criss cross design of the top is so pretty and the suit seems to be well made.  Now that I'm a mother of two, my body has sadly changed quite a bit, so I am always looking for one piece suits that are figure flattering.  No more bikinis for me!  This one covers most of my problem areas and I love the colors.

The only complaint I have about this suit is that it's a tad big on me.  I ordered a 4XL in this because I know bathing suits usually run small.  Typically, I wear a size 12, but in bathing suits I usually buy a size 14.  The 4XL fits, but the straps are a bit loose on me so I don't get great boob support.  The "girls" look kind of saggy without the right support.  Not really a fault of the suit, just the fact that I should have ordered one size smaller.  I will probably just take in the straps a tad and I'll be good to go.

I received this product at a discount in exchange for my honest review. These opinions are 100% my own and have not been influenced in any way. I am in no way obligated to leave a positive review.

I have worn this necklace almost everyday since I got it. I love how you can dress it up or down depending on your outfit.

The only thing I would change is to make the bar a bit heavier so it stays straight throughout the day. I often notice mine is a bit tilted when I look in the mirror - not a big deal but something I noticed!

These are probably wonderful if you don't have Hobbit fat & wide feet like I do. I honestly don't want to give them a bad rating because the foot bed is sooo cushiony. I just know if I could have slid my Frodo Baggins feets into these pretty little flops they would have become my favorite pair. But alas the straps were just to narrow to be comfortable for me. I'm sure normal folks elvin and humans alike will be fine. Bummed.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Won't fit Frodo Baggins feet--- fore warning

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: The Kurti does look as in the image provided. Just an FYI - those button on the neckline are not functional - but you have enough room to get your head in. I liked the price. Regular light cotton material. I am size US 8 -10 and so I bought XL and fits fine.

I had a similar shoe but made by a different manufacturer. That size 11 N fit.  The size 11N Easy Spirit ordered from you was too tight.  Compared to my other brand 11N shoe which is similar to this Easy Spirit shoe, this brand in N was too tight. I have mailed back the shoe asking for a slightly larger width. Hope that will work!
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: The size 11N Easy Spirit ordered from you was too tight

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: I have a very tall 8 1/2 year old and I know the 10/12 is always too tight in the fitted shirts.  This 14/16 one fits but I think it's still somewhat small.  My daughter has a bit of a tummy but is not big, just tall and solid I'd say.  She wears 10/12 in most shirts. We got this shirt to wear with her costume this year.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Good shirt but it's fitted so I ordered the largest size.

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: Love the print style, embroidered and pictured as is.  I love the fit, I ordered a medium which is usually my size.  The length is perfect for me, 5' 0" tall, but might be too short for a taller person unless you want it that way.  Can't wait to wear it!

I LOVE THIS WATCH! I use the 1/3/5/10/15/20/30 minute timers all the the time to remind myself to do pretty much everything and it's a great strategy to keep me from spacing out all day. Yes, many of us probably have smartphones that can do the same thing but smartphones also are full of other ways to space out. I have scrawny wrists and this is the perfect size but is still an adult watch! The only thing is it's kind of itchy and uncomfortable because some of the parts seem to be cut roughly. I'll file them down if I don't get used to it. One last thing: I'm pretty sure I saw this at American Apparel being sold for twice the amazon price.

I love this bag, it's plenty big! It has a neat little phone pocket on the strap, a zipper pocket on the inside, the bag itself zips shut, and also has a little button to close it. I gave it four stars because the inside zipper pocket seems to be sewed partly shut, I'll just fix that myself. It's real good quality too. Overall, great bag for the price! And I will post some pictures.

I bought this as a gift and just ordered one for myself. The quality was beautiful and even though the sleeves were a little long for my mother, she was very pleased. Ill post a longer review when I get mine. All in all the size medium for her was the correct size. She is slight and about 5'7".

I ordered these shoes originally from a clearing house, and used the size scale to find my size.  Ordered my normal size, and they were huge. Unfortunately, I could not return those, but loved the style so I went on a mad search.  Very cute and comfortable, but run at least a full size large.

So, I typically buy the Doublju Short Sleeve Long Asymmetrical Tunic Doublju Basic Short Sleeve Long Asymmetrical Tunic Tops For Women With Plus size NAVY MEDIUM(in a Medium, they run a little large), but wanted to change it up a little. I bought a L in this one, wanted to keep some movement around my less than slender core. Fit just right - have the orange one on its way. Normally wear a large, so I'd say true to size. The length on this one hits a little past mid thigh on my shortness.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: First one of this type - I like it

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: There are a number of things that I love about this top including the 3/4 sleeve length, the tunic style that hits just above my thigh, and that subtle beauty of the design. The only flaw for me is that the material feels a bit like really lightweight sweater so As Florida  springtime wear it is sometimes a miss. But overall wonderful.

I'd been looking for nude flats for quite some time and decided on these after doing research.  Sometimes flats with elastic can pull too tight and begin to hurt my heel after a while, but these don't do that.  They have enough cushion in the sole to make them comfortable  for a whole day of wear, but they don't have arch support.

Call me old school but I still like an analog watch - save the digital watches for the kids.  Because I wanted a weatherproof watch for mountaineering and backpacking that also had an alarm - this watch fits the bill.  Worn it swimming and on Mt. Rainier when the driving rain from Camp Muir to the lodge soaked through the shell and my clothing.  No problems at all.

The only thing that could make this better is if the hands were self illuminating so that you could see it in the dark without having to press the back light button.

I typically wear an XL glove.  Reviews stated they ran smaller, so I ordered the XXL.  I am glad I did.  They are still a little tight getting on and off, but fit comfortably once on.  I wore them skiing the bowls at Arapahoe Basin, CO, two days ago on a cold and very windy day.  My hands were very warm (in fact were sweating!).  I'm definitely happy with the warmth and quality of the glove.  I do recommend you order XXL if you have XL sized hands.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Sized small, but warm and good quality

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText:
Jees I hate buying footwear over the web.
 I was looking for a easy on/off winter shoe to wear from home to work because I must wear safety footwear at work.
Work footwear get's filthy so must stay at work.
Wear 8.5 EE Redwings for work, and could not be happier with the comfort and fit.
Like my footwear with plenty of space.
First ordered Northside Men's Dawson Winter Shoe in size 8 & 9.
8 to narrow and just tight, 9 to narrow and to long...... and a large lump sewed into the toe.
Both go back.
Decided to try the more expensive Propet Men's Blizzard Ankle Zip Boot.
After several orders of sizes from 8 M, 8 3E, 8.5 3E, 9M finally found 8 5E fit fine.
Wore the 8 5E around the homestead a few hours and realized there was a lump defect in the toe of one of the boots.
Ordered a second pare of 8 5E boots and they are OK.
There is not many makers that offer multiple widths in a relatively inexpensive boot so hurray for Propet!!!
Jees I hate buying footwear over the web.

Arrived as expected, they look great. Still a little narrower than I was hoping for, hopefully they fit better after few weeks. They did have a small blemish on the outside of my left shoe about .250" x 1" inch long but I didn't mind so I wore them to my outdoor game. Felt good when striking the ball, another game this week then tournament this weekend. Hope they start to feel wider...

This bracelet is very nice. I do have to fiddle with it to re-tighten throughout the day and sometimes one of the pieces of steel will turn at an awkward angle; however, it doesn't happen often enough to be a real nuissance. So I give it 4 stars. It arrived in a timely fashion and nicely packaged. Kudos to Urban Jewelry for a nice piece and great service.

I haven't actually worn my shoes but have tried them on after I received the shipment.  There is extra room in the toe while the width seems about right.  I may have to re-lace the shoes to allow for a slightly looser fit but the "continental" lacing is not as easy to adjust as the method I am used to.  I like the looks of the shoe and will keep them.

Like some other people I have been looking for the belstaff bag that can be found in the movie "I am legend".  The only ones that I could find was well beyond my price range.  So I was hopeful when I found this bag though afraid of a cheep Chinese replica.

The good.
The bag has good weight and though a bit smaller than I was expecting it can hold a good amount of my thing; laptop, notebooks, drawing pad, etc. So far I don't see and loose threads and the strap is rather nice.  The bag also feels very durable and that it can take a beating.

The Bad.
My only complaints is of the magnetic buttons that hold the leather straps down.  I would much rather it just be loops to feed the leather through.  I also don't like the zipper.  It feels kind of cheap.  Lastly the interior of the bag has a liner that is not attached.  I can understand the logic for this as to adjust and expand for what you put in, but again I am not fond of it.

Final words.
I like this bag save for the few little things mentioned above but they can easily be adjusted.  For what it is worth it's a good bag.

I love the look of this hat! You can turn up the brim in SO many different ways and it changes the look of the hat. The color is more like a deep, rich turquoise which is even better in my opinion.  It feels a bit snug when you try it on, but that might be a good thing for a windy day.  If it feels too snug, I plan on just removing the inner drawstring.  I bought it for a trip overseas as the reviews said it was rollable and still maintained its shape.  Will keep you posted.  Love so much that I will probably buy another one in a more neutral color.  PS I also sprayed it with my shoe/cloth protector to help avoid staining when I travel and the color stayed the same with no bleeding:)
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: I love the look of this hat

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: I like it.  But you better keep the instructions around to figure out how to set the analog and the various digital components on this one.  Four buttons, and you have to know what you are doing.  Not a big deal if you don't get it right the first time try again.  Don't try to remember how to set this watch.

I am actually really impressed with these bras. Coming out of the package, they are thick and soft. Once I tried them on, they were easy to adjust to fit well and very comfortable. The padding inside the bra moves around, so I had to adjust the breast pad once on; it does not look like you can pull the padding out, so I might have to adjust it often. The snaps work really well and seem to be very durable as well.

I wish the sizing was clearer before ordering. I had to read reviews to see what size to order. I was surprised to see the fitting recommendations on the package once they arrived, yet they are not on the website. I wear a 36-38 D/DD. I ordered the XL and they fit well. My milk has not come in yet (I'm only 36 weeks pregnant) but I still have room for another half cup size, maybe a full cup size. Not only will I be wearing these while nursing, these be worn as everyday bras for me. Totally worth $25 for 3 of them. The way these are made, I would see these sold in stores at $25 each, great quality!

****UPDATE***
I've been wearing these bras for a couple of months now and I'm not too impressed. At first, when I tried them on, they seemed like they were going to be perfect...well...no. The shoulder straps keep falling down. I have adjusted the straps countless time and still nothing, every 5 minutes, they keep falling off. The padding in the breast moves around all the time and I'm not even nursing yet, I'm always moving the breast pad down as it keeps shifting up. Otherwise, they are comfortable, but if they can figure out the strap issue....I would be a highly satisfied customer.

*I hope my review was helpful for you!
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: they were easy to adjust to fit well and very very comfortable

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: If it was offered in larger sizes it would be a great robe for everyone and if you are a smaller person you will love it. The robe runs a bit small compared to other bathrobes I have bought. If you are 6ft tall... you might think about a different robe. I would also recommend that if you have a waist larger than 36 this might not fit the way you want. It will close and tie, but without a comfortable margin of overlap for the very shy folks.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Great for someone less than 5'-8" tall

Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.reviewText: I have number of Tom's Ware shirts and like most of them. Always needs to refer to customer feedback on sizing before ordering. Tom's ware sizes are not consistent across their products. Need to order large for this one and fits well. Styling is great and that's the main reason I bought couple of Tom's Ware shirts. Quality is fine but not top notch.
Clothing_Shoes_and_Jewelry.summary: Great shirt for the price! Sizing could be tricky

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: Although the color was acceptable, I was hoping for more of a fuchsia since the color was candy pink.  There is an UNNECESSARY huge cardboard that sticks out on the left side of the corset.  There was absolutely no way to hide it.  I did get rave reviews on the dress though.

I wore this to a wedding and it fit just fine. I liked that it wasn't thick but thick enough that when it got chilly it wouldn't be noticeable. This is a good strapless/backless option if you're just looking for coverage. The center of bra snaps together so if you need to have it detached for whatever reason you can. It's also very sticky so no fears of it just falling off.

My favorite part about this shirt dress is the deep pockets. In the picture, I have both my phone and wallet in each pocket, and you can barely tell. The quality is pretty good, somewhat see-through, but definitely not a problem if you wear light underwear. In the picture, I actually have blue shorts on underneath the dress, and again, you can hardly tell.

My problem with the dress is that it will swallow you up if you are petite. I am 5'2'' 110 lbs, and if it weren't for the convenient tie-waist, I would not be able to pull this dress off at all.

Overall, the style is elegant and the quality is not bad. Would recommend to taller friends especially because of the pockets and tie-waist features.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Well-designed, but not great for petite ladies

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: The watch is GORGEOUS -- BUT the clasp is weak.  It has dropped off my wrist at least 4 times during the first 5 days I had it and I wasn't even wearing it all the time.  I tried bending it out just a bit, but that didn't help so now I wrap a piece of scotch tape around it. It's a pain to get it off now, but it doesn't seem to fall off on its own.  Also the dial is a little hard to read. I think because the dial is a glossy gold and so the gold hands don't stand out well.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: I like it but it has problems.

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: This suit is very cute but some what impractical for wearing in the water. It felt like I had a diaper on because of how thick the neoprene is. It tends to collect water inside the suit, so be careful when getting out of water! Otherwise, it is a very cute suit and it fits great.

very high quality material but it fit smaller than I expected for a tank, which is all I was looking for.  for something which could generously provide shape, constriction, and contour to the torso, it will probably work very well for other people.  just not the type of tank I was looking for.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: very high quality material but it fit smaller than I ...

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: It's a very nice sweater. But it's more of a burnt Orange color instead of the red pictured. Also the sleeves have a crocheted design to it that is really hard to notice in it. It fits nice. I normally wear a M or L in sweaters, so if you wear a bigger size it might be a little tight. Overall, it's realy nice. I received a lot of compliments on in.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: It's a very nice sweater. But it's more of a burnt Orange ...

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText:
I wanted something that would help disguise my flat chest and this does ok. It doesn't come with very much padding at all (so it's great if you don't want much padding) but it has the little holes where you can insert a little something extra in there if needed. The "blue" color is really aqua and so pretty. The bottoms ran a little small for me, but that's just because I have a curvy bottom and like decent coverage in that area.
I'm 5'0, 110 lbs and wear a small for the top, and actually ordered a second suit in the medium so I could use those bottoms. Luckily it was only $15 so I was ok with buying a second suit.

They should let you order the top and bottom as  separates for those of us who need to mix different sizes...

My 13 year old has an Irish fetish due to Jack Septiceye.  I though he would love this sweatshirt  but was just kinda "meh".  It may be that he is shy about the shamrock placement, which had not occurred to me until he was wearing it.  He might consider this a girl's racy sweatshirt.

This is a very nice scarf. The colors are a beautiful blend of pastel pinks, purples, blues and white. It is very sheer, not too big and drapes nicely around the neck. The design is in the material, it is not handpainted or silk screened but is still a beautiful Japanese scene with blossoms and birds. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because it came with a small snag and 1" of unraveled hem. Overall, a beautiful scarf and I'm sure that I will get a lot of use from it.

Very comfortable and flattering-these shirts hang lower and are shaped/fitted in a way which gives a slimming look. Casual. Soft. Loose fitting. I own 4 of them. I had been told not to dry them because they shrink and will fall apart due to thin material/cheap quality, but I have washed and worn these multiple times and had no issues. I am 130lb and busty-the small fits perfectly.

**Edit to this review**
I bought two of these at the same time, both the same size. As time has gone on, one the shirt shrank more than the other...odd. Also the neck has frayed a bit on both of them but I like the distressed look so it doesn't bother me so much. I still wear them often and like them, very comfortable.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Very comfortable and flattering-these shirts hang lower and are shaped/fitted in ...

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: Extremely pretty swimsuit but not made for women with a 32 band size. Overall the whole suit fit except for the band that's supposed to keep the built in cups of the suit where they need to be. I'm sure you could re sew all the elastic around the cups but I honestly don't have time for that and will just be giving it away. Apart from that the suit is constructed very well and hides all "problem areas" perfectly.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Extremely pretty swimsuit but not made for women with a 32 ...

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: These are perfect for hanging out in and possibly Yoga, but not compression fitting for Pilates or exercising. The fabric is more like a tee shirt rather than the compression spandex I am used to. But they are very soft and surprisingly, they looked like they were too small but fit well. The only thing is, I need High Waist (as advertised) because I have such a short torso; I never seem to be able to find pants that come up to my natural waistline. One pair I purchased is perfect, the other pair is not cut quite as long so it falls on my hips like hip-huggers and would definitely show "butt cleavage" if I wore them to work out. For the price, and the cute colors, I would definitely order more.

Cute blouse. It's sort of what I've been looking for in an open shoulder blouse but I didn't  really like the panel material. So I cut it out instead and now the blouse is more like an open arm one. I'm modifying it so that it will be a cold shoulder blouse. Other than that, it's made nicely! I would advise ordering one size up.

These are very good quality cedar boot trees and do the job of keeping the foot area of the boot in good condition. However, the heel part of the boot tree is too narrow and does not fill the heel area well enough. The result is that the heel area of the boot is not kept filled out and the sides of the heel area are not kept in ideal shape. For the money they are not bad, and they are certainly better than not having boot trees at all. I would buy them again if nothing better was available at a reasonable price.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Good quality budget cedar boot trees

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: Really nice. It was smaller then I expected, but it actually worked out great for my son's kindergarten graduation. I prefer bowties with the neck strap, this one only had the pin, but I made it work and it stayed on. The quality was great, it had a matte look, I did not want a satin bowtie for this event.

Wow! Intensely red. This shirt is amazing. Neat clean lines and so sensuously soft. It is one of my new favorites tops. Be advised though and pay attention to the picture. The top of the shirt where the sleeve connects to the shoulder is has some unusual gathers. At first I thought it was a flaw in the make of the shirt, but after carefully examining the picture I realized it is supposed to be there. I think its purpose is to allow extra room for larger shoulders, but I'm not sure. At first it annoyed me, but now I have become accustomed to it.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: This shirt is amazing. Neat clean lines and so sensuously soft

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: Would be nice if there was a bit more stretch to them. I'm a fat lady and my wrists reflect that, they fit but they don't pull completely up my forearm like the picture shows, still far enough that it won't be a problem. I think even if they did pull all the way up my forearm it wouldn't matter, upon rotating the wrist it would pull them down anyway.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Would be nice if there was a bit more stretch to them

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: Very cute and great price! I'm a teacher, and this was fun to wear on Halloween. My only complaint is that it's plain blue in the back. In my opinion, it should say Crayola on the front and back. That's what crayons look like. The crayon wrapper goes all the way around. With this costume, it's hard to tell what you are from the back.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Very cute and great price! I'm a teacher

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: it look very small when you receive it however it will stretch--I am a size 16. The item do have a strong chemical smell. I washed it twice and you can still smell it- just not as bad. The material is not see through but it is on the thin side and should be handled with care when washing or putting them on.  It is soft--this is something I would wear around the house not so much to go out in
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: I washed it twice and you can still smell it- just not as bad. The material is not see through but it ...

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: I gave four stars because I choose my size but it barely fit. I cant wear it. Still thinking I'm going to lose weight. Like every woman. lol. So I kept it. But besides being to small the dress is just like the picture. So cute. Great material. Can't wait toil in able to wear it.

love the print, but design isn't terribly functional.  flimsy construction.  I want to use this all the time, but it can't handle that kind of use for two reasons: it won't hold up, and it is impossible to find anything in it.  I give the concept five stars, but execution I give two stars.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: love the print, but cheap construction

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText:
Wallet came a day early and undamaged, and looks just like it does in the photos. The fabric and stitching are well-done, nothing loose or out-of-place. I'm satisfied with the color and body overall, and the main pocket spaces are large enough to fit (and zip up with) my iPhone 6+, even with a case on it!

My only issue is that the wallet doesn't have some of the features listed. There are 8 card slots instead of 12 (and I can confirm that they're a little tight, as others have mentioned), and there is no clear view slot (not a big deal for me, though I admit I would've liked a clear view slot to showcase photos). Also, the two center-most pocket divisions are not sewn into the bottom of the wallet, so there's a small gap beneath them. I don't have any huge issue with this, but it's worth noting.

Conclusively, it's a well-made wallet. Haven't taken it out to test durability or anything (I'm a student with a heavy bag and a testy route around school, so we'll see), but it seems as if it'll hold up, as there aren't any loose threads or stitchings that might pose a problem. If there are any changes, I will update my review accordingly.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Cute and well-made, but lacking a couple of features.

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: The item name on this listing needs to be corrected. It reads "ASICS Utility Stretch Refu Running Gloves, Utility/Grey," however the item is actually (as pictured) a pair of slightly-elastic reflective wrist bands with velcro closures. They measure 1.5" wide x 11.5" long. Their maximum circumference when closed is about 5", which allows me to wear them on my wrists or ankles (to pull up some of the length of my too-long running pants). Good quality, bright neon fabric with super-reflective stripes.

I was worried about buying this product but it's actually really cute. I normally wear a Medium and I ordered a Large and it fits very snug but I think an XL would have been much better. . The fabric is great actually. The quality is a lot better than I expect it it to be.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: I ordered a size up and it fits great. The fabric is not bad either

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText:
I was excited to see this pack of 4 glasses with a nice variety of colors. The picture shows the glasses with a strength of +1.50. When I received my glasses, they were a +2.0. They are a bit too strong for me, but perhaps as my eyes weaken, I will be able to use them. The hinges are strong and the acrylic lenses seems to be of decent quality.

*I received this item at a discount for my honest opinion*

They're cute, come clean easily and the strings are long enough to securely tie this onto my kids head and it stays on her head. I have the infant and toddler sizes and love them both. I got white to go with everything and am pleased that when I have to wash them they come clean with no additional effort. I will re-purchase these as the girls get bigger.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: I own two and love them

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: I sent Lisong my measurements via the "Contact seller" option per their request on the item description. After some back and forth, they were able to verify that my measurements were sent to the manufacturer and I received a skirt that was proportional to my waist and height. I did request a different bow color but they were unable to meet the request. It was okay though because the bow was really cheap and hard to tie so I ended up buying another belt to match the skirt and cover the elastic waistband. As others have said, the elastic makes the skirt fit more comfortably but it's not cute at all and must be covered. As for the quality, I was pleasantly surprised. The tulle was not cheap and soft and better quality than I expected. The silhouette was just like in the photo - true A-line and fluffy. When it arrived, it was all compact and possibly wrinkly, but I sprayed it with Static Guard and hung it up over night before I needed to wear it and it was perfect. I got so many compliments and I felt darling in it. The color was bright and cheery as I hoped too! I definitely recommend this listing for good quality inexpensive tulle skirts and I myself will be purchasing another color soon. I knocked off one star because of the frustrating communication process (at first) and for the poor quality of the bow. Had it not been for that, I would have given them 5 stars. Thank you!
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Darling Staple Tulle Skirt For Spring/Summer

AMAZON_FASHION.reviewText: So, I just got this product today, the purple ones, in case it didn't state, and they definitely fit. They are only the TINIEST bit too tight, but I have fat thighs. And I can barely feel them, they aren't too tight! I am 135 pounds and 5'6. I would recommend this product, and want to buy more!

I Love the design and color of this bathing suit, color was true to picture- a bright red. However the bathing suit fit a tad bit small. The bottoms are more of a cheeky, and the top doesn't fit the entire breast. My suggestion would be to order a size up. Am usually a M but exchanging it for a L.

I purchased this item of clothing for my wife.  As a matter of fact she when she saw it she liked it and asked me to get it for her.  It is only at the check out I discovered that it was coming from china based on the length of time it will take to arrive.  I decided however that it would be worth the wait (she was really excited about it).  However, she was really disappointed when it finally came and she tried it on.  The material is quite flimsy and the construction is very poor.  Well the truth is, it was cheap.  You Get What You Pay For.

The necklace was knotted when it arrived and was quite dirty. But the charm itself was my reason for ordering and was beautiful on its own. I removed the charm and placed it on a different chain but in all i was satisfied with this item for the price i paid.

I loved this dress, but the arm holes were soooooooooooooooo small and the bust area did not come down over the bust area.  The reviews did not give good advice, I would have order a large if I knnew this.  Most reviews stated that it fit true to size.  Not!  I think this is Asian sized, not USA sized.  But the dress itself was beautiful, the color was as expected.  Sorry, I couldn't wear it.  I gave it to my niece.  She loved it!

When I received this set, to say that I was disappointed, would be a gross understatement.  I was disgusted!  First of all, the ring was damaged/defective (whatever you want to call a mess up).  The center stone was improperly set and positioned within he prongs.  It was crooked.  And I assure you it was extremely obvious.  It didn't take any close inspection to see.  It was glaring.  Then the prongs themselves were also bent down in mismatched places on the stone, one being bent straight down the side edge of the stone vs. pointing relatively toward the center.  This only added to the overall impression of the stone being crooked.  It made the stone look as if IT were misshapen and cut wrong.

I get that you can't expect fake jewelry that costs $30 to be the same quality as the real deal... But this?  It looks like it came off the $5 carousel at walmart.  And frankly, I wouldn't have bought it from there, for that price.  It looks like crap.  It looks like a gumball machine ring, or something that could have come out of a little girl's dress up set.

Now, even had the prongs been set properly, etc. I still wouldn't have worn it.  That just added insult to injury.  The ring, had it been in perfect shape, still would have looked like something from the dollar store.  It doesn't look anymore "real" than a peice of glass stuck in a plastic band.  The silver even looks funny. It looks like tin foil. The reflective sheen is a dead give away.

The stones don't look like diamonds at all.  They don't even look like good immitations.  They look like cheap junk.

Also the center stone is waaaaaaaaaaaaaaay to large to be believable. On anybody.  It's about a 3-4 ct. stone.  It looks absurdly fake.  So unless you think that your friends might actually be able to bring themselves to believe that you could afford a $15,000.00 ring, then ummm yeah it'll be too big.

And if you can pull that off, then maybe you can also convince them that you know, all good metals are as shiny as tin foil, too.

Don't get this ring.  Don't waste your money.

BTW.. I found a beautiful, well crafted and believable ring for a little bit more $$$ (but still at a VERY decent price) at [...]

I was fortunate not have much of a belly after he was born. In fact I think I have more of one now and I'm not sure if it is because I didn't wear my Belky Bandit for the recommended amount of time. I was able to tolerate it for 3 weeks day and night, not the 6 they say produces the best results. It is stiff and does not move with your body. It is difficult to wear under your clothes and does not stay in place. It requires constant readjusting. The worst was at night when it would slide up on my abdomen and squash my sore, milk-engorged boobs. My biggest complaint is it is not machine washable and if anyone else is like me it would get soaked during my delightful postpartum hormone sweats. Not fun!

So I bought these glasses thinking they were a steal! I mean finding sunglasses anywhere for a $10 price point is amazing already. Not to mention that they are polarized?! I was so excited to get some decent sunglasses finally...

Upon opening the packaging, I was already a little off-put by the small size of the glasses (it can probably be attributed to them being unisex). After putting them on though, that's the real kicker. They immediately gave me the feeling of dizziness similar to that of drunk goggles, if you have ever shared that experience. Walking outside was a whole new ball game. The glare coming off of other vehicles was magnified, not reduced like polarized sunglasses are meant to be. Instead, when looking at the glare directly, one of the lenses would perform perfectly, cancelling out all glare to the point that I could see into the backseat of a car with tinted windows. Yet on the other hand, or rather lens, it magnified the glare! It was like watching a 3-D movie out of the 2000's with the little paper glasses they would provide, but somehow the 3-D glasses didn't work as well and everything looked like it was in focus and out of focus at the same time while throwing depth perception out the window.

I am not sure if I received a poor or defective product, but these are going back as soon as I print the label out. These glasses may have panned out well if not for the so called "polarization" they put on them. Next time I look for a cheap pair of sunglasses, I'll avoid the polarized ones.
AMAZON_FASHION.summary: Spend more on the polarization or go un-polarized

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText:
This is a new purchase so I can only comment on my initial impressions and offer a tip on usage. I will update after I've used it for a while.

The overall build quality, fit and finish seem good. The instructions are only so-so.

The first issue I ran into was adding air as instructed. Both YouTube videos and the printed instructions say to inflate to 150 psi. This is relatively straight-forward using a shock pump (required). What nobody explains is how to remove the pump without losing all of the air you just added. There is an unboxing review on YouTube by Seth's Bike Hacks where he says to put more than 150 psi (the seatpost is rated for up to 250) and "take it off really quick".  Here's how I finally got that to work. First I only screw the pump hose on as far as needed to seal in preparation for minimal turning to remove. Pump it up and then unscrew it slowly until it starts to hiss. Tighten it a quarter turn at a time until the hissing stops.

Now inflate to just shy of 250 psi. If the inner post retracts, squeeze the release mechanism and pull it all the way out and continue inflating. The "trick" to removing quickly is to place the hose nut into something stable so you don't have to hold the pump. I put it loosely into a Panavise. I made it just tight enough that it wouldn't fall out, but didn't crank down on it so as not to deform anything. Place your right forearm on top of the left with fingers pointing at the opposite elbows. One palm should face up and the other should face down hands overlapping with the heels of your hands aligned. This is similar to the "I dream of Jeanie" pose for those who remember that. Put the body of the seatpost between the heels of your hands with the clamp end pointed away from you. As quickly as you can, pull your hands away from your elbows while maintaining pressure against the post. This should rapidly rotate the large diameter part of the seatpost thus unscrewing it from the pump hose. This worked like a charm, but air will still escape until you screw the cap provided over the Schrader valve.
Sports_and_Outdoors.summary: So far so good... if you know how to inflate

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText: It's got a lot of good features.  Keep water cold,  Easy to flip up to drink and down to close.  The spout should be bigger,  It is hard to drink and completely close your lips around the spout to keep it from spilling.  The wrist strap gets tangled on your wrist, it gets wet when you wash the bottle, and it's just awkward.  A small plastic piece that you can carry on a digit works much better.  Finally, I like a lot of ice and the container is very cold to carry.  It could use some sort of neoprene sleeve to hold on to.

I ordered the Subclaw as a daily carry knife for general purpose.  Debated between combo edge or claw, went with claw because I already have several combo edge knifes.  After ordering it arrived via UPS lightning quick.  I did not need it that fast and gladly would pay less to deliver slower.  In fact that is my biggest complaint, shipping cost is outragous and there are NO OPTIONS.  The knife itself is very good quality.  The blade is razor sharp! The body is made of heavy gauge metal and heavier than I expected.  It measures over a quarter inch thick, not including clip, and 2.75" x 1.75" when closed, 4.25" when open, blade itself is just under 2".  It's all held together with screws and the clip is reversable and removable.  One side is black with nice grips and the other side is plain no frills.  The only big concern is the thumb pads, which are on both sides for ambidextrous use, but they are only glued on.  Should have been bolted.  They seem secure, but long term is unknown.  Takes a little practice to open one handed, but can be done.  The reasons I gave 4 stars, rather than 5, are the thumb tabs, the shipping cost and the weight.  Aside from that it seems to be an excellent knife that I would recomend to anyone.

I gave it 4 out of 5 stars not because of the quality of the material but bec the sheath is too tight. I struggle to get the snap closed. The blade fits perfect in the sheath but too effort to close the snap. Once I stored it for about a week, it snapped fine every time. The company shipped the item om time and it was packed well.

It doesn't bother me, and I love how easy it's been to stay hydrated with this water bottle.

My problem is that my ankles are small compared to my 17 inch calf  and the hose hung from just below the curvature of my calf to my ankle and provided no compression in that area.  I even tried two different sizes. These would work well for a man or a woman with large ankles or small calves.  So sorry that they don't work for me but I would recommend them to those for whom they would work,  The logo is not as large or obnoxious as some of the other brands. Sadly, I'm back to the open toe compression hose instead.  The orange color is not too loud a color when on and the other colors look nice in the picture so I imagine they are less bold in reality also. If they had fit me I would have given them 5 stars because of the usefulness and comfortable band. I obviously need to lose weight so if you are a near average weight give them a try.

I do not recommend that you waste your time and money on this. Even if you are going for a budget knife and you don't have the kind of money to buy a higher priced one, you are seriously better off saving up for a long time and getting something at the very least around $30 and up.

Would this knife be useful in a self defense scenario? ABSOLUTELY! That serrated portion could do a ton of damage and is very sharp. Plus there is an intimidation factor as visually, it looks pretty dangerous.

Is it practical for use as an actual knife? ABSOLUTELY NOT! Do not buy this thinking it will be a good survival knife. The handle is total crap, its cheap hollow plastic and mine over the years has developed a sticky residue (though that could have been from something spilled on it or due to heat, I decided to wrap mine). The serrations, while sharp and intimidating are very poor for cutting through cordage or for use as a saw, even for smaller branches. Could it cut through some branches and rope, sure. But it would definitely not hold up to that much abuse for very long.

In short, I would choose this knife as a last resort. It would NOT be in my bug out bag or sit alongside my other knives or tools. I could find much better survival tools to occupy the space this would take in my bag.

It would probably be pretty decent for the impending zombie apocalypse though.

The main defect of this seat is what is being sold as a feature, but to me is definitely a bug.  That is, the swiveling of the seat.  Every time you pedal, pushing with your leg, the seat swivels backwards in the opposite direction leaving you nothing to push back upon.  This steals the pushing force from your pedal stroke and also makes riding with the seat unstable because the seat keeps moving away from behind you every time you make a stroke pedaling .

To clarify, you naturally push from your rear when you pedal, pushing down and forward with your leg.  However, the seat swivels and "disappears" behind your rear, giving you nothing to push back on.  A normal stationary seat gives you something to push back against, giving you force in the other direction against the pedals.

Imagine your have your hands up vertically in a Patty cake position, placed against the the hands of another person facing you similarly.  You press against the persons hands while the other person holds their hands stationary.  This force would provide you propulsion and movement in the opposite direction.  That's what happens when you pedal with your legs.  Now imagine that when you push against the other person's hands that instead of holding them stationary, they just let them go back loosely.  You get no opposing force because you have nothing to push against, and you have the feeling of falling, uncontrolled movement.  That's what happens with this seat.  It neutralizes your movement, causing you to lose pedaling force, destabilizing you with its swivel.

In order to compensate for the movement of the seat I have to adopt an awkward, unnatural style of pedaling to make up for the saddle moving all the time.

What's frustrating is that otherwise the seat is nicely engineered and machined.  It's comfortably padded to sit still on.  If the seat was simply stationary instead of wobby, it would be a perfect seat.

I don't get what the designer was trying to accomplish with the wobbling.  The problem with saddles with noses is the nose.  It's not that they are stationary.  A solid stationary platform is necessary for efficient and stable cycling.  The product description claims that the swiveling makes the seat "comfortable and safe for delicate nerves and arteries".  I don't see this.  If anything it makes it less comfortable and dangerous for the rest of you because of the instability.

This saddle fixes one problem but needlessly adds another.  It's as if the designer felt they had to add some feature to the seat so that it could qualify as unique in order to obtain a patent.  Sorry, as they say in software, it's not a feature, it's a bug.

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText: Having had a previous item similar to this, I was excited to order another one. However, upon receipt I noticed that the locking mechanism for the blade would not work as the 'spring lock' upper metal was not cut to specs thereby failing to engage and creating a serious safety issue, one I experienced when the blade nearly closed on my hand immediately after opening it from the package.
Sports_and_Outdoors.summary: Safety Concern: Blade locking mechanism failed to engage

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText:
I am notoriously anti-Brita, since all of their products always seem to break or not work well rather easily.  This bottle is no exception--it was so awful I had to toss it.  The screw-on top of the first bottle I got shattered into pieces after a fall from about a foot--classic Brita craftsmanship.  Amazon quickly replaced the week-old bottle and the newer one went on to suck for almost a year until I chucked it out of disgust.

Pros:

Filters water.

Cons:

Everything else.

1) Not remotely leak/spill-proof.  The screw-on top barely has a seal, so if this happens to tilt or fall over in your work bag, water is going everywhere (not ideal especially if you happen to have a laptop in the same bag).  It also leaks when full and at a small angle--for instance, when you're simply walking and holding it with a finger by the loop.  It leaks constantly while in motion, so you're the dummy leaving a trail of water everywhere.

2) It makes very strange noises when you first try to suck water through the flip-up straw.  Perfect for when you're thirsty in the middle of a meeting and you want everyone to look at you like you just passed gas.

3) As such, not ideal for an office environment.  My main reason for buying this was to have a device that could contain and filter water for consumption throughout my office work day.  Not only does it make untimely straw noises, but you feel like you're using an adult sippy cup.

4) As for outdoors, I cannot imagine this cheap piece of plastic managing any rugged activity (let alone holding any water in).  Again, my first bottle broke after a very short fall onto a carpeted floor.

I recently switched to a Camelbak Chute and couldn't be happier (I fill it with filtered water).  As far as Brita products, I am done forever.  I had so many bad experiences with their pitchers that I switched to Mavea (their pitchers rock, for what it's worth).  This water bottle was no different--cheap parts and ill-conceived design.  That it filters water on the fly does not outweigh the awful experience of having to actually use it.

This item is garbage. Literally. After an hour dealing with parts that don't work and that don't fit, I gave up and just threw it away. Just cheap, cheap plastic that doesn't fit together and breaks if you barely try. There were no written instructions and the pictures didn't at all match the connections on my bike (2011 Trek 4 Series). SKIP!

Bought these for my son to keep water out of his ears when he showers because he has a really difficult time with water staying trapped in them and he ends up with chronic swimmers ear. We have tried the vinegar and alcohol trick, and the hydrogen peroxide, but those products tend to dry out the skin inside the ear as much as they do the water, and he ends up with dried out skin inside the ear that is sore and cracked. We hoped these would prevent the water from entering the ear but unfortunately they were completely worthless in that respect. The do however make fun little toys for my cat to bat around on the floor so I guess they are worth 1 star.
Sports_and_Outdoors.summary: worthless for ears... but the cat likes to chase them around.

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText: LOVE LOVE this hat. I wore it all summer in the corn fields and at two separate  student camps I went to. This hat did a good job of keeping the sun of most of my face. I did get my lips burnt on a really hot week, however I should of put sunscreen on. On the rainy day's it is awesome at beading the water away from your face. I receive many completes on it as well.

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText: Works well. Bought it to throw in my winter emergency kit in my car. You can never have too many ways to start a fire. Word of advice: this makes plenty of spark, but only starts a fire with the help of very good tinder. If you don't want to spend a fortune on exotic fungus or wood shaving tinders, go out and buy a roll of waxed paper, tear it in strips and wad them in your hand. Then loosen them up and you have some excellent tinder.

He started baseball's famous streak That's got us all aglow He's just a man and not a freak, Joltin' Joe DiMaggio. Joe, Joe DiMaggio We want you on our side The song "Joltin'" Joe DiMaggio was penned in 1941 by Ben Homer and Alan Courtney for the Les Brown Orchestra, where it was sung by Betty Bonney. Of course the reference is to the 56-game hitting streak that began on May 15 when DiMaggio went 1-for-4 with a run batted in against the Chicago White Sox. It would end 56 gmes later on July 16, the day before third basemen Ken Keltner of the Cleveland Indians made two terrific backhanded stops to rob DiMaggio of hits. During the streak DiMaggio had 91 hits in 223 at bats to hit .409, to go along with 56 runs, 16 doubles, 4 triples, 15 home runs, and 55 runs batted in. DiMaggio's 56-game hitting streak is one of the greatest individual achievements in baseball history. It might not be as impossible as record to break as Cy Young's marks for career wins (511), career losses (316), and complete games (749), and no one is going to come close to Jack Chesbro's 41 wins. But in terms of single season achievements in the realm of hitting the only other marks that seem equally unassailable are Earl Webb's 67 doubles, Babe Ruth's 177 runs scored (or Billy Hamilton's 192 runs if you want to go pre-1900), and Hack Wilson's 191 RBIs. But none of those have the cache of DiMaggio's hitting streak. What is nice about this Cooperstown Series 4 action figure of Joe DiMaggion in the pinstripped uniform of the New York Yankees is that it is clearly based on one of the best known photographs of the Yankee Clipper, sold on Amazon as The Swing, Washington, D.C., 1941, Joe DiMaggio Photographic Poster Print, 11x14. Was the photo taken during the streak? When the Yankees went to Washington in late May (27-29) those were only games 12-14 in DiMaggio's streak. He went 4-5, 1-4 and 1-3 during the series, with the Yankees winning the first two games and tying the third. So if the photograph was indeed taken during that period it was not because photographers were focuing on the streak. I rounded up on this figure because they did a great job of capturing DiMaggio's distinctive hitting approach, even if they did add a lot of dirt on his pants legs and were rather inconsistent on drawing the pinstrips. But I also like the details that you can just tell DiMaggio is wearing a blue t-shirt underneath his uniform, and that the pine tar goes a third of the way up the bat where the signature is for "Joseph DiMaggio." The sculpt of the face is pretty good, but more from the profiles than from the front. There is no articulation for the figure and you have to add the right foot to the figure to complete it. The most significant change is the knob of the bat comes already attached to the figure's left hand. In the beginning we had to cut open the hands of a batter (e.g., Jason Giambi) to put the bat in position, and then they did it so the knob came off and you could slide the bat into position (e.g., Hideki Matsui), and hope the knob did not fly off and disappear. So this is a great improvement (although I did spend a couple of minutes looking for the knob on my desk or on the ground when I opened the package and found it was not on the end of the bat. The Yankee Clipper played in 139 games in 1941, getting 193 hits in 541 time at bat for a .357 batting average (of course, that was the same year that Ted Williams batted .406). DiMaggio scored 122 runs and drove in 125 while hitting 43 doubles, 11 triples, and 30 home runs while only striking out 13 times, and winning the second of his three American League Most Valuable Player awards. It is quite appropriate that joining DiMaggio in the Cooperstown Series 4 are Ted Williams  completing his swing at Fenway Park for the Red Sox (with road variation), along with Roger Maris of the New York Yankees (clearly based on the photograph of him hitting his home run #61 in 1961, which makes the Cardinal variant somehwat odd), Johnny Bench of the Cincinnati Reds diving over the short fence in front of the dugout at Riverfront Stadium to catch a ball, Steve Carlton about to deliver the ball on the road for the Philadelphia Philies (or at home), and an upside down Ozzie Smith doing his pattented opening day back flip in St. Louis for the Cardinals. With DiMaggio (#5, first worn by Bob Meusel) and Maris (#9) getting McFarlane figures this season, along with Derek Jeter (#2), Babe Ruth (#3), Mickey Mantle (#7, first worn by Leo Durocher), and Yogi Berra (#8), we have two thirds of the Yankee single digit uniform numbers, all of which have been retired except for Jeter (for now). Sooner or later there has to be one of Lou Gehrig (#4), and then the question is whether they will ever do a figure of Billy Martin (#1, first worn by Earle Combs) and Bill Dickey (also #8, although he started wearing #10). Phil Rizzuto wore #10 in case you were wondering (#6 was first worn by Tony Lazzeri, and there are also McFarlane figures of Don Mattingly(#23), and Reggie Jackson (#44) when it comes to retired Yankee numbers, which can include #42, retired now for Jackie Robinson but also in the future for Mariano Rivera. I assume the day will come for Thurman Munson (#15), Whitey Ford (#16), Elston Howard (#32), Casey Stengel (#37), and Ron Guidry (#40), because it seems like McFarlane comes out with a couple of Yankees, past and present, every single year. As soon as I get my updated Bobby Abreu, the new Robinson Cano and the second Johnny Damon figures later this summer, I will have all nine of this year's Yankee starters in Yankees uniforms (Yes, I know, I have to put Giambi at first base instead of DH to do this because there is not a Doug Mientkiewicz action figure, at least, not yet...).
Sports_and_Outdoors.summary: "Joltin'" Joe DiMaggio from the 1941 season of the 56-game hitting streak

Sports_and_Outdoors.reviewText:
